rules.title: Case Suffixes: तस् and त्र
rules.body:
The following suffixes are sometimes added to nominal bases to express the meanings of cases.

**(a)** The suffix @deva[तस्] added to the base of a noun gives it the sense of the Ab.[^1]; as @deva[प्रमादतः], from carelessness'. @deva[वस्तुतः] from the real state of the thing, in reality. @deva[ज्ञानतः] 'from knowledge,' @deva[बहुतः] &c.

**(b)** The suffix @deva[त्र] is used to denote the meaning of the Loc.[^2] case, and is generally added to pronominal adjectives; as @deva[तत्र] 'in that place, there'; @deva[सर्वत्र] 'in every place, everywhere, &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[पञ्चम्यास्तसिल्] — Pāṇ. V. 3. 7.

[^2]: @deva[सप्तम्यास्त्रल्] Pāṇ. V. 3. 10. By '@deva[इतराभ्यां द्रष्टव्ये]' — Pāṇ. V. 3. 14. @deva[तस्], @deva[त्रल्] &c. may stand for all cases except the Nom. (though they may be used for the Nom. also).

rules.title: Indeclinable Nouns
rules.body:
A few nouns such as @deva[भूर्] 'the lowest world,' @deva[स्वर्] 'heaven,' @deva[संवत्] 'a year of an era', @deva[अस्तम्] 'setting,' @deva[शम्] 'ease,' @deva[नमस्] 'a bow', @deva[स्वस्ति] 'hail, farewell' &c. are indeclinables.

---

# Chapter IV.
# PRONOUNS AND THEIR DECLENSION.

rules.title: Definition of Pronouns: The 35 Sanskrit Pronouns
rules.body:
The following 35 words are termed 'Pronouns' in Sanskrit:—@deva[सर्व], @deva[विश्व], @deva[उभ], @deva[उभय], @deva[इतर], @deva[इतम] (i. e. the word formed by the addition of the terminations @deva[इतर] and @deva[इतम] to the pronouns @deva[किम्], @deva[यद्], and @deva[तद्] which become @deva[क], @deva[य] and @deva[त] respectively before these; e. g. @deva[कतर], @deva[कतम], @deva[यतर], @deva[यतम], and @deva[ततर], @deva[ततम्]) @deva[अन्य], @deva[अन्यतर], @deva[त्यत्], @deva[त्वत्], @deva[त्व], @deva[नेम], @deva[सम], @deva[सिम], @deva[पूर्व], @deva[पर], @deva[अवर], @deva[दक्षिण], @deva[उत्तर], @deva[अपर], @deva[अधर], @deva[स्व], @deva[अन्तर]; @deva[त्यद्], @deva[तद्], @deva[एतद्], @deva[इदम्], @deva[अदस्], @deva[एक], @deva[द्वि], @deva[युष्मद्], @deva[अस्मद्], @deva[भवत्] and @deva[किम्].

---

[^1]: @deva[पञ्चम्यास्तसिल् । सप्तम्यास्त्रल्] Pāṇ. V. 3. 7. 10. By '@deva[इतराभ्यां द्रष्टव्ये ।]' Pāṇ. V. 3. 14. @deva[तस्], @deva[त्रल्] &c. may stand for all cases except the Nom. (though they may be used for the Nom. also).

## 1—Personal Pronouns.

rules.title: Personal Pronouns: अस्मद्, युष्मद्, भवत्
rules.body:
The pronouns @deva[अस्मद्] 'I,' @deva[युष्मद्] 'thou', and @deva[भवत्] 'your honour.'—

**N. B.**—The declension of the first two of these pronouns is the same in all the three genders.

@deva[अस्मद्][^1] m. f. n.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[अहम्] | @deva[आवाम्] | @deva[वयम्] |
| A. | @deva[माम्], @deva[मा] | @deva[आवाम्], @deva[नौ] | @deva[अस्मान्], @deva[नः] |
| I. | @deva[मया] | @deva[आवाभ्याम्] | @deva[अस्माभिः] |
| D. | @deva[मह्यम्], @deva[मे] | @deva[आवाभ्याम्], @deva[नौ] | @deva[अस्मभ्यम्], @deva[नः] |
| Ab. | @deva[मत्] | @deva[आवाभ्याम्] | @deva[अस्मत्] |
| G. | @deva[मम], @deva[मे] | @deva[आवयोः], @deva[नौ] | @deva[अस्माकम्], @deva[नः] |
| L. | @deva[मयि] | @deva[आवयोः] | @deva[अस्मासु] |

@deva[युष्मद्] m. f. n.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[त्वम्] | @deva[युवाम्] | @deva[यूयम्] |
| A. | @deva[त्वाम्], @deva[त्वा] | @deva[युवाम्], @deva[वाम्] | @deva[युष्मान्], @deva[वः] |
| I. | @deva[त्वया] | @deva[युवाभ्याम्] | @deva[युष्माभिः] |
| D. | @deva[तुभ्यम्], @deva[ते] | @deva[युवाभ्याम्], @deva[वाम्] | @deva[युष्मभ्यम्], @deva[वः] |
| Ab. | @deva[त्वत्] | @deva[युवाभ्याम्] | @deva[युष्मत्] |
| G. | @deva[तव], @deva[ते] | @deva[युवयोः], @deva[वाम्] | @deva[युष्माकम्], @deva[वः] |
| L. | @deva[त्वयि] | @deva[युवयोः] | @deva[युष्मासु] |

@deva[भवत्] to be declined like @deva[भगवत्]; @deva[भवान् भवन्तौ भवन्तः] N. @deva[भवन्तम् भवन्तौ भवतः] A. &c. @deva[मद्भवत्], @deva[तद्भवत्] (see Syntax 'Pronouns') are similarly declined.

---

[^1]: @deva[युष्मदस्मद्भ्यां षष्ठीचतुर्थीद्वितीयास्थानयोर्वानौ । बहुवचनस्य नसौ । तेमे द्वैकवचनस्य । त्वामी द्वितीयायाः ।] Pāṇ. VIII. 1. 20-23.

rules.title: Usage Rules for Shorter Pronoun Forms
rules.body:
**(a)** The optional shorter forms of the pronouns @deva[अस्मद्] and @deva[युष्मद्] are never used at the beginning of a sentence or of a foot of a metre;[^1] nor can they be used immediately before the particles @deva[च], @deva[वा], @deva[ह] or @deva[हा], @deva[अह] and @deva[एव]; as @deva[मम गृहं] my house, and not @deva[मे गृहम्]; @deva[वेदैःसर्वैः संयतोऽस्मान् कृष्णः सर्वदापातु] (Sid. Kau.), 'may Kṛṣṇa, revered throughout or capable of being known properly from all the Vedas, always protect us; and not @deva[नः कृष्णः] &c.; @deva[तवैव कर्मैतत्] 'this is surely your deed,' and not @deva[ते एव] &c. But if these particles do not connect these forms they may be used with them‡; as @deva[हरो हरिश्च मे स्वामी] (Sid. Kau.) Hara and Hari are my lords, &c.

**Obs.**—**(b)** The shorter forms may be used in a sentence having one verb; @deva[शालीनां ते ओदनं दास्यामि]; but @deva[ओदनं पच तव भविष्यति] as there are two verbs[^2].

**(c)** These shorter forms are not also used immediately after the Vocative case except when a qualifying adjective follows it;[^3] @deva[देवास्मान्] (and not @deva[नः]) @deva[पाहि सर्वदा] (Sid. Kau.) 'Oh God! do thou protect us always'; but @deva[हरे दयालो नः पाहि] (Sid. Kau.) 'Oh merciful Hari, protect us.'

**(d)** The shorter forms may or may not be used when there is no @deva[अन्वादेश] (the subsequent mention of a thing already mentioned); @deva[याता ते मक्रोसिः], @deva[याता तत्र मक्रोसिः], @deva[इति वा ।]; but must be used when there is anvadeś'a[^4]; @deva[तस्मै ते नमः] 'bow to thee (already described) only.'

---

[^1]: @deva[पदादौ । अनुदात्तं सर्वमपादादौ ।] Pāṇ. VIII. 1. 17. 18. The following couplets illustrate the use of these short forms:—@deva[श्रीशङ्कराः अवतु मा पाहि दत्ता ते मे पि मां च सः । स्वामी ते मे पि स हरिः पातु बाधेभ्यो नौ विधुः ।। सर्वदा नो ददात्येष धनं जीविभि नो हरिः । सोऽप्यादौ नः शिवं यो नो दयाते वैव युक्त्या सः नः ।।] Sid. Kau.

[^2]: @deva[समानवाक्ये निपाते युक्तोऽसमदादेशा एकव्याः ।] Vārt.

[^3]: Pāṇ. VIII. 1. 72. 73.

[^4]: @deva[एते सर्वे अन्वादये आदेशा अनन्वादेशे वा वक्तव्याः ।] Vārt.

## 2—Demonstrative Pronouns.

rules.title: Demonstrative Pronouns: तद्, एतद्, इदम्, अदस्
rules.body:
The pronouns @deva[तद्] 'that or he, she, it,' @deva[एतद्] 'this,' @deva[इदम्] 'this' and @deva[अदस्] 'that'. The Nom. sing of the first two is respectively @deva[सः] and @deva[एषः] mas. and @deva[सा] and @deva[एषा] fem. In other cases they become @deva[त] and @deva[एत] and are declined like nouns in @deva[अ] except in the Nom. pl., D. Ab. sings., G. pl. and L. sing. the terminations of which are @deva[ए], @deva[स्मै], @deva[स्मात्], @deva[एषाम्] and @deva[स्मिन्] mas. and @deva[स्यै], @deva[स्यास्], @deva[स्यास्], @deva[साम्] and @deva[स्याम्] fem. respectively. All pronouns ending in @deva[अ] are similarly declined.

@deva[तद्] mas.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[सः] | @deva[तौ] | @deva[ते] |
| A. | @deva[तम्] | @deva[तौ] | @deva[तान्] |
| I. | @deva[तेन] | @deva[ताभ्याम्] | @deva[तैः] |
| D. | @deva[तस्मै] | ,, | @deva[तेभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[तस्मात्] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | @deva[तस्य] | @deva[तयोः] | @deva[तेषाम्] |
| L. | @deva[तस्मिन्] | ,, | @deva[तेषु] |

Fem.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[सा] | @deva[ते] | @deva[ताः] |
| A. | @deva[ताम्] | ,, | ,, |
| I. | @deva[तया] | @deva[ताभ्याम्] | @deva[ताभिः] |
| D. | @deva[तस्यै] | ,, | @deva[ताभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[तस्याः] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | ,, | @deva[तयोः] | @deva[तासाम्] |
| L. | @deva[तस्याम्] | ,, | @deva[तासु] |

Decline @deva[त्यद्] which means the same thing as @deva[तद्],
e.g. @deva[त्यः त्यौ त्ये] Nom.; @deva[त्यम् त्यौ त्यान्] Acc. &c.

@deva[तत्] neu.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. and A. | @deva[तत्] | @deva[ते] | @deva[तानि] |

The following cases like the mas.

@deva[एतद्] mas.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[एषः] | @deva[एतौ] | @deva[एते] |
| A. | @deva[एतम्-एनम्][^1] | @deva[एतौ-एनौ] | @deva[एतान्-एनान्] |
| I. | @deva[एतेन-एनेन] | @deva[एताभ्याम्] | @deva[एतैः] |
| D. | @deva[एतस्मै] | ,, | @deva[एतेभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[एतस्मात्] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | @deva[एतस्य] | @deva[एतयोः-एनयोः] | @deva[एतेषाम्] |
| L. | @deva[एतस्मिन्] | ,, | @deva[एतेषु] |

Fem.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[एषा] | @deva[एते] | @deva[एताः] |
| A. | @deva[एताम्-एनाम्] | @deva[एते-एने] | @deva[एताः-एनाः] |
| I. | @deva[एतया-एनया] | @deva[एताभ्याम्] | @deva[एताभिः] |
| D. | @deva[एतस्यै] | ,, | @deva[एताभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[एतस्याः] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | @deva[एतस्याः] | @deva[एतयोः एनयोः] | @deva[एतासाम्] |
| L. | @deva[एतस्याम्] | ,, | @deva[एतासु] |

Neu.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[एतत्] | @deva[एते] | @deva[एतानि] |
| A. | @deva[एतत्-एनत्] | @deva[एते-एने] | @deva[एतानि-एनानि] |

The rest like the mas.

**Notes:**—The visarga of @deva[सः] and @deva[एषः] is dropped when followed by any letter except @deva[अ] in which case the usual Sandhi rule applies; e.g, @deva[स गच्छतु], @deva[एष आगत्ति]; but @deva[एषोऽगच्छत्] &c, Vide @ref[50].

rules.title: Usage Rules for Demonstrative Pronouns
Optional Forms with अन्वादेश
rules.body:
The optional forms of @deva[इदम्] and @deva[एतद्] in the Acc., Inst. Sing. and Gen. & Loc. Duals are to be used when there is anōddeś'a[^1] i. e. their proper forms have already been used in a previous clause; e. g. @deva[अनेन व्याकरणमधीतं एनं छन्दोऽध्यापय] 'he has studied grammar, teach him prosody,' @deva[अनयोः पवित्रं कुले, एनयोः प्रभूतं स्वम्], 'The family of them both is pure, and their wealth ample.'

---

[^1]: @deva[किञ्चिदुपन्यासविधायोपसर्गस्य पुनर्विधानं पुनरुपादानमन्वादेशः ।] Sid. Kau.

## 3—The Relative Pronouns.

rules.title: Relative Pronoun: यद्

| L. | @deva[कस्याम्] | ,, | @deva[कासु] |

|---|---|---|---|
| N. & A. | @deva[किम्] | @deva[के] | @deva[कानि] |

The remaining cases like the mas,

## 5—Reflexive Pronouns.

rules.title: Reflexive Pronouns: आत्मन् and स्वयम्
rules.body:
The sense of the reflexive pronoun is, in Sanskrit, expressed by the word @deva[आत्मन्] 'self' which is invariably used in the masculine gender and singular number, and by the reflexive adverb @deva[स्वयम्] e.g. @deva[गुप्तं ददृशुरात्मानं सर्वाः स्वप्नेषु वामनैः] "they all (the wives of Das'aratha) saw in dreams that they were guarded by dwarfs; " @deva[सः] or @deva[सा कृतापराधमिव आत्मानमवगच्छति ।] @deva[राजा स्वयं समरभूमि जगाम], &c.

## 6--- Indefinite Pronouns.

rules.title: Indefinite Pronouns: Formation with चित्, चन, अपि, स्विद्
rules.body: Indefinite pronouns are formed by the addition of @deva[चित्] or @deva[चन] or @deva[अपि] and sometimes of @deva[स्विद्] to the various cases of the pronoun @deva[किम्] in all the genders; g. @deva[कश्चित्], @deva[कश्चन] a certain one, @deva[कोपि], @deva[केनापि], @deva[कयाचन], @deva[कस्यापि]; @deva[कस्विद्], &c.

rules.title: Indefinite Adverbs
rules.body:
The terminations given above are also added to interrogative adverbs in the sense of indefiniteness; as @deva[कदाचित्] at some time, @deva[कदाचन], @deva[कतिचित्] some, @deva[क्वचित्] somewhere, &c.

## 7 - Correlative Pronouns.

rules.title: Correlative Pronouns: Formation with वत् and दृश
rules.body: Correlatives are formed by the affix @deva[वत्] added to @deva[यद्], @deva[तद्] and @deva[एतद्], and @deva[यत्] added to @deva[इदम्] and @deva[किम्] in the sense of as much as; and @deva[दृश] or @deva[दृश्] in the sense of 'similar to'; @deva[तद्], @deva[एतद्] and @deva[यह] become @deva[ता], @deva[एता] and @deva[या] respectively before these, and @deva[इदम्] and @deva[किम्] @deva[इ] and @deva[कि] before @deva[वत्] and @deva[ई] and @deva[की] before @deva[दृश] or @deva[दृश्]; e. g. @deva[तावत्] (@deva[तत्परिमाणमस्य]), @deva[इयत्] (@deva[इदं परिमाणमस्य]), @deva[तादृश] like that, @deva[ईदृश], like this, @deva[कियत्] how much, &c.

rules.title: Numerical Correlatives: तति, यति, कति
rules.body:
The affix @deva[आति] is added to @deva[तद्], @deva[यद्] and @deva[किम्] to show number or measure e. g. @deva[तति] 'so many', @deva[यति] 'as many,' and @deva[कति] 'how many'. These are declined in the plural only, and take no termination in the Nom. and Acc.; e. g. Nom. and Acc. @deva[कति] Inst. @deva[कतिभिः] the rest like @deva[हरि].

## 8—Reciprocal Pronouns.

rules.title: Reciprocal Pronouns: अन्योन्य, इतरेतर, परस्पर
rules.body:
Reciprocity is expressed by the repetition of the pronominal adjectives @deva[अन्य], @deva[इतर] and @deva[पर]; e. g. @deva[अन्योन्य], @deva[इतरेतर], and @deva[परस्पर]. These are generally used in the sing. and also adverbially e. g. @deva[परस्परेण स्पृहणीयशोभौ] &c. (Rag. VII. 14); @deva[परस्परं विवद्न्ते] &c. They are more commonly used as the first members of compounds; as @deva[अन्योन्यक्रोधाजननात् बभूव] &c. (Ku. I, 44; @deva[इतरेतरयोगात्] (Sis. X. 24.) &c.

## 9- -Possessive Pronouns.

rules.title: Possessive Pronouns: Formation and Declension
rules.body:
Possessive pronouns are formed by means of the secondary affix @deva[ईय] added to @deva[तद्], @deva[एतद्], @deva[अस्मद्], and @deva[युष्मद्]; and @deva[अ] and @deva[ईन] added to @deva[अस्मद्], and @deva[युष्मद्], changed respectively to @deva[मामक्] and @deva[तावक्] in the sing. and @deva[आस्माक्] and @deva[यौष्माक्] in the plu. before these; e. g.

@deva[अस्मद्]

| @deva[मदीय] 'my, mine' | @deva[अस्मदीय] 'our, ours' |

**N. B.** These are declined like nouns ending in @deva[अ], @deva[आ] or @deva[ई] regularly. @deva[स्व] is a possessive pronoun by itself.

## 10—Pronominal Adjectives.

rules.title: Pronominal Adjectives: अन्य, कतर, यतर, ततर
rules.body:
@deva[अन्य] 'another,' @deva[अन्यतर] 'either of two,' @deva[इतर] 'other,' @deva[एकतम] 'one of many,' @deva[कतर] 'who or which of two,' @deva[कतम] 'who or which of many,' @deva[यतर] 'who or which of two,' @deva[यतम] 'who or which of many,' @deva[ततर] 'that one (of two),' @deva[ततम] 'that one (of many),' are declined in all the three genders like @deva[यद्] e. g.

mas.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[कतरः] | @deva[कतरौ] | @deva[कतरे] |

fem.

| &c. | | | |

| N. & A. | @deva[कतरत्] | @deva[कतरे] | @deva[कतराणि] |
| &c. | | | |

**N. B.** @deva[अन्यतम] is not a pronoun, as it is not mentioned in the group @deva[सर्वादि] (@deva[सर्वाद्यतमसहस्रस्य गणे पठनमावात् संज्ञा] Sid. Kau.). It is, therefore, declined like nouns ending in @deva[अ].

rules.title: Pronominal Adjectives: सर्व, विश्व, उभ, उभय
rules.body:
Decline @deva[सर्व], @deva[विश्व], @deva[सम] and @deva[सिम] all having the same meaning, @deva[उभ] (declined in the dual only) and @deva[उभय] (which has no dual according to Kaiyata and other grammarians) both meaning 'both,' @deva[इतर] and @deva[एकतर] 'one of two,' like @deva[यद्] except in the Nom. and Acc. sing. of the neu. which is formed by adding @deva[म्], e. g.

rules.title: स्व Variations: उद्दात्त and अनुदात्त Forms
rules.body: **Obs:**—@deva[स्व] and @deva[स्व] (the 10th and 11th @deva[सर्वादिगणs]) the one @deva[उद्दात्त] (uddātta), the other @deva[अनुदात्त] (anudātta), both synonyms of @deva[अन्य] are declined like @deva[सर्व]. The former is of the form @deva[स्वत्] according to some and then it is declined regularly by adding the terminations; e. g. @deva[स्वत् स्वतौ स्वतः] Nom. &c.

rules.title: स्व as Pronoun: Optional Forms
अन्तर as Pronoun: Optional Declension
द्वेष (Half): Optional Declension
rules.body: @deva[द्वेष] meaning 'half' is a pronoun, but it is optionally declined like @deva[राम] in the Nom. plu. mas.; in other respects it is declined like @deva[सर्व].

rules.title: Directional Pronouns: पूर्व, अपर, दक्षिण, उत्तर, अधर
Numerals: एक and द्वि
rules.body:
@deva[एक] when a numeral is declined in the sing. and @deva[द्वि] in the dual only, @deva[द्वि]. is considered as @deva[द्वि], and they are both declined like @deva[सर्व] in all the three genders; e g.

rules.title: Meanings of एक
Optional Pronominal Nominative Forms
rules.body:
@deva[प्रथम], @deva[चरम], @deva[अल्प], @deva[अर्ध], @deva[कतिपय], and words ending in the termination @deva[तय] optionally form their Nom. plu. like that of pronouns; e. g. @deva[प्रथमे-प्रथमाः], @deva[कतिपये-कतिपयाः], @deva[द्वितये-द्वितयाः] &c.

## 11—Pronominal Adverbs.

rules.title: Pronominal Adverbs: Formation and Examples
Pronominal Words in Compounds: Declension Exceptions
rules.body:
When a pronominal word is used as the subordinate member of a compound, or is at the end of an Inst. Tat., or of sentence having the sense of the Inst. Tat., or at the end of a Dwandwa, it is not declined like a pronoun[^1]; e. g. @deva[अतिक्रान्तः ये अतिसर्वेः], @deva[तस्मै अतिसर्वस्मै] and not @deva[सर्वस्मै]; so @deva[अतिकतरे कुलम् स्वप्रीय] or @deva[मासेन पुत्रस्मै] and not @deva[मासपुत्रस्मै]; @deva[वर्णाभिमेतराणां] &c. In the case of a Dwandwa comp., however, it is optionally declined like a pronoun in the Nom. plu.,[^2] as @deva[वर्णाभिमेतरै] or @deva[वर्णाभिमेतराः ।]

---

[^1]: @deva[संज्ञापूर्वंनियोगात्तु न सर्वादेः । द्वितीयातससमाधे । इन्द्रे च ॥] Pāṇ. I. 1. 30. 31.

[^2]: @deva[विभाषा द्वन्द्वे ।] Pāṇ. 1. 1 32.

[^3]: @deva[एकदशशतसहस्रायुतलक्षप्रयुतकोटयः क्रमशः । अर्बुदमब्जं खर्वनिखर्वमहापद्मशङ्कवस्तथा प्रात् ॥ जलधिरन्त्यं मध्यं पराधमिति दशगुणोत्तराः संज्ञाः । संख्यायाः स्थानानां व्यवहारार्थं कृताः पूर्वैः ॥]

rules.title: Formation of Compound Numbers
rules.body:
The cardinal numbers between @deva[विंशति] and @deva[त्रिंशत्], @deva[त्रिंशत्] and @deva[चत्वारिंशत्], it will be seen, are made up by prefixing @deva[एक], @deva[द्वि], &c. up to @deva[नवन्] to the lower. The ninth intermediate number may also be made up by prefixing @deva[एकोन], @deva[ऊन] or @deva[एकान्] to the higher. In these compounds @deva[द्वि], @deva[त्रि] and @deva[अष्ट] are changed to @deva[द्वा], @deva[त्रयः], and @deva[अष्टा] necessarily before @deva[विंशति] and @deva[त्रिंशत्], and optionally before the rest except @deva[अशीति] before which they remain unchanged.[^1]

---

[^1]: @deva[द्वात्रयः संख्यायामष्टाविंशतिभ्यः । त्रिंशत्तः । विभाषा चत्वारिंशत्प्रभृति सर्वत्र ।] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 47-49

rules.title: Expressing Numbers Between Hundreds
rules.body: The cardinal numbers between 100 and 200, 200 and 300, &c. are generally expressed by means of @deva[अधिक] added to the number showing the excess and then optionally prefixing the whole to 100, 200, &c, e. g. @deva[एकाधिक शतं] or @deva[एकाधिकशतं] 101, @deva[द्वादशाधिक शतं] or @deva[द्वादशाधिकशतं] 112, @deva[पञ्चाशदधिक शतं] 150. &c. After 1000 this @deva[अधिक] may be repeated with every multiple of ten or hundred; e. g. @deva[द्वि-द्वानवत्यधिकाष्टशताधिकसहस्र] 1892, @deva[एको-नचत्वारिंशदधिकषट्शताधिकसप्तसप्ततिसहस्राधिक लक्षय] 177639, &c. Similarly @deva[उत्तर] may also be used insted of @deva[अधिक] e. g. @deva[चतुःपञ्चा-शदुत्तरं सप्तशतम्] 754. Or these may also be, at times, expressed by the copulative particle @deva[च] as @deva[सप्त च शतानि विंशतिश्च] 720.

rules.title: Formation with Taddhita Affix अ
rules.body:
The Tad. affix @deva[अ][^1] may be used, instead of @deva[अधिक], in the case of the cardinal numbers ending in @deva[दशन्‌], the numeral @deva[विंशति] and those ending in @deva[शत्] i. e. in the case of the numerals 111-159, 211-259, 311-359, &c. and qualifying the numerals @deva[शत] and @deva[सहस्र] before which the final @deva[अन्‌], @deva[अति] and @deva[अत्] are dropped e. g. @deva[एकादशं शतम्] 111, @deva[विंशं शतं] 120, @deva[पञ्चाशं शतं] 150, @deva[सप्तदशं द्विशतं] 217, @deva[त्रिंशं त्रिशतं] 330 and so on.

---

[^1]: @deva[तदर्थेऽधिकार्थे दशान्तादु । शतसहस्रयोरेवेष्यते ।] Pāṇ. V. 2. 45. 46. @deva[शतसहस्रयोरेवेष्यते ।] Vārt.

rules.title: Formation of Ordinal Numbers
rules.body:
The ordinals from @deva[एक], @deva[द्वि], @deva[त्रि], @deva[चतुर्] and @deva[षष्][^1] are irregularly formed. The ordinal from other numerals up to @deva[दशन्] inclusive are formed by dropping the final @deva[न्] and adding @deva[म] and after @deva[दशन्] up to @deva[नवदशन्] by simply dropping the @deva[न्]. The ordinals from @deva[विंशति][^2] above are formed by adding @deva[तम] or by dropping the @deva[ति] of @deva[विंशति] and the final consonant of the rest; the compound numerals, in this latter case, change the final vowel to @deva[अ], while the simple ones ending in a vowel i. e. @deva[एका-सपति], @deva[अशीति] and @deva[नवति] form their ordinals in the first way only; as @deva[एकपशः] or @deva[एकपष्टितमः], but @deva[षष्टितम] only. @deva[शत] has invariably @deva[शततम].

---

[^1]: @deva[एककतिपयषष्टुरां युच् ।] Pāṇ. V. 2. 51; so @deva[कतिथः], @deva[चतुर्थः] &c.; '@deva[चतुर्थस्यतुरीयोऽथ पञ्चम्याम्]' Vārt. @deva[तुरीय], @deva[तुर्य । द्वितीयः । त्रेः सम्प्रसारणं च ।] Pāṇ. V. 2. 54, 55.

[^2]: @deva[विंशत्यादिभ्यस्तमडन्यतरस्याम् ।पञ्चाद्यष्टादिभ्यः ।] Pāṇ. V.3.56,58.

---

# DECLENSION OF THE NUMERALS. (CARDINALS AND ORDINALS)

rules.title: Numerals as Adjectives: Gender Agreement
rules.body: @deva[एक] (@deva[एका] fem.), @deva[द्वि] (@deva[द्वी] fem.), @deva[त्रि] (@deva[तिस्र] fem.), and @deva[चतुर्] (@deva[चतस्र] fem.), are all adjectives and takes the gender, number and case of the nouns they qualify.

rules.title: Declension of त्रि and चतुर्
rules.body:
@deva[एक] is declined in the sing. (though it may have the dual and plural also), and @deva[द्वि] in the dual alone. For further particulars see @ref[154]. @deva[त्रि] and @deva[चतुर्] are declined in the plu. alone. E. g.

@deva[त्रि] and @deva[चतुर्]

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| N. | @deva[त्रयः] | @deva[तिस्रः] | N. | @deva[चत्वारः] | @deva[चतस्रः] |
| A. | @deva[त्रीन्] | ,, | A. | @deva[चतुरः] | ,, |
| I. | @deva[त्रिभिः] | @deva[तिसृभिः] | I. | @deva[चतुर्भिः] | @deva[चतसृभिः] |
| D. Ab. | @deva[त्रिभ्यः] | @deva[तिसृभ्यः] | D. Ab. | @deva[चतुर्भ्यः] | @deva[चतसृभ्यः] |
| G. | @deva[त्रयाणाम्] | @deva[तिसृणाम्] | G. | @deva[चतुर्णाम्] | @deva[चतसृणाम्] |
| L. | @deva[त्रिषु] | @deva[तिसृषु] | L. | @deva[चतुर्षु] | @deva[चतसृषु] |

The rest like the mas.

rules.title: Declension of पञ्चन्—नवदशन्
rules.body:
@deva[पञ्चन्]—@deva[नवदशन्]. These are also adjectives agreeing in case with the nouns to which they are applied. They are declined in the pl. and are uniform in all the three genders.

| | @deva[पञ्चन्] | @deva[षष्] | @deva[अष्टन्] |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. V. A. | @deva[पञ्च] | @deva[षट्-ष्] | @deva[अष्ट] |
| I. | @deva[पञ्चभिः] | @deva[षड्भिः] | @deva[अष्टभिः-अष्टाभिः] |
| Dat. & Ab. | @deva[पञ्चभ्यः] | @deva[षड्भ्यः] | @deva[अष्टभ्यः-अष्टाभ्यः] |
| G. | @deva[पञ्चानाम्] | @deva[षण्णाम्] | @deva[अष्टानाम्] |
| L. | @deva[पञ्चसु] | @deva[षट्सु] | @deva[अष्टसु-अष्टासु] |

@deva[सप्त], @deva[नवन्] and the following cardinals up to @deva[नवदशन्] ought to be declined like @deva[पञ्चन्].

---

[^1]: @deva[त्रिस्तुरिः त्रियौ तिसृचतसृ ।] Pāṇ. VII. 2. 99.

rules.title: Declension of विंशति and Higher Cardinals
rules.body: @deva[ऊनविंशति], @deva[विंशति] and other cardinal numbers up to @deva[नवनवति] are all feminine substantives, the numerals @deva[शत], @deva[सहस्र], &c. are all neuter, with the exception of @deva[लक्ष] which is neu. and fem. @deva[कोटि] which is fem. and @deva[शङ्ख] and @deva[जलधि] both of which are mas. and have no declensional peculiarities. They are declined in the sing. and so used with a plural noun; e. g. @deva[पञ्चविंशतिब्राह्मणाः:] 25 Brāhmaṇas; @deva[एकादशाधिकशतेन] or @deva[एका-दशोत्तरेण शतेन नरैः] or @deva[स्त्रीभिः:] by 111 men or women; @deva[एकोनसहस्रेण रूप्यकैः:] with Rs. 999 &c. They may be made to have duals and plurals by being used as fixed standards of counting; e. g. @deva[ब्राह्मणानां विंशतयः:] many twenties of Brāhmaṇas; @deva[द्वे शते नारीणाम्] two hundreds of women &c.

rules.title: Declension of Ordinal Numbers
Numeral Adverbs: Frequency, Distribution, Division
rules.body:
**(a)** @deva[सकृत्] once, @deva[द्विः] twice, @deva[त्रिः] thrice, @deva[चतुः] four times; from @deva[पञ्चन्] onwards adverbs of frequency are formed by adding @deva[कृत्वः] before which final @deva[न्] is dropped e. g. @deva[पञ्चकृत्वः] five times, @deva[सप्तकृत्वः] seven times, &c.

**(b)** @deva[एकधा][^1] or @deva[ऐकध्यम्] in one way or part, @deva[द्विधा] or @deva[द्वेधा] or @deva[द्वैधं] in two ways or parts, @deva[त्रिधा] or @deva[त्रेधा] or @deva[त्रैध्यम्] in three ways, &c.; @deva[चतुर्धा] in four ways, @deva[षोढा] or @deva[षड्धा] in six ways, @deva[सप्तधा], @deva[अष्टधा], &c.

**(c)** @deva[एकशः] one by one; @deva[द्विशः] two and two, by twos; so @deva[त्रिशः] @deva[शतशः] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[संख्यायाश्च विधार्थे धा। आविःकरणावचाले च। एकाच्छो द्व्यष्टन्यतरस्याम्। द्विन्नोऽथ धञ्च्। एतञ्च] Pāṇ. V. 3. 42-46.

rules.title: Other Derivatives from Numerals
rules.body:
Other derivatives from the numerals:—

**(a)** by the Taddhita affix @deva[क] which is added to numerals ending in @deva[शत्] and @deva[ति] e. g. @deva[पञ्चक:] bought for five (rupees &c.) @deva[चत्वारिंशक:] bought for forty; @deva[विंशतिक:] bought for twenty (coins, &c.)

**(b)** by means of the Tad. affix @deva[तय] in the sense of "consisting of parts" or "collection"; e.g. @deva[चतुष्टय] (@deva[चतुष्टयी] fem.) consisting of four parts or a collection of four; so @deva[पञ्चतय] (fem. @deva[यी]); @deva[तय] is optionally changed to @deva[अय] after @deva[द्वि] and @deva[त्रि] e. g. @deva[द्वय] or @deva[द्वितय] (@deva[-यी] fem.) twofold, consisting of two parts, or a pair; @deva[त्रय] or @deva[त्रितय] (@deva[-यी] fem.) threefold or consisting of three parts, a collection of three, a triad.

**(c)** by means of @deva[क] and @deva[अय] e. g. @deva[षट्] a collection of six, @deva[पञ्चक्] collection of five, @deva[दशक्] a collection of ten, a decade, &c.

---

# Chapter VI
# DEGREE OF COMPARISON.

rules.title: Comparative and Superlative: तर and तम
Optional Shortening of ई and ऊ Before तर and तम
rules.body: Before these the final @deva[ई] and @deva[ऊ] of a prātipadika are optionally shortened, e. g. @deva[श्रीतरा] or @deva[श्रीतरा], @deva[श्रीतमा] or @deva[श्रीतमा]; @deva[धेनुतरा] (more lame) or @deva[धेनुतरा], @deva[धेनुतमा], @deva[धेनुतमा], &c.

rules.title: Forms तराम् and तमाम् with Verbs and Adverbs
Comparative ईयस् and Superlative इष्ठ
Dropping Possessive Affixes Before ईयस् and इष्ठ
rules.body:
The possessive affixes at the end of words and the affix @deva[व्] are dropped before @deva[ईयस्] and @deva[इष्ठ][^1] and then these terminations are applied subject to the above rule; e. g. @deva[मतिमत्] talented @deva[मतीयस्], @deva[मतिष्ठ]; @deva[मेधाविन्]-@deva[मेधीयस्], @deva[मेधिष्ठ]; @deva[धनिन्]-@deva[धनीयस्]-@deva[धनिष्ठ]; @deva[कवे]-@deva[कवीयस्], @deva[कविष्ठ] (@deva[आतिशयन कर्ता]); @deva[स्रोम]-@deva[स्रवीयस्], @deva[स्रविष्ठ]; so @deva[स्रजीयस्], @deva[स्रजिष्ठ] from @deva[स्रजिन्] one having a garland &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[विन्मतोर्लुक् । तुरिष्ठयेमयः-छ ।] Pāṇ. VI. 4, 154.

rules.title: Substitution of इ for अ Before ईयस् and इष्ठ
rules.body:
@deva[इ] is substituted for the @deva[अ] (short) of a base preceded by a consonant before @deva[ईयस्], @deva[इष्ठ] and the Tad. aff. @deva[इमन्] e. g.[^1]

| | Comp. | Superl. |
|---|---|---|
| @deva[कृशु] 'thin' | @deva[कृशीयस्] | @deva[कृशिष्ठ] |
| @deva[दृढ] 'strong, firm' | @deva[दृढीयस्] | @deva[दृढिष्ठ] |
| @deva[परिवृढ] 'head, chief' | @deva[परिवृढीयस्] | @deva[परिवृढिष्ठ] |
| @deva[पृथु] 'broad' | @deva[प्रथीयस्] | @deva[प्रथिष्ठ] |
| @deva[भूरि] 'much' | @deva[भूयीयस्] | @deva[भूयिष्ठ] |
| @deva[श्लक्ष्ण] 'soft' | @deva[श्लद्यीयस्] | @deva[श्लद्यिष्ठ] |

---

[^1]: @deva[इ क्तो हल्दैघ्र्ये ।] Pāṇ. VI. 4. 155.

rules.title: Irregular Comparatives and Superlatives
rules.body:
The following is an alphabetical list of the irregular comparatives and superlatives that are commonly met with:-

| Positive | Comparative | Superlative |
|---|---|---|
| @deva[अन्तिक] 'near'[^1] | @deva[नेदियस्] | @deva[नेदिष्ठ] |
| @deva[अल्प] 'little'[^2] | @deva[अल्पीयस्] | @deva[अल्पिष्ठ] |
| | @deva[कनीयस्] | @deva[कनिष्ठ] |
| @deva[बृह] 'wide'[^3] | @deva[वरीयस्] | @deva[वरिष्ठ] |
| @deva[क्षिप्र] 'quick'[^4] | @deva[क्षेपीयस्] | @deva[क्षेपिष्ठ] |
| @deva[क्षुद्र] 'mean,' 'small' | @deva[क्षोदीयस्] | @deva[क्षोदिष्ठ] |
| @deva[गुरु] 'heavy' | @deva[गरीयस्] | @deva[गरिष्ठ] |
| @deva[तृप] 'restless or anxious' } | @deva[त्रपीयस्] | @deva[त्रपिष्ठ] |
|     'satisfied'         } | | |
| @deva[दीर्घ] 'long' | @deva[द्राघीयस्] | @deva[द्राघिष्ठ] |
| @deva[दूर] 'distant' | @deva[दवीयस्] | @deva[दविष्ठ] |
| @deva[प्रशस्य] 'praiseworthy'[^5] | @deva[श्रेयस्] or @deva[ज्यायस्] | @deva[श्रेष्ठ] or @deva[ज्येष्ठ] |
| @deva[प्रिय] 'dear' | @deva[प्रेयस्] | @deva[प्रेष्ठ] |
| @deva[बहु] 'much'[^6] | @deva[भूयस्] | @deva[भूयिष्ठ] |
| @deva[बहुल] ,, | @deva[बहीयस्] | @deva[बहिष्ठ] |
| @deva[बाढ] 'firm, well' | @deva[साढीयस्] | @deva[साढिष्ठ] |
| @deva[युवन्] 'young' | @deva[कनीयस्], @deva[कनीयस्] | @deva[यविष्ठ], @deva[कनिष्ठ] |
| @deva[विपुल] 'much' | @deva[ज्यायस्] | @deva[ज्येष्ठ] |
| @deva[वृद्ध] 'old' | @deva[वर्षीयस्], @deva[ज्यायस्] | @deva[वर्षिष्ठ], @deva[ज्येष्ठ] |
| @deva[शठारक] 'great lovely' | @deva[श्रेयीयस्] | @deva[श्रेयिष्ठ] |
