Bahuvrīhi compounds are divided into two classes, @deva[समानाधिकरणबहुब्रीहि] and @deva[व्यधिकरणबहुब्रीहि].[^1]

**(a)** That is a Samānādhikaraṇa Bah. in which both the members are in apposition to each other i. e. have the same case relation when dissolved. There are six kinds of this according as the @deva[पदू] is in any one of the six oblique cases; e. g. @deva[प्राप्तं उदकं यं असौ प्राप्तोदको ग्रामः]; @deva[ऊढः रथः येन असौ ऊढरथः आनडूान्], @deva[उपहूतः पशुः यस्मै सः उपहूतपशुः कृष्णः], @deva[उद्भूतः ओदनः यस्यः सा उद्भूतोदना स्थाली], @deva[पीतं अम्बरं अस्य स पीताम्बरो हरिः], @deva[वीरः पुरुषः यस्मिन् स वीरपुरुषो ग्रामः] ।

---

[^1]: Strictly speaking this is not a division of the Bah. but an exception to the general rule. We have given it as a separate division to avoid confusion.

rules.title: Vyadhikaraṇa Bahuvrīhi
rules.body:
A Vyadhikaraṇa Bah. is that whose members are not in apposition to each other i. e. are in different cases when dissolved. A Vyadhikaraṇa Bah. is not allowed in any case except in the Genitive and the Locative:[^1] as @deva[चक्रं पाणौ यस्य स चक्रपाणिः हरिः], @deva[चन्द्रस्य इव कान्तिर्यस्य स चन्द्रकान्तिः][^2]; so @deva[पद्मगन्धः], @deva[ब्राह्मपाणिः], &c. @deva[शशिनो शंशरे यस्य असौ शशिशेखरः] &c.; but @deva[पद्मगन्धिकन्यस्य पद्मगन्धः] is not allowed.

---

[^1]: @deva[सप्तमीविशेषणे बहुव्रीहौ] Pāṇ. II. 2. 35. In a Bah. the noun in the Loc. and an adjectival word are placed first; @deva[अत एव ज्ञापकात् व्यधिकरणपदो बहुव्रीहिः] Sid.Kau.

[^2]: This is allowed by the Vārt. '@deva[सप्तम्युपमानपूर्वपदस्योत्तरपदलो-पश्च वक्तव्यः]' In a Bah. comp. the word following a noun in the Loc. or an upamānapada ( a noun denoting a standard of comparison ) is dropped; so this ought to be properly analysed as @deva[चन्द्रस्य कान्तिः चन्द्रकान्तिः चन्द्रकान्तिरिव कान्तिर्यस्य असौ चन्द्रकान्तिः] । But later grammarians, such as Vāmana, Bhaṭṭoji &c., have rejected this Vārt. altogether as of no practical value.

rules.title: तद्गुणसंविज्ञान and अतद्गुणसंविज्ञान Bahuvrīhi
rules.body: **Obs.**—The Bah. compounds are also further divided into two kinds; @deva[तद्गुणसंविज्ञानबहुव्रीहिः] and @deva[अतद्गुणसंविज्ञानबहुव्रीहिः]. That in which the sense of the attributive member is also present is called Tadguṇasaṃvijñāna. @deva[पीताम्बरं हरिमाहुय] is an instance of the first; here such a @deva[हरि] is meant as has the yellow silk garment actually on. @deva[चित्रगुं गोपं आनय] is of the other; here what is meant is herdsman only and not his variegated cows.

rules.title: Negative Particles and Prepositions in Bahuvrīhi
rules.body:
The negative particle @deva[अ] or @deva[अन्] and prepositions, may, sometimes, form Bah. compounds with substantives; the verbal derivatives used to express their sense may be optionally retained;[^1] @deva[अधिगमानः गुरः यस्य स अगुरः]; @deva[प्रपतितानि पर्णानि यस्य स प्रपर्णः] a tree with its leaves dropped; @deva[निर्गता घृणा यस्य स निर्घृणः] ruthless; @deva[उद्धृता कन्धरा यस्य स उत्कन्धरः] with the neck uplifted; @deva[विगतं जीवितं यस्य स विजीवितः] dead &c. Also @deva[अधिगमानगुरः]; @deva[प्रपतितपर्णः] &c.; @deva[आस्ति क्षीरं यस्याः सा आस्तिक्षीरा गौः] a milk-cow (where @deva[आस्ति] is an indeclinable meaning 'having').

---

[^1]: Implied by context; no specific Pāṇini reference given in the text.

rules.title: सह Compounds in Bahuvrīhi
rules.body:
The particle @deva[सह] may be compounded with a noun in the Instrumental case in a Bahuvrīhi when there is equal participation in some action; in this case @deva[सह] optionally becomes @deva[स];[^1] as @deva[पुत्रेण सह सहपुत्रः] or @deva[सपुत्रः].

**(a)** @deva[सह] remains unchanged when the compound involes a blessing but is necessarily changed to @deva[स] when followed by @deva[गो] a cow, @deva[वत्स] a calf, or @deva[हल] a plough, even when a blessing is pronounced; as @deva[स्वस्ति राज्ञे सहपुत्राय], @deva[सहभ्रात्राय], &c.; @deva[सगवे], @deva[सवत्साय], @deva[सहलाय].

---

[^1]: @deva[तेन सहेति तुल्ययोगे] Pāṇ. II. 2. 28. @deva[गोवत्सजनस्य] । @deva[पञ्च्याशिषि] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 82-83. @deva[अगोवत्सहलेक्षिति वाच्यम्] Vārt. The restriction @deva[तुल्ययोगे] is not universal as there are instances in which there is no equal participation; e. g. @deva[सक्रन्दक], @deva[सकोलक], @deva[सपक्षक] &c.; hence the Vrittikāra remarks-'@deva[प्रायिकं तुल्ययोगे इति विशेषणमत्यन्तापि समासो दृश्यते]' Dikshita also says @deva[तुल्ययोगाऽवधने प्रायिकम्]'

rules.title: Numeral and Indeclinable Bahuvrīhi Compounds
rules.body:
A compound of an indeclinable or a numeral or of @deva[आह्], @deva[स], @deva[अहर्] or @deva[अधिक] with a numeral is a Bahuvrīhi.[^1] In the formation of such compounds the final vowel except that of @deva[बहु] and @deva[गण], or the final consonant with the preceding vowel of the latter numeral and the @deva[स्थिति] of @deva[विंशति][^2] are dropped and @deva[अ] added; @deva[दशानां समीपे ये सन्ति ते उपदशाः] 'about ten' i. e. nine or eleven; @deva[द्वौ वा त्रयो वा त्रिद्वाः] 'two or three'; @deva[द्वे वा त्रीणि वा त्रिद्वाणि]; @deva[द्विः आवृत्ता दश द्विदशाः] 'ten repeated twice i. e. twenty; so @deva[त्रिदशाः] &c., @deva[विंशतेः आसन्नाः आसन्नविंशाः] 'nearly twenty', @deva[त्रिंशतः अदूराः अदूरत्रिंशाः] 'not far from thirty', @deva[अधिकचत्वारिंशाः] 'more than forty'; but @deva[उपचत्वः], @deva[उपचत्वाः].[^3] @deva[चतुर] preceded by @deva[उप] or @deva[त्रि] does not drop any letter but simply has an @deva[अ] added to it; @deva[त्रयो वा चत्वारो वा त्रिचतुराः], @deva[चतुर्णां समीपे ये सन्ति ते उपचतुराः].

---

[^1]: @deva[संख्यायाऽव्ययासन्नदूराधिकसंख्याः संख्येये] Pāṇ. II. 2. 25.

[^2]: @deva[बहुव्रीहौ संख्येये डजबहुगणात्] । @deva[त्रिविशतोऽक्षति] Pāṇ. V. 4. 75, VI. 4. 142. @deva[उपाख्यायां चतुरोऽजिन्यते] Vārt. under Pāṇ. V. 4. 77. (see art. @ref[284] ).

[^3]: @deva[अत्र हरे विशेषः] Sid. Kau. (for the form is the same in both cases.)

rules.title: Directional Bahuvrīhi Compounds
rules.body:
Names of directions may form a Bahuvrīhi compound and signify the point of direction between them;[^1] @deva[दक्षि-णस्याः पूर्वस्याश्च दिशोऽन्तरालं दक्षिणपूर्वा]; so @deva[उत्तरपूर्वा], &c. But if the words so compounded are not the names of quarters, no compound is possible; as @deva[ऐन्द्याश्च कौबेर्याश्चान्तरालं विन्दु] the point between the East and the North, and not @deva[ऐन्द्रकौबेरी] as these are not the names of the Eastern and Northern quarters.

---

[^1]: @deva[दिङ्नामान्यन्तराले] Pāṇ. II. 2. 26.

rules.title: Phonological Changes at End of Bahuvrīhi
rules.body:
The following words drop their final vowel or the final consonant with the preceding vowel and take @deva[अ] when at the end of a Bah. compound:—

**(a)** @deva[अक्षि] and @deva[सक्थि] 'both meaning parts of the body';[^1] @deva[जलजवत् अक्षिणी यस्य स जलजाक्षः] 'one whose eyes are like lotuses'; @deva[दीर्घे सक्थिनी यस्य स दीर्घसक्थः] 'one having long thighs', 'spindlelegged'; @deva[कमले इव अक्षिणी यस्याः सा कमलाक्षी] (@deva[स्त्री]); but @deva[दीर्घसक्थिय शकटम्] 'a cart with long poles'; @deva[रखलासा वेणुपात्री] 'a bamboo stick with big eyelike holes'; (where @deva[अ] is added by @ref[282] (c). and hence the feminine ends in @deva[आ]; see N. B. For @deva[सक्थिय] see also (e) below.

**N. B.** The fem. of Bah. compounds ending in @deva[अम्] is formed by adding @deva[आ] when it qualifies an inanimate object.

**(b)** @deva[अङ्गुलि], when the compound is an attribute of @deva[द्राख्];[^2] @deva[पञ्च अङ्गुलयो यस्य तत्पञ्चाङ्गुलं दारु] (@deva[अङ्गुलिसङ्ख्यावयवं यान्यादिविशेषणकाष्ठम्]); but @deva[पञ्चाङ्गुलिः हस्तः] the hand having five fingers.

**(c)** The words @deva[मूर्धन्] preceded by @deva[द्वि] or @deva[त्रि], @deva[लोमन्] preceded by @deva[अन्त्] and @deva[बहि], and @deva[नेतृ] used in apposition to the name of a constellation of stars;[^3] @deva[द्वौ मूर्धनौ यस्य स द्विमूर्धः] two-headed; @deva[त्रिमूर्धः] but @deva[द्वामूर्धनी]; @deva[अन्तर्लोमः]; @deva[बहिर्लोमः], @deva[मृगो नेता यासां ताः मृगनेत्रा रात्रयः] 'nights of which the Mṛiga constellation is the leader' i.e. 'whose position in the heavens marks their advance,' so @deva[पुष्यनेत्राः] &c.

**(d)** Feminine words ending in a termination showing 'a complement of,' and the word @deva[प्रमाणी];[^4] e. g. @deva[कल्याणी पञ्चमी यासा रात्रीणी ताः कल्याणीपञ्चमा रात्रयः]; 'nights whose complement is an auspicious fifth night.' @deva[स्त्री प्रमाणी यस्य असौ स्त्रीप्रमाणः] 'one whose authority is a woman.'

**(e)** @deva[हलि] and @deva[सक्थिय] optionally become @deva[हल] and @deva[सक्थय] when preceded by @deva[अ], @deva[इस] or @deva[ह];[^5] @deva[अहलः-लिः] having no plough; @deva[असक्थयः-द्विऊः] 'one who has no thighs,' @deva[दुःसक्थयः द्विऊः] 'one having deformed thighs'; @deva[द्वसक्थय:-द्विऊः]; &c. @deva[शक्ति] is another reading for @deva[सक्थि] in the sūtra; so @deva[अशक्ः-क्तिः]; &c.

**(f)** @deva[प्रजा] and @deva[मेधा] under similar circumstances drop their @deva[आ] and take @deva[अस्];[^6] as @deva[अविद्यमाना प्रजा यस्य अस्तो अप्रजाः] having no progeny, @deva[दुष्टा प्रजा यस्य स दुष्प्रजाः] having bad progeny, @deva[शोभना मेधा यस्य स सुमेधाः] of good intellect; similarly @deva[दुर्मेधाः], @deva[अमेधाः].

---

[^1]: @deva[बहुव्रीहौ सक्थ्यक्ष्णोः स्वाङ्गत्वच्] Pāṇ. V. 4. 113.

[^2]: @deva[अङ्गुलेर्दाक्षिणि] Pāṇ. V. 4. 114.

[^3]: @deva[द्विमूर्ध्यौ च सूर्यं] । @deva[अन्तर्बहिर्भ्यां च लोमः] Pāṇ. V. 4. 115, 117. @deva[नेतृनक्षत्रे अव्यतव्यः] Vart.

[^4]: @deva[अप्पूरणीप्रमाण्योः] Pāṇ. V. 4. 116.

[^5]: @deva[नजदुःसुभ्यो हलिसक्थ्योरन्यतरस्याम्] Pāṇ. V. 4. 121. @deva[शकटादिति पाठान्तरम्] Sid. Kau.

[^6]: @deva[नित्यमस्त्रिच् प्रजामेधयोः] Pāṇ. V. 4. 122.

rules.title: Transformations of धर्म, धनुस्, जम्भ, and इर्म
rules.body:
**(a)** @deva[धर्म] when preceded by a single member in a Bahuvrīhi becomes @deva[धर्मन्];[^1] @deva[कल्याणी धर्मः यस्य स कल्याणधर्मा]; similarly @deva[समानधर्मी] ( see Māl. Māḍ. Act. I Intro. ); but @deva[परमः स्वः धर्म यस्य स परमस्वधर्मा]; @deva[परस्परधर्मी] may also be correct if @deva[परस्पर] be regarded as one word compounded in a Karmadhāraya. @deva[संहिष्णुतात्पर्यधर्मी], @deva[तिलुचिषधर्मी], @deva[अत्रनिष्ठतिधर्मी] are to be similarly explained.

**(b)** @deva[धनुस्] at the end of a Bah. becomes @deva[धन्वन्], as @deva[अजिज्यं धनुरस्य स अजिज्यधन्वा] 'one whose bow is strung'; so @deva[शार्ङ्गधन्वा] ( @deva[शृङ्गस्य इदं शार्ङ्गं] ) 'one whose bow is made of horn'; i. e. the god Vishṇu. This change is optional when the whole compound is a name; @deva[शातधन्वा-धुः].

**(c)** Similarly @deva[जन्भ] 'a tooth,' 'food,' &c. becomes @deva[जन्भन्] when preceded by @deva[शु], @deva[हरित], @deva[शुभ्र] or @deva[सोम]; as @deva[शोभनः जन्भः अस्य शुजन्भा] one having beautiful teeth; similarly @deva[हरितजन्भा] m.; @deva[पूर्णं भक्ष्यं यस्य], @deva[हृण्यमिव दन्ता यस्येति वा पूर्णजन्भा], @deva[सोमजन्भा] one whose food is the holy soma juice; but @deva[पतितजन्भाः].

**(d)** The word @deva[इर्म] n. a wound, preceded by @deva[दक्षिण] becomes @deva[इर्मन्] when the wound is inflicted by a hunter; @deva[दक्षिणे इर्म यस्य दक्षिणेर्मा हरः] a stag wounded on the right side by a hunter. See Bhaṭṭi VI. 44.

---

[^1]: @deva[धर्मादिनिचु केवलात्] Pāṇ. V. 4. 124. @deva[धनुरप्रच्] । @deva[अः सञ्ज्ञायाम्] । @deva[जम्भा शुहरितशुभ्रसोमेभ्यः] । @deva[दक्षिणेर्मा लुब्धयोगे] Pāṇ. V. 4. 132, 133, 125, 126.

rules.title: Transformations of जानु, जाया, गन्ध, and नासिका
rules.body:
At the end of a Bah. compound—

**(a)** @deva[जानु] is changed to @deva[ञु] necessarily when preceded by @deva[प्र] or @deva[सम्] and optionally when preceded by @deva[उच्चै];[^1] @deva[प्रजत्ते जानुनी यस्य स प्रञ्नुः] 'one having the knees wide apart' i. e. 'bandylegged;' @deva[सञ्नुः] 'one having well-turned or beautiful knees,' @deva[उर्चैर्जानुः—ञुः] 'long-shanked.'

**(b)** @deva[जाया] becomes @deva[जानि];[^2] @deva[युवती जाया यस्य स युवजानिः] 'one whose wife is young;' @deva[भूजानिः] lit. 'one whose wife is the earth, i. e. a king,' &c.

**(c)** @deva[गन्ध] becomes @deva[गन्धि] when preceded by @deva[उत्], @deva[प्रति] or @deva[दुः];[^3] @deva[उद्दतः गन्धः यस्य स उद्गन्धिः] 'whose smell is spread above,' @deva[प्रतिगन्धिः] 'having a repulsive smell,' @deva[दुर्गन्धिः]. This change of @deva[गन्ध] is possible only when the smell referred to is inseparably connected with ( looks like a part and parcel of ) the object denoted by the other member; as @deva[दुर्गन्धि पुष्करं सन्निहं च] ( which receives its odour from the lotuses &c. growing in it; ) @deva[दुर्गन्धिवारिहः]; but @deva[शोभना गन्धा अस्य इति गन्ध आपणिकः] 'a perfumer dealing in sweet smells.' @deva[गन्ध] is also changed to @deva[गन्धि][^4] when it means 'a particle of,' 'a little of,' or when the compound involves comparison; @deva[सुरस्य गन्धः परिमन्द तत् सृणगन्धि भोजनम्]; so @deva[सृतगन्धि] a dinner in which there is a scanty supply of ghee, &c.; @deva[पद्मस्य इव गन्धः यस्य तत् पद्मगन्धि] 'that which has the smell of a lotus.'

**(d)** @deva[नासिका] becomes @deva[नस] when it is preceded by a preposition or when the compound is used as a distinguishing name and it is preceded by any word except @deva[स्थूल];[^5] @deva[उन्नता नासिका यस्य स उन्नसः] 'one having a prominent nose,' @deva[प्रणसः] 'one having a good nose,' @deva[द्रुरिव नासिका यस्य द्रुणसः][^6] 'one whose nose is like a tree,' 'large-nosed;' but @deva[स्थूलनासिकः]. @deva[नस] becomes @deva[नष्] optionally when preceded by @deva[खुर] or @deva[खर]; as @deva[खुरणसः] or @deva[खुरणषः] 'having a nose like a horse's hoof i. e. flat;' @deva[खरणसः-णषः] 'sharp-nosed.' @deva[नासिका] when preceded by @deva[वि] becomes @deva[ञ] or @deva[ष्ण]; as @deva[विगता नासिका यस्य स विञः] or @deva[विष्णुः] 'one having a deformed nose.'

---

[^1]: @deva[प्रसंभ्यां जानुनोर्ञुः] । @deva[उच्चैर्दिभाषा] Pāṇ. V. 4. 129, 130.

[^2]: @deva[जायाया निङ्] Pāṇ. V. 4. 134. @deva[स्त्रियो भोटर्जिति] Pāṇ. VI. 1. 66. @deva[जाया] at the end of a Bah. substitutes @deva[नि] for its final @deva[आ]. The preceding @deva[न्] or @deva[त्] is dropped before a consonant except @deva[य्].

[^3]: @deva[गन्धस्येदुतिदुर्भ्यांश्चः] Pāṇ. V. 4. 135. @deva[गन्धस्येवेति तत्कालस्यग्रहणम्] Vārt. There is a difference of opinion among critics as to the meaning of the Vārt.. @deva[गन्धस्य] &c. Some hold that the smell must be the natural property of a thing to necessitate the final @deva[च]. Cf. Jayamaṅgala on Bhaṭṭi. @deva[आत्मविद्यान्यन्यवद्धः दुर्गन्धः] &c. II. 10, and Mallinatha on Rag. IV. 46. But the view of such eminent grammarians as Kaiyaṭa, Bhaṭṭoji, Nagesha, &c. is as given above.

[^4]: @deva[अल्पाख्यायाम्] । @deva[उपमानाच्च] Pāṇ. V. 4. 136-137.

[^5]: @deva[अत्र नासिकाया संज्ञायां नसं चाशक्लात्] । @deva[उत्सर्गोऽन्यत्र] Pāṇ. V. 4. 118. 119. @deva[वक्षौ वक्तव्यः] । @deva[स्थूलञ्च] Vārtikas.

[^6]: @deva[वृक्षपलाशंज्ञायामन्यः] । @deva[उत्सर्गादिहुलम्] Pāṇ. VIII. 4. 3. 28.

rules.title: Loss of Final Vowel: पाद, दन्त, कङ्कुद्, काकुद्
rules.body:
The following words lose their final vowel when at the end of a Bahuvrihi:-

**(a)** The word @deva[पाद] when it is preceded by a numeral or @deva[सु] or when the compound involves comparison and it is not preceded by a word of the @deva[इस्त्यादि] group (@deva[इस्तिन्], @deva[अज], @deva[कुरुल], @deva[अम्भ], @deva[कपोत], @deva[जाल], @deva[मण्ड], @deva[दासी], @deva[गणिका] and some others).[^1] @deva[द्वौ पादौ यस्य द्विपाद्] a biped; @deva[सुपद्] fair-footed; (@deva[व्याघ्रस्य इव पादौ यस्य],) &c. but @deva[इस्तिपादः], @deva[कुरुलपादः], &c.

**(b)** @deva[पाद] becomes @deva[पद्] and the comp. takes @deva[ई] in the fem. in the case of the words @deva[कुम्भपदी], and others (i. e. @deva[कुम्भपदी], @deva[एकपदी], @deva[जालपदी], @deva[क्षुरपदी], @deva[शतपदी], @deva[विपदी], @deva[द्विपदी], @deva[त्रिपदी], @deva[दासीपदी], @deva[विष्णुपदी], @deva[सुपदी], &c.;)[^2] but @deva[कुम्भपादः] mas.

**(c)** @deva[दन्त] necessarily when it is preceded by a numeral or @deva[स्व] indicating age, or when the whole compound forms a feminine name, and optionally when it is preceded by @deva[श्याम], @deva[भसोड], a word ending in @deva[अम्], @deva[छन्द], @deva[छम्न], @deva[दर्व], or @deva[चराह];[^3] @deva[द्वी दन्तो यस्य स द्विदन्त्] 'a child so small as to have two teeth only,' @deva[बड् दन्ता अस्य] । @deva[पाडन्त्]; @deva[शोभना दन्ता अस्य छन्दर्], @deva[छदन्तो] (i.e. youthful) fem; but @deva[द्विदन्तः कती], @deva[सुदन्तः] (having beautiful teeth) @deva[पृहर्व]; @deva[अयोदन्ती], @deva[फलदन्ती] (both proper names,) &c. but @deva[समदन्ती] having even rows of teeth; @deva[श्यामा] (black) @deva[दन्ता यस्य स शाम्बदन्-न्त]; @deva[अरोकदन्-दन्त] having black or thick-set teeth; @deva[कुमुडलाग्रदन्-न्त] having teeth like the points of buds; @deva[शुभ्रदन्-न्त] &c.

**(d)** @deva[कङ्कुद्] 'when the compound denotes a particular stage of growth;'[^4] @deva[अजातं कङ्कुद् यस्य सः अजातकङ्कुद्] 'a bull that has not got his hump as yet' i.e. 'who is very young'; also when it is preceded by @deva[त्रि] and the compound designates the mountain of that name; as @deva[त्रिकङ्कुद्] 'name of a mountain with three peaks'; but @deva[त्रिकङ्कुदः] 'having three humps'.

**(e)** @deva[काकुद्] 'the palate' (@deva[काकुदं तालु] Kās.) necessarily when preceded by @deva[उन्] and @deva[त्रि] and optionally when preceded by @deva[पृणी];[^5] as @deva[उत्काकुद्], @deva[त्रिकाकुद्]; @deva[पृणीकाकुद्-कुट्].

---

[^1]: @deva[पादस्य लोपोऽकस्त्यादिभ्यः] । @deva[संख्यायाः पूर्वत्व] Pāṇ. V. 4. 138. 140.

[^2]: @deva[कुम्भपद्यृु च] Pāṇ. V. 4. 139.

[^3]: @deva[न्यापि दन्तस्य वृद्] । @deva[स्त्रियां संज्ञायाम्] । @deva[विभाषा श्यामाशोकाभ्याम्] । @deva[अमान्तछन्दछम्नचराहैश्चमत्र] Pāṇ. V. 4. 141. 143-145.

[^4]: @deva[कङ्कुदस्याजातख्यायां लोपः] । @deva[त्रिकङ्कुदर्वते] Pāṇ. V. 4. 146, 147. See Foot-note p. 102.

[^5]: @deva[उद्त्रिभ्यां काकुदस्य पृणीत्रिभाषा] Pāṇ. V. 4. 148,149.

rules.title: Transformation of हृदय
Combat Compounds with Vowel Changes
rules.body:
Two nouns alike in from in the Loc. and meaning 'something that can be seized,' or in the Instrumental, meaning 'weapons or things used as weapons,' may be compounded in a Bah. when the sense is 'the fight thus began' and the idea of an exchange of action is to be implied.[^1] In such compounds the final vowel of the first member is lengthened and that of the second is changed to @deva[इ]. The compounds so formed are of the nature of Avyayîbhâvas and are indeclinable. The final @deva[इ] takes Guna substitute before the final @deva[इ].[^2] e. g. @deva[केशोइ केशोइ युधि स्वैर्यं युध्दं प्रवृत्तं केशाकेशि] 'a battle in which the warriors fight seizing each other's hair'; @deva[दण्डेश्व दण्डेश्व प्रहरत्येषं युध्दं प्रवृत्तं दण्डादण्डि]; similarly @deva[मुष्टीमुष्टि], @deva[हस्ताहस्ति], @deva[बाहुबाहवि], @deva[हस्तलाहस्तलि], &c.; but if the instruments used by both the parties be not the same, no compound is possible; @deva[हस्ताखड्गि] will, therefore, be wrong.

**Obs.**—**(a)** The following words also change their final to @deva[इ]; @deva[द्वौ दण्डौ यस्मिन्प्रहरणे तद् द्विदण्डि]; similarly @deva[द्विमुसलि], @deva[उमा-उमया सलि], @deva[उमाहरिन्], @deva[उन्यहरिन्], @deva[उमा-उमया-पाणि], @deva[शाह्वु] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[तत्र तमेदमिति सप्तम्ये] Pân II. 2. 27. @deva[सप्तम्यन्ते प्रहरणविषये सप्त्म्यन्ते च प्रहरणविषये इदं युद्धं प्रवत्तमित्येवं समर्थेते कर्मव्यतिहारे घोरौ स बहुव्रीहिः] Sid. Kau.

[^2]: @deva[अन्येषामपि दृश्यते] । @deva[इचु कर्मव्यतिहारे] Pân. VI. 3. 137. V. 4. 127. @deva[तिङश्च प्रतिषेध्यस्यव्यस्य पादादुपसंख्यानमुत्तरं च] Sid. Kau. @deva[ओर्गुणः] Pân. VI. 4. 146.

rules.title: Irregular Bahuvrīhi Forms
rules.body:
The following Bahuvrîhis are laid down as irregular.[^1] @deva[शोभनं प्रातरस्य सुप्रातः] m. 'one having an auspicious morning or a day having an auspicious dawn'; see Bhattî. II. 49. @deva[शोभनं श्वः अस्य सुश्वः] 'having an auspicious morrow;' @deva[शोभनं दिवास्य सुदिवः] 'one who has passed a happy day', @deva[शारीरिक कुक्षितस्य शारिकुक्षः] 'having a round belly;' @deva[चतुरश्रयोरस्य चतुरश्र] 'four-cornered, quadrangular,' @deva[एण्या] (of a female black deer) @deva[इव पादौ अस्य एणीपद्] @deva[अजपद्], @deva[गोष्स्य इव पादौ अस्य गोष्पद्] 'having the feet like those of a bull'.

---

[^1]: @deva[शुप्रातश्वब्दिवशारिकुक्षश्चतुरश्रेणीपाजनपक्षगोष्पदः] Pāṇ. V. 4. 120.

rules.title: Addition of क to Specific Words in Bahuvrīhi
rules.body:
The words @deva[उरस्], @deva[सर्पिस्], @deva[अपनह्], @deva[द्वि], @deva[त्रि], @deva[शालि-ली] and @deva[संध्], @deva[गन्धहु], @deva[पत्], @deva[गो] and @deva[लक्ष्मी] when used in the singular, have a @deva[क] added to them, when they form the latter member of a Bah. comp.;[^1] @deva[उरुक] (expanded, well-developed) @deva[उरः यस्य उरुकोरस्कः], @deva[सिप्रसर्पिकः] 'one fond of ghee', &c. @deva[एकः उद्गात् यस्य असौ एकुद्गातृकः] 'having one man only', &c.; when @deva[द्वि] and the words following it are used in the dual and the plural they take @deva[क] optionally. @deva[द्विशालक] or @deva[द्विशालः] &c.

**(a)** @deva[अर्थ] takes the final @deva[क], necessarily when preceded by @deva[अन] and optionally in any other case;[^2] @deva[अनर्थकः] 'useless'; but @deva[अपार्थ-र्थकः] 'meaningless' @deva[बच्चः].

---

[^1]: @deva[उरःसर्पिभ्यः कुप्] Pāṇ. V. 4. 151. @deva[द्वि त्र्यादि अनहुव्], @deva[पत्], @deva[गो लक्ष्मीति एकवचनान्तानि पश्यन्ते] । @deva[द्विवचना·न्तेभ्यस्तु] '@deva[शेषाद्विभाषा]' @deva[इति विकल्पेन कुप्] Sid. Kau.

[^2]: @deva[अपार्थकाः] Vārtika.

rules.title: क for Feminine Bahuvrīhi Ending in इन्
rules.body:
A fem. Bah. ending in @deva[इन्] takes this @deva[क] necessarily;[^1] as @deva[बहुतपस्विका नगरी] 'a city having many ascetics'; @deva[बहुवाग्मिका सभा] 'an assembly having many eloquent speakers in it'; but @deva[बहुदण्डी] or @deva[बहुदण्डिको ग्रामः] (vide @ref[263] below), as it is mas.

---

[^1]: @deva[इनः स्त्रियाम्] Pāṇ. V. 4. 152.

rules.title: General Optional क for Bahuvrīhi
rules.body:
And as a general rule, when the final word of a Bah. comp. does not undergo any additions or alterations mentioned in the foregoing rules, it optionally takes the affix @deva[क].[^1] @deva[महायशस्कः=महायशाः] 'of mighty glory'; but @deva[उत्तरपूर्वी], @deva[व्याघ्रपाद्], @deva[छगलिकः] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[शेषाद्विभाषा] Pāṇ. V. 4. 154.

rules.title: Mandatory क for Certain Feminine Endings
rules.body:
But if the last word of a Bah. compound be a fem. noun ending in @deva[ई] or @deva[ऊ] not capable of being changed into @deva[इन्] or @deva[उन्] before the vowel case termination, or if it ends in @deva[आ], @deva[क] is necessarily affixed; @deva[ईश्वरः क्षमा यस्य तत् ईश्वरक्षमक जगत्], @deva[बहुवर्णको देशः], @deva[रूपवती वधूः यस्य स रूपवधूकः], &c.; but @deva[सुधी] @deva[स्त्री] is an exception; @deva[बहुस्त्रीकः], @deva[सस्त्रीकः] &c.

---

[^1]: Implied by context and previous rules; see @deva[उरःसर्पिभ्यः कुप्] Pāṇ. V. 4. 151, @deva[इनः स्त्रियाम्] Pāṇ. V. 4. 152, @deva[शेषाद्विभाषा] Pāṇ. V. 4. 154.

rules.title: Shortening आ before क
rules.body: The final @deva[आ] is optionally shortened before @deva[क्]; as @deva[बहुमाक्षः-मालाक्षः-मालकः], &c.

rules.title: Exceptions Where क Is Not Affixed
rules.body:
No @deva[क] is affixed[^1]

**(a)** when the whole compound is used as a name or when it ends in @deva[ईश्वर], as @deva[विश्वे देवा यस्य विश्वेदेवः] 'whose deities are the Viswadevas'; @deva[बहवः भेयार्याः यस्य बहुभेयार्य]. A Bah. ending in @deva[ईश्वर] f. (i. e. @deva[ईश्वरी][^2]) does not shorten its final vowel; e. g. @deva[बहवः श्रेयस्यो यस्य बहुश्रेयसीः] 'one having many excellent wives.' But @deva[अतिश्रेयसीः] as a Tatpurusha.

**(b)** to the word @deva[भ्रातृ] preceded by a term of praise; @deva[प्रशस्तो भ्राता यस्य स प्रशस्तभ्राता]; but @deva[मूर्खभ्रातृकः] one whose brother is a fool.

**(c)** to the words @deva[नाडि] and @deva[तन्त्री] both referring to the body of an animal; @deva[बहुनाडिः कायः] 'the body having many arteries'; @deva[बहुत-न्त्रीग्रीवा] 'the many-veined neck'; but @deva[बहुनाडीकः स्तम्भः] 'a pillar with many ornamental lines'; @deva[बहुतन्त्रीका] (many-stringed) @deva[वीणा].

**(d)** to the final of the compound @deva[निष्प्रवापिः] (@deva[निर्गता प्रवाणी] 'a weaver's shuttle' @deva[यस्य]) @deva[पटः] 'a new, unbleached garment.'

**(e)** to compounds formed according to rules @ref[251], @ref[252], and @ref[253], as @deva[सपुथः], @deva[उपवहवः], @deva[दक्षिणपूर्वी], &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[आपोऽन्यतरस्याम्] Pāṇ. VII. 4. 15.

[^2]: @deva[न संज्ञायाम्] । @deva[ईश्वरस्थ] । @deva[बन्धिते भ्रातुः] । @deva[नाडीतन्त्र्योः स्वाङ्गे] । @deva[निष्प्रवापिश्च] Pāṇ. V. 4. 155-57, 159-60. @deva[ईश्वरो बहुव्रीहेरिति वाच्यम्]

rules.title: Masculine Restoration in समानाधिकरण Bahuvrīhi
rules.body:
In the formation of a @deva[समानाधिकरणबहुव्रीहि], if the first member be a fem. noun derived from the mas. the affix @deva[आ] or @deva[ई], the mas. is restored if followed by another fem. noun[^1]; @deva[विद्या गावः यस्य स विद्यगुः]; @deva[जरती गौः यस्य स जरद्गुः], @deva[रूपवती भार्या यस्य स रूपवद्भार्यः]; but @deva[गंगा भार्या यस्य स गंगाभार्यः]; @deva[शारदोत्सार्यः]; @deva[कल्याणी प्रजावै यस्य स कल्याणीप्रजावानः] ।

**Exception:**—**(a)** This change in the first member does not take place, when it is followed by an ordinal ( fem. ) or any of the words @deva[प्रिया], @deva[सनोज्ञा], @deva[कल्याणी], @deva[सुभगा], @deva[भक्ति], @deva[सविता], @deva[सखा], @deva[कान्ता], @deva[शान्ता], @deva[समा], @deva[पुत्रा], @deva[दुहिता], @deva[नाभा], @deva[अबला] and @deva[तनया]; as @deva[कल्याणी प्रिया], @deva[अन्त स कल्याणीप्रियः] 'one to whom a virtuous woman is dear.' @deva[अत्र भक्तिरेव स ततामतिः], but @deva[सृत भक्तिरेव ततमतिः]।[^2]

**(b)** If the first member be a proper name, an ordinal number, name of a limb of the body of an animal ending @deva[ई], name of a class, or a word having a penultimate @deva[इ] in a few cases, it does not undergo this change: @deva[दुर्गा] (a proper name) @deva[मातरं यत्र स], @deva[दुर्गा-मातरं], @deva[पञ्चमीमातरं], @deva[षष्ठेहीमातरं], @deva[शूद्रमातरं], @deva[पतिकामातरं], @deva[पाणिकामातरं], &c.; but @deva[अहीश्वर मातरं यत्र स अहीश्वमातरं] as the first word does not end in @deva[ई]; @deva[पाजा मातरं यत्र स पाजमातरं] &c.

---

## IV. AVYAYĪBHĀ'VA OR THE ADVERBIAL COMPOUNDS.

---

[^1]: @deva[स्त्रियाः पुंवद्भाषितपुंस्काद्नूङ् समानाधिकरणे स्त्रियामपूरणीप्रियाधिभिः] Pāṇ VI. 3. 34.

[^2]: @deva[शीलविद्यावतां स ईदृशमतिः] Sid. Kau. @deva[विद्वद्वेदविदुषां स ईदृशमतिरित्यादि-सिद्धेऽपि यियमिद् भक्तियुक्त-पाठ] Th.

rules.title: Definition of Avyayībhāva
rules.body: An Avyayībhāva comp. consists of two members the first of which is, in most cases, an indeclinable (a preposition or an adverb) and the second a noun, the whole being treated like the Nom. sing. of ses. nouns. the comp. so formed is indeclinable; e. g. @deva[आदिहरि] 'in Hari'; @deva[अन्ताद्रि] 'in a mountain,' &c.

rules.title: Formation Rules for Avyayībhāva
rules.body:
In forming the Avyayībhāva compounds the following rules should be observed:—

**(a)** The final long vowel is shortened, and the ending @deva[इ] or @deva[ई] is changed to @deva[य] and @deva[ओ] to @deva[उ]; @deva[गोपावति भाः पातीति वा गोपः] । @deva[तस्मिन्निति भक्तियोगः], @deva[भगविष्णु] after Vishṇu, @deva[उपगु] near a cow, &c.

**(b)** The final @deva[त्] of mas. and fem. nouns in @deva[अत्] is dropped; and optionally that of neuter nouns ending in @deva[अत्];[^1] @deva[उपराजत्]; @deva[उपब्रह्मत्-सं].

**(c)** @deva[अ] is optionally substituted for the final of @deva[नदी], @deva[पौर्णमासती], @deva[आग्रहायणी] and @deva[गिरि];[^2] @deva[उपनक्षत्र-दि], @deva[उपर्पौर्णमासम्-सि], @deva[उपाग्रहायणम्-णि] 'near to the full-moon day of Mārgas'īrsha'; @deva[उपगिरम्-रि].

**(d)** It is also optionally added to all nouns ending in any of the first four letters of a class;[^3] @deva[उपक्षत्रियम्-यित्].

**(e)** @deva[अ] is attached to the final of the following nouns when compoundedin an Avyaya.[^4]:—@deva[हारद्], @deva[विपाश्], @deva[भगस्], @deva[मनस्], @deva[उपनह्], @deva[अनडुह्], @deva[द्विप्], @deva[हिमवत्], @deva[द्विगु्], @deva[हरि], @deva[विशु्], @deva[चेतस्], @deva[चतुर्] @deva[तड्], @deva[यड्], @deva[कियत्], @deva[जरस्] (substituted for @deva[जरा]) &c; @deva[हारदः समीपम् उपहारदम्], @deva[प्रतिवि-पाशम्], 'towards the Vipāśā,' @deva[दिशोर्मध्ये अपदिशम्] between two divisions of the compass, @deva[उपजरसम्] towards old age, @deva[अध्यात्मम्] on the soul, &c.; and to @deva[आदि] when preceded by @deva[प्रति], @deva[परि] changed to @deva[परो], @deva[सम्] and @deva[अनु], the @deva[इ] of @deva[आदि] being dropped; @deva[अक्षणः प्रति प्रत्यक्षम्] before one's eyes; @deva[अक्षण परे परोक्षम्] out of sight; @deva[समक्षम्], and @deva[अन्वक्षम्] afterwards, forthwith.

---

[^1]: @deva[अनङ्] । @deva[नपुंसकस्त्वन्यतरस्याम्] Pāṇ. V. 4 108, 109.

[^2]: @deva[नदीपौर्णमास्याग्रहायणीभ्यः] । @deva[गिरेश्च सेनकस्य] Pāṇ. V. 4. 110,112.

[^3]: @deva[शून्यः] Pāṇ. V. 4. 111.

[^4]: @deva[अव्ययीभावे शरत्प्रभृतिभ्यः] Pāṇ. V. 4. 107.

rules.title: Meanings of Avyayībhāva Compounds
rules.body:
The indeclinables forming Avyayībhāva compounds have various senses[^1]; e. g. (1) the meaning of case; as @deva[गोपे इति अधिगोपम्] 'in the protector of the cowherd,' so @deva[हरादिति अधिहरि], @deva[अध्यात्मम्] &c.; (2) @deva[सामीप्य] or 'vicinity,' as @deva[कृष्णस्य समीपमष्टम्याम्] near Krishna; so @deva[उपहरम्] &c. (3) @deva[समृद्धि] or 'prosperity' as @deva[मद्राणां समृद्धिः समद्रम्], 'in a country wherein the Madras are in a prosperous condition,' (4) @deva[दुर्द्धि] (@deva[वि+ऋद्धिः]) or 'bad condition,' as @deva[यवनानां दुर्द्धिः दुर्यवनम्] 'when the Yavanas are in a bad condition,' (4) @deva[अभाव] or absence; as @deva[मक्षिकाणामभावः निर्मक्षिकम्] 'where flies are utterly absent' i. e. 'perfect loneliness', or 'quiet', so @deva[निर्जनम्] &c. ( 6 ) @deva[अत्यय] or 'the close or the transgression of' as @deva[हिमस्य अत्ययः आतिहिमम्], 'after the wintry season,' so @deva[आतिवसन्तम्], @deva[आति-शैवनम्], @deva[अतिमात्रम्] 'transgressing the proper limits', &c;( 7 ) @deva[असम्भति] or 'unfitness of time;' as @deva[निद्रा संप्रति न युज्यते इति आति-निद्रम्] 'past sleeping time;' as @deva[आतिनिद्रम् उत्तिष्ठति पुरुषः]; ( 8 ) @deva[आदुर्भीव] or 'manifestation' as @deva[हरिशब्दस्य प्रकाशः इतिहरि] in which the name Hari is manifested ( loudly uttered ); ( 9 ) @deva[पश्चात्] or 'after', as @deva[विष्णोः पश्चात् अनुविष्णुः]; ( 10 ) @deva[योग्यता][^2] or 'fitness' as @deva[रूपस्य योग्यमनुरूपम्] in a corresponding manner; so @deva[अनुरूपम्] agreeably or comfortably to, favourably; &c. ( 11 ) @deva[सीख्या] or 'repetition' as @deva[अर्थे अर्थे प्रति प्रत्यर्थम्] 'in every case,' @deva[अहन्यहनीति प्रत्यहम्-ह], 'every day'; so @deva[प्रतिपर्वम्], &c. ( 12 ) @deva[अनतिवृत्ति] or the 'non-violation of'; as @deva[शक्तिमनतिक्रम्य यथाशक्ति] 'not going beyond' i. e. 'according to one's power', so @deva[यथाविधि][^3] &c. ( 13 ) @deva[साहश्य] or 'similarity'; as @deva[हरेः साहश्ये सहरि] 'like Hari.' ( 14 ) @deva[आनुपूर्व्य] or 'succession in order, priority', as @deva[ज्येष्ठस्य आनुपूर्व्येण अनुज्येष्ठम्] 'according to seniority', so @deva[अनुक्रमम्] 'according to the proper order,' &c. ( 15 ) @deva[यौगपय] or 'simultaneousness', as @deva[चक्रेण युगपत् सचक्रम्] 'along with the wheel'.( 16 ) @deva[सम्पत्ति] or 'power, influence;' as @deva[क्षत्रणां सम्पत्तिः सक्षत्रम्] 'with the Kshatriyas in a satisfactory condition,' or 'very influential' or 'powerful.' ( 17 ) @deva[साकल्य] or 'entirety, fulness'; as @deva[तृणमपि अपरित्यज्य सतृणम्] 'in a manner not leaving out even grass' @deva[भक्षि]; and ( 18 ) @deva[अन्त] or 'end'; as @deva[अन्तेअग्निमन्थ्यपर्यन्तमधीते साग्नि] 'including the work on fire ( which is studied last of all )', so @deva[सक्षाध्यम्], &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[अक्षद्वे विभक्तिसमीपसमृद्धिव्यृद्ध्यभावात्ययासम्प्रतिशब्दप्राहुण्यापगतानि भाक्तादयश्चाव्ययीभावे] Pāṇ. II. 1. 6.

[^2]: @deva[योग्यता] appears in the original as a marginal gloss or explanation.

[^3]: @deva[यथाविधि] follows the pattern of @deva[यथाशक्ति].

rules.title: यावत् Compounds Showing Definite Measure
rules.body:
**(a)** @deva[यावत्] showing a definite measure may be compounded with any word;[^1] e. g. @deva[वाक्पतः सुश्लोकः वाक्पतः अच्युतमधावास्त्वाक्पञ्चीशम् अच्युतमधावातः] 'bowing down to Achyuta as many times as there are Slokas;' so @deva[वाग्वद् अत्वीश्वरः वाग्वद् अपवाह वाग्वदुरोयम् मध्यातः] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[यावदवधारणे] Pāṇ. II. 1. 8. 10-13. are the senses of @deva[यथा]; @deva[योग्यतासीख्यानतिवृत्तिसाहश्यानि यथायाः] Sid. Kau. @deva[यथाऽसाहश्ये] Pāṇ. II. 1. 7, @deva[यथा] is not compounded' when it indicates similarity; @deva[यथा हरिस्तथा हरः] &c.

rules.title: प्रति Meaning 'Very Little'
परि Compounds for Loss in Games
rules.body:
The words @deva[अक्ष], and @deva[शलाका] and a numeral, are compounded with @deva[परि] and placed first to express 'loss in a game';[^1] @deva[अक्षेण विपरीतं दृष्टे अक्षपरि], 'so as to be a loser by an unlucky throw of dice'; @deva[शलाकापरि] 'an unlucky throw or movement of one of the pieces at a game played with Śalākas'; @deva[एकपरि] 'loss of one throw of dice', &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[अक्षशलाकासंख्याः परिणा] Pāṇ. II. 1. 10. @deva[शूद्रमनुष्टि राजन्ये एकपारः] Sid. Kau.

rules.title: Optional Avyayībhāva Compounds with Ablative/Accusative
rules.body:
**(a)** The prepositions @deva[अप], @deva[परि] and @deva[बहिः] and words derived from the root @deva[अञ्च्] (@deva[प्राङ्], @deva[प्रत्यङ्], @deva[उदङ्], @deva[अवाङ्], @deva[तिर्यङ्], &c.), are optionally compounded with a noun in the Ablative;[^1] @deva[अपविष्णु] or @deva[अपविष्णोः] 'away from Vishṇu'; @deva[परिविष्णु] or @deva[परिविष्णोः]; @deva[बहिर्वनम्] or @deva[बहिर्वनात्]; @deva[प्राग्वनम्] or @deva[प्राग्वनात्] 'to the east of the forest' &c.

**(b)** @deva[आ] showing limit, inclusive and exclusive, is optionally compounded with a noun in the Ablative; and so are @deva[अनु], @deva[आधि], and @deva[प्रति] all meaning 'towards' with a noun in the Accusative;[^2] @deva[आमुक्ति] or @deva[आमुक्तेः] 'until final liberation' @deva[संसारः], @deva[आबालं] or @deva[आबाल-केभ्यः] up to the child; @deva[हरिमक्तिः]; @deva[अग्न्याधि] or @deva[अधिमग्नि] towards the fire @deva[इन्धनः]; @deva[पदान्नि]; @deva[प्रवाहि] or @deva[अहि प्रति]; @deva[अनुवनम्] or @deva[वनमनु].

**(c)** @deva[अनु] meaning 'towards' or 'alongside of,' 'lengthwise,' is also similarly compounded; @deva[अनुवनम्] ( @deva[वनस्य समीपे अशनिर्गतः] 'the thunderbolt passed ) towards the forest'; @deva[वङ्गया अनु अनुगङ्गम् वाराणसी] 'Varânasi is alongside the Ganges' ( @deva[भङ्गावेच्यंसहशब्दैच्यो] । @deva[षष्ठ्येतत् इत्यर्थः] S. K.)

---

[^1]: @deva[विभाषा] । @deva[अपपरिबहिरञ्चवः पञ्चम्या] Pāṇ. II. 1. 11-12.

[^2]: @deva[आङ्मर्यादाभिविध्योः] । @deva[उत्तरान्निपात्यन्ते काभिश्च्ये] । @deva[अनुपश्चमवाः कस्य चायाः] Pāṇ. II. 1. 13-16.

rules.title: पार and मध्य Compounds
rules.body:
The words @deva[पार] and @deva[मध्य] optionally form Avya. compounds with any nominal base, and are placed first, the final @deva[अ] being changed to @deva[ए] when thus compounded;[^1] e. g. @deva[पारे-मध्ये-गङ्गाम्] from the middle of the Gangetic stream; optionally of course, the Gen. Tat.; also @deva[पङ्गापारात्], @deva[गङ्गामध्यात्]. In this case the Ab. termination is irregularly retained. If the final noun has the sense of the Loc. the final vowel may be changed to @deva[अक्]; as @deva[पारे-मध्ये-गङ्गक्]; cf. @deva[पारेसहद्रम्] Bhatti. V. 4.

---

[^1]: @deva[पारेमध्ये पञ्चमा वा] Pân. II. 1. 18.

rules.title: Numeral Compounds with Relations/Learning and Rivers
rules.body:
**(a)** A numeral may optionally be compounded with a noun, showing relation by blood or by some kind of learning, to form an Avya. comp.;[^1] @deva[द्वौ मुनी बन्धवौ विद्वांते], @deva[व्याकरणस्य विद्वांते]; e. g. @deva[त्रिमुनि व्याकरणम्], 'Sans. Grammar of which the three sages-Pânini, Kâtyâyana and Patanjali, are the authors in succession.'

**(b)** and with names of rivers, this comp. also shows an aggregate;[^2] @deva[सप्तगोदम्], @deva[द्विःयमुनम्].

---

[^1]: @deva[संख्या पूर्वेन] Pân. II. 1. 19. @deva[बंधो रिक्था विद्या जन्मना च] Sid. Kau.

[^2]: @deva[नदीभिश्च] Pân. II. 1. 20 @deva[समाहारे चायमिष्यते] Vârt.

rules.title: River Compounds for Place Names
rules.body:
Any noun may be compounded with the name of a river, into an Avya. comp. to form a name;[^1] @deva[उन्मत्तगङ्गम्], 'a place where the Ganges is very boisterous,' so @deva[लोहितगङ्गम्], &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[अन्यपदार्थे च संज्ञायाम्] Pân. II. 1. 21.

rules.title: Indeclinables That Do Not Compound
rules.body: The indeclinables @deva[समया], @deva[निकषा], @deva[आरात्], @deva[अभितः], @deva[परितः], @deva[पश्चात्], do not combine with any noun; @deva[समया ग्रामं], @deva[निकषा छात्रम्] &c.

rules.title: Anomalous Avyayībhāva Compounds
rules.body:
The following Avya. compounds are anomalous[^1]:-

@deva[तिष्टन्ति गावः वसितुम् काले स तिष्ठदु दोहजकालः] 'the time when cows stand for being milked;' see Bhatti. IV. 14. So @deva[वह्दु] 'the time when cows conceive or bulls bear the plough; @deva[आयवथाः गावः आस्मिन् काले आयन्तीत्ययम्] 'the evening time,' 'the time when the cows come home'; @deva[खलेवपदम्], 'the time when the barley is on the thrashing ground;' similarly @deva[खलेबुसम्]; @deva[छन्नवसम्] 'when barley is reaped,' @deva[दुग्धमातवसम्], @deva[सह्नेवसम्], &c. @deva[समशुद्धि] 'when the ground is even;' @deva[समपदाति] 'when the foot-soldiers are in right lines,; @deva[हस्तसम्], @deva[विषसम्], @deva[अपसमय्] at the end of the year; @deva[आपत्तीसमय्], @deva[पापसमय्] in an evil year; @deva[पुण्यसमय्], @deva[प्राह्नम्], @deva[प्रथयम्] 'when the chariots move forth,' @deva[प्रमृगम्] 'when the deer comes,' @deva[विषृगम्], @deva[प्रदक्षिणम्], @deva[संगति] and @deva[असंगति].

**N. B.**—According to all followers of Pân. compounds of this group are precluded from being further compounded though poets do not seem to respect the prohibition except in so far as to place such words at the end of these comps.; cf. @deva[प्रदक्षिण-क्रियाहीनाम्] । Rag. I. 76; also IV. 25, VII. 24, &c.

---

## GENERAL RULES APPLICABLE TO ALL COMPOUNDS.

---

[^1]: @deva[तिष्ठद्गुप्रभृतीनि च] Pân. II. 1. 17.

rules.title: Addition of अ to ऋच्, पुर्, अप्, धुर्, पथ्
rules.body:
The words @deva[ऋच्], @deva[डर्], @deva[अप्], @deva[धुर्] when is does not mean 'the yoke of a carriage', and @deva[पथ्],[^1] at the end of any compound take the suffix @deva[अ];[^2] @deva[अर्धर्चं-चैक] 'half a Rik'; @deva[विष्णुपुरं][^3] 'the town of Vishnu;' @deva[विमलाप् सरः] 'a lake with pure water;' @deva[राज्यधुरा] 'the yoke of a kingdom', i. e. 'the heavy responsibilities of governing it' &c. @deva[रम्यपथो देशः] 'a country with pleasant roads', &c.

**(a)** But in the case of @deva[ऋच्] preceded by @deva[अन्] or @deva[बहु] the @deva[अ] is added only when the compound denotes a student of the Rig Veda[^4]; @deva[अनृचः] 'one who does not study the Rig Veda;' @deva[बहूचः] 'one that has studied the Rig Veda;' but @deva[अनृक् साम], 'the Sâma Veda that contains no riks,' @deva[बहूक् छन्दम्] 'a hymn consisting of many riks.'

**(b)** @deva[सुर] when it refers to @deva[अक्ष] 'a car' does not take this @deva[अ]; @deva[अक्षरूः] the yoke of a carriage; @deva[हङ्रूः अक्षः]

---

[^1]: Substituted for @deva[पथिन्].

[^2]: @deva[ऋच्डरपथुरामानधे] Pân. V. 4. 14.

[^3]: @deva[कौत्सवै लोकात्] Sid. Kau.

[^4]: @deva[भन्ऋचबहूचावध्येतर्यैव] Sid. Kau.

rules.title: Vowel Changes in अप् Compounds
rules.body:
The @deva[अ] of the word @deva[अप्] is changed to @deva[ई] when preceded by @deva[द्वि], @deva[अन्तर्], or a preposition; and to @deva[ऊ] when preceded by @deva[अप्] and the compound is the name of a country;[^1] as @deva[द्वीपोऽग्रो पश्चिमद् इति द्वीपम्] " peninsula; @deva[अन्तरीपो आपोऽधेति अन्तरीपम्] 'an island.' @deva[प्रतीपम्] 'in opposition to the force of waters;' @deva[समीपम्]; @deva[अद्वुपः][^2] ( @deva[अद्वगताः आपोऽत्र] ) 'name of a place or country.' The change of @deva[अ] to @deva[ई] is optional if the preposition end in @deva[अ]; @deva[प्रछद्व आपः][^3] @deva[प्रतिद्वप् प्रपद्व-आपम्]; @deva[पैरपद्व-परापम्] 'a pond or a tank, a passage for water.'

---

[^1]: @deva[द्व्यन्तरूपसर्गेभ्योऽप ईत्] । @deva[उदलोपेश्च] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 97-98.

[^2]: @deva[नानाद्वुमहतार्थेविषयेष्मान्तगीतादेः] । @deva[धनैश्चासिमयं तच् सत्त्वैर्विधि-शादिभिः] ॥

[^3]: @deva[अवणोन्ताच्च] Vārtika.

rules.title: Adding अ with Vowel/Consonant Dropping
rules.body:
The following words take the suffix @deva[अ] before which the final vowel, with the following consonant, if any, is dropped.[^1]

**(a)** @deva[सामन्] and @deva[लोमन्] when preceded by @deva[प्रति], @deva[अनु] or @deva[अव]; @deva[प्रति-सामं], @deva[साम अनुगतः अनुसामः] friendly; @deva[अवरं साम अवसामम्] a bad hymn; @deva[प्रतिलोमम्] 'in inverse order, inversely'; @deva[अनुलोमम्] 'in natural order, successively, directly.'

**(b)** @deva[क्षुधि] preceded by @deva[छन्न], @deva[उदक्], @deva[पाण्डु] or a numeral; @deva[छन्नाक्षुधिः यस्य स छन्नाक्षुधः]; similarly @deva[उदीर्णी क्षुधिः यस्य स उदक्षुधः]; @deva[पाण्डुक्षुधिः यस्य स पाण्डुक्षुधः]; @deva[द्वै क्षुधी यस्य स द्विक्षुधः] [@deva[मासादः]] 'having two floors'

**(c)** The words @deva[नदी] and @deva[गोदावरी] preceded by a numeral; @deva[पञ्चनदम्], @deva[सप्तगोदावरम्].

**(d)** @deva[आधि] when used in a metaphorical sense, and not meaning the eye'; as @deva[वृषभाक्षीव वातायः] lit. resembling the eye of a bull: hence 'a round window.'

**(e)** @deva[आपत्] when preceded by a preposition; @deva[प्रपत्तो आपत्] a carriage that has reached a road, @deva[पन्थो] (distant) @deva[आपत्] journey @deva[वा पाथः] ।

**(f)** also @deva[नाभि] in compounds like @deva[पश्चनाभः] ।[^2]

---

[^1]: @deva[अत्र प्रत्यन्नवपूर्वास्तमलोम्नः] Pāṇ. V. 4. 75. @deva[छन्नोदक्पाण्डुसंख्या-पूर्विया क्षुधरजिभ्यते] । @deva[संख्याया नदीगोदावरीभ्यां च] Vārtika. @deva[अधिनोऽर्थगतौ] Pāṇ. V. 4. 76. @deva[उपसर्गाद्द्वन्द्वः] Pāṇ. V. 4. 85.

[^2]: @deva[अजिति योगाद्विभागादन्त्यवज्ञापिः] Sid. Kau.; this is obtained by separating the portion @deva[अन्त्] from the Sûtra '@deva[अन्त् प्रत्यक्षव०]' But this is no sanction for forming new compounds ending in @deva[नाभ्]. It is only a device used by grammarians to explain such words as @deva[पडिन्नाभ] &c.

rules.title: Adding अ to Specific Finals
rules.body:
@deva[अ] is added to the finals of the following—[^1]

**(a)** @deva[वर्चस्] preceded by @deva[ब्रह्मन्] or @deva[हस्तिन्]; @deva[ब्रह्मवर्चसम्] 'the divine Majesty of Bramhan or the glory of a Brâhmana'; 'pre-eminence or sanctity arising from sacred knowledge'; @deva[हस्तिवर्चसम्] 'the splendour or magnificence of an elephant'.

**(b)** @deva[तमस्] preceded by @deva[अव], @deva[सु] and @deva[अन्ध]; e. g. @deva[अवतमं तमः अवतमसम्] 'slight darkness,' @deva[संततं तमः संतमसम्] 'great or continuous darkness; @deva[अन्धं तमः अन्धतमसम्] 'pitchy darkness.'

**(c)** @deva[रहस्] preceded by @deva[एक], @deva[अप] or @deva[तप्]; @deva[एकगतं रहः एकरहसम्] 'secret, solitary'; @deva[अपगतं रहः अपरहसम्] 'a little secret,' or 'desolate'; @deva[तप्तं रहः तपरहसम्] 'a hot secluded place.'

**(d)** @deva[उरस्] in the Loc. and preceded by @deva[प्रति]; @deva[उरसि प्रति यद् उरसम्] 'against the breast.'

**(e)** @deva[गौ] preceded by @deva[अनु], when length is implied; @deva[अनुगव यावत्] 'a vehicle measuring as much as a bull in length.'

---

[^1]: @deva[ब्रह्मवर्च्चसि वर्च्चसः] । @deva[अवसन्तमान्धतमसः] । @deva[एकप्रतिरहस्तपसः] । @deva[प्रतिरस्य सुस्थौरस्याम्] । @deva[अनुगवमायये] Pāṇ. V. 4. 78. 79; 81-83.

rules.title: Twenty-Five Compounds Always Taking न
rules.body: @deva[न] is always added in the case of the following twentyfive compounds which are:—@deva[अतिवाणादि षट्काशादि त्रिशदादि श्रेयः तुर्याः]; @deva[अश्वचतुर्] destitute of four; so @deva[विपलचतुर्] and @deva[पुद्धचतुर्]: all three Bah. compounds; then eleven Dw. compounds for which see @ref[192] (b) the last two; and @ref[196](c); @deva[मूड्गाभ्यां अपरित्यज्य समृद्धिभवः] Avya. (@deva[सरजः] as a Bah.); @deva[निर्भीतं श्रेयो निःश्रेयसम्] 'sure, never failing bliss;' @deva[पुरुषस्य आयुः पुरुषायुषम्] 'the period of human life'; both Tat; @deva[द्वयोरायुषोः समाहारः द्व्यायुषम्] 'the period of two lives;' similarly, @deva[त्र्यायुषम्], both Dwigus; @deva[कृष्णशुक्लम्] Dw.; @deva[जातश्चासौ उक्षा च जातोक्षः] 'a young bull'; @deva[महोक्षः] 'a grown up bull,' @deva[वृद्धोक्षः] 'an old bull'; all Karma; @deva[कुनः समीपम् उपकुनम्] 'near the dog', Avya. @deva[गोष्ठे श्वा गोष्ठश्वः], 'a dog in a cowpen that barks at others'; hence figuratively 'a person who idly stays at home and slanders others'. Tat.

rules.title: Unchanged Finals with सु, अति, द्वि
rules.body:
The finals of compounds having for their first member @deva[सु] or @deva[अति] in the sense of 'praise' and @deva[द्वि] in the sense of 'censure', remain unchanged; @deva[सुराजा] 'a good king' @deva[अतिराजा] 'a pre-eminent king': @deva[अतिगौ] 'an excellent bull' @deva[अतिवृष] &c: but @deva[परमराजः]; @deva[भाववासयः अतिभुवः]; @deva[कुत्सितो राजा द्विराजा] 'a bad king', @deva[द्विवला] 'a bad friend'; but @deva[द्विराजः], @deva[द्विवलः] in other cases. This prohibition does not apply to Bah. compounds @deva[सुभक्ष्य]; @deva[सुहृत्].

---

## OTHER CHANGES IN CONNECTION WITH COMPOUNDS.

---

rules.title: पाद् → पद् Transformations
rules.body:
The word @deva[पाद्] is changed to @deva[पद्] when followed by @deva[अन्ति], @deva[आति], @deva[प] and @deva[उपधा]; and to @deva[पद्] necessarily when followed by @deva[हिन], @deva[क्रादिन्], and @deva[हति], and optionally when followed by @deva[षोष], @deva[गिन्], @deva[शनच्] and @deva[तिष्क];[^1] as @deva[पादाभ्यामजतीति पदाजिः], @deva[पद्भ्यामततीति पद्भातिः पद्भ्यां गच्छतीति पद्गः] all meaning one walking on foot, a pedestrian; a foot-soldier', &c.; @deva[पदोपहतः] 'beaten down by the feet'; @deva[पादश्धमन्] 'coldness of the feet;' @deva[पादौ कष्टवै शीलमस्य पदकर्षी] 'one accustomed to tax his legs, a footman'; @deva[पदा हतिः पद्धतिः] a beaten-track, a way, a road; @deva[पदशोषः] or @deva[पादशोषः]; @deva[पद्गिनम्] or @deva[पादगिनम्]; @deva[पदष्णद्] or @deva[पादष्णद्] @deva[पद्गिष्कः] or @deva[पादतिष्कः] 'quarter of a Nishka' (a gold coin).

---

[^1]: @deva[पादस्य पदाज्यतिभोषहेषु] Pāṇ. VI 3. 52. @deva[हिनक्रादिहतिषु च] Vā. @deva[शोषेन्विकल्पश्च] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 54, 56

rules.title: हृदय → हृद् Transformations
उदक → उद् Transformations
rules.body:
**(a)** @deva[उदक] becomes @deva[उद्] necessarily (1) when it forms a proper name, also when it is final; or (2) when followed by the words @deva[पूर्], @deva[वास], @deva[वाहन], and @deva[धि]:[^1] @deva[उदमेघः] 'a particular cloud filled with water'; @deva[उदधिः], @deva[क्षीरोदः] the sea of milk; @deva[उडुपोदः] &c.; @deva[उदवर्षं तिष्ठति], @deva[उदवासः] standing in water; @deva[उदवाहनम्]; @deva[उदधिः] 'a vessel for holding water' @deva[घटः], @deva[संज्ञाये तु पूर्णेण सिद्धम्] Sid. Kau.;

**(b)** and optionally when followed by a word beginning with a simple consonant and denoting 'a vessel to be filled up with water', and by @deva[मन्थ], @deva[औदन], @deva[सक्तु], @deva[विन्दु], @deva[वज्र], @deva[मार], @deva[हार], @deva[शीर्षप्] 'a yoke with a pan at each end for carrying loads' (@deva[काठी] Maráthi) and @deva[गार]; @deva[उदकुम्भः] or @deva[उदककुम्भः]; but @deva[उदकस्थाली] (as @deva[स्थाली] begins with a conjunct consonant), @deva[उदकपाषम्]; @deva[उदमन्थम्] or @deva[उदकमन्थम्] barley-water; @deva[उदौदनः] or @deva[उदकौदनः] rice boiled with water, water-meal; @deva[उदवीवः] or @deva[उदकवीवः], 'a yoke for carrying water;' @deva[उदवागः] or @deva[उदकवागः] 'plunging or bathing in water' &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[उदकस्योदः संज्ञायाम्] । @deva[उत्तरपदस्य चेति वक्तव्यम्] । @deva[पूर्ववासवाहनधिषु च] । @deva[एकदेहलादौ पूर्वविधेऽन्यत्रपरत्वात्] । @deva[मन्थौदनसक्तुविन्दुवज्रमारहारशीर्षपागारेषु च] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 57-60.

rules.title: Shortening इ and उ in First Member
rules.body:
**(a)** When the first member of a compound ends in @deva[इ] or @deva[उ] not capable of changing into @deva[इय्] or @deva[उव्] and not belonging to a fem. termination or an indeclinable, the @deva[इ] or @deva[उ] is optionally shortened; @deva[ग्रामणिपुत्रः] or @deva[ग्रामणिपुत्रः] the son of a leader of a village; &c.; but @deva[गौरिपतिः], @deva[श्रीमत्], @deva[भ्रूकः], @deva[शुक्रोपास] &c.

**(b)** But the word @deva[भ्रू] followed by @deva[कृत] and @deva[कुटि] is an exception; @deva[भ्रू+कृत्=भूकृतः] (@deva[कृता कृतिः भासनं कोपया वा यस्य स निषेधवातीं नटकः] Sid. Kau.) an actor; @deva[भ्रूकुटिः] the knit eyebrow; according to some, @deva[भ्रू] optionally becomes @deva[भु] when followed by @deva[कृत] or @deva[कुटि]: as @deva[भकृतः] and @deva[भुकुटिः] (see ft. note).

rules.title: Shortening Feminine आ and ई in First Member
rules.body: **Obs.**— The fem. affix @deva[आ] or @deva[ई] at the end of a word forming the first member of a compound is shortened in most cases when the whole is a name or in the Veda; @deva[रेवतिपुत्रः], @deva[अजनिपुत्रः], @deva[कुमारिदासः], @deva[पदविदा], @deva[अजक्षीरम्] (as @deva[अजक्षीरेण जुहोति]), @deva[शिलप्रथम्], &c.; but @deva[नान्दीकरः], @deva[नान्दीघोषः], @deva[फाल्गुनीपौर्णमासी], @deva[जगतीच्छन्दः], @deva[लोमकारपदम्], &c. The @deva[आ] or @deva[ई] is optionally shortened when followed by @deva[त्व]; @deva[अजत्वे], @deva[अजात्वम्], @deva[रोहिणिभीत्वम्].

rules.title: Shortening of इष्टका, इषीका, माला
rules.body:
**Obs.**— The words @deva[इष्टका], @deva[इषीका] and @deva[माला] shorten their final when followed by @deva[चित्], @deva[तूल] and @deva[मालिन्] respectively;[^1] @deva[इष्टकाचितम्] made of bricks; @deva[पकेष्टकाचितम्]; @deva[इषीकतूलम्] 'the point of a reed,' @deva[पजेषीकतूलम्], @deva[मालमालिन्] having or wearing garlands; @deva[उत्सवमालमालिन्], (cf. Māl. Mād. IX. 2.) &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[इको ह्रस्वोऽन्योग गालवस्य] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 61. @deva[इयदुद्भ्यामतिनामस्त्रयावां च नेति वाच्यम्] । @deva[आशुक्रगार्वगामिति वक्तव्यम्] Vārtikas. @deva[अकारोऽत्र विधीयते इति व्याख्यान्तरम्] Sid. Kau. @deva[ह्रस्वोऽपोः संज्ञाच्छन्दसोर्बहुलम्] । @deva[त्वे च] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 63, 64. @deva[इष्टकेषीकामालानां चित्तूलमालिषु] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 65.

rules.title: Insertion of Nasal in Specific Compounds
rules.body:
**Obs.**— A nasal is inserted in the case of the following words:—[^1]@deva[सत्य], @deva[भवत्] and @deva[अद्य] followed by @deva[कार]; @deva[वेद्य] by @deva[अक्ष]; @deva[लोक] by @deva[पृथि]; @deva[अनभ्यास] by @deva[हव]; @deva[आङ्] and @deva[अधि] by @deva[इन्ध], @deva[तिमि] by @deva[तिङ्] or @deva[तिङ्गिल]; and @deva[उन्न] and @deva[भद्] by @deva[करण]; as @deva[सत्यङ्कारः], 'making true, earnest money,' &c; cf. Kir. XI. 50. @deva[भवदङ्कारः] 'a physician,' @deva[सन्तङ्कारः], 'efficacious,' 'admittance' ( @deva[अनुपगमः] Tat. B. ), @deva[वेद्यङ्क्षया] ( @deva[भविष्यती भयः] Tat. B. ); @deva[लोकम्पृथ्] 'pervading or filling the world,' @deva[अनभ्यासांहित्वम्] 'not to be approached, to be shunned from afar,' ( @deva[दूरतः परिहर्तव्य इत्यर्थः] Sid. Kan. ); @deva[आङ्गिन्धः], 'one who fries or roasts in a frying-pan,' @deva[अधिगिन्धः], 'one who kindles fire,' @deva[तिमितिङ्गः] 'a monstrous fish that swallows down Timi (a large fish said to be 100 Yojanas in length ),' @deva[तिमितिङ्गिलः] 'a very large fish that swallows even a Timingila;'[^2] @deva[उन्नङ्करणम्] heating; @deva[भद्रङ्करणम्] conferring prosperity.

---

[^1]: @deva[कारसत्यावदद्यानाम्] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 70. @deva[अक्षवेद्यस्य] । @deva[वानोभ्यासगस्य] । @deva[लोकस्य पृथौ] । @deva[हवेऽनभ्यासस्य] । @deva[आङ्गधोरिन्धौ] । @deva[तिमेस्तिमिङ्गस्य] । @deva[तिङ्गिले च] । @deva[उन्नभद्रयोः करणे] Vārtika

[^2]: Vide Rag. XIII. 10. and Mallinatha on it. '@deva[आस्ते मत्स्यकुलतिमिर्ग शतयोजनमायतः] । @deva[तिमिङ्गिलगिलोऽप्यस्ति तद्गिलोऽप्यस्ति राघवः] ।'

rules.title: Optional Nasal Insertion in रात्रि
rules.body: @deva[रात्रि] followed by a kṛit affix inserts a nasal optionally; @deva[रात्रिञ्चरः] or @deva[रात्रिचरः], 'a night-rover,' 'a demon;' @deva[रात्रिष्टहः] or @deva[रात्रिष्टहः] &c.

rules.title: सह → स Transformations
rules.body:
@deva[सह] forming the first member of a compound, is changed to @deva[स]—[^1]

**(a)** when the whole compound is a name, e. g. @deva[सभाजयः]; but @deva[सहयुध्वा] a comrade in battle ( Upapada comp. ).

**(b)** when it means 'including a certain literary work,' or 'in addition to;' as @deva[सज्योतिषम्] ( Avya. comp. ) @deva[ज्योतिषमधीते] 'he studies the science of astronomy, including that of finding out the auspicious times,' @deva[सकोणा वीणा] 'a khāri with a drone in addition to it.'

**(c)** and when the object denoted by the latter member is not visibly seen, but is to be inferred: as @deva[सराक्षश्चा] ( Bah-comp. ) @deva[निशा] 'a night in which presence of demoness is to be inferred'

---

[^1]: @deva[सहस्य सः संज्ञायाम्] । @deva[अन्यान्तविधौ च] । @deva[द्वितीये चाङुपाख्ये] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 78-80.

rules.title: समान → स Transformations
rules.body:
@deva[समान] becomes @deva[स]—[^1]

**(a)** when followed by the words @deva[ज्योतिस्], @deva[जनपद], @deva[रात्रि], @deva[नाभि], @deva[नामन्], @deva[गोत्र], @deva[रूप], @deva[स्थान], @deva[वर्ण], @deva[वयस्], @deva[वचन], and @deva[बन्धु]; @deva[समानं ज्योतिः अस्य सज्योतिः] a kind of mourning which lasts from the rising of the sun or a particular collection of stars to its setting. (@deva[समानं ज्योतिरस्येति बहुव्रीहिः] । @deva[यस्मिन् ज्योतिषि आदित्ये नक्षत्रे वा संजातं तदस्तमयपर्यन्तमनुवर्तमानमाशौचं सज्योतिरित्युच्यते] Tat. Bod.); @deva[सजनपदः] belonging to the same country; @deva[सरात्रिः], @deva[सनाभिः] 'connected by the same navel, sprung from the same ancestor,' &c.

**(b)** when followed by the word @deva[ब्रह्मचारिन्][^2] 'a student of the Veda who belongs to the same S'âkhâ or branch as another,' @deva[समानः ब्रह्मचारी सब्रह्मचारी].

**(c)** when followed by @deva[तीर्थ] with the Tad. affix @deva[य] added to it; as @deva[समानतीर्थे वासी सतीर्थ्यः] 'a disciple of the same preceptor,' and optionally when followed by @deva[उदर] under the same circumstances; @deva[समानोदरे शयितः सोदर्यः] or @deva[समानोदर्यः] 'born of the same womb,' 'a brother by whole blood.'

**(d)** when followed by @deva[दृक्], @deva[दृश] and @deva[दृक्ष]; @deva[सदृक्], @deva[सदृश], @deva[सदृक्ष] ।

**(e)** and in the case of compounds like @deva[सपक्ष], @deva[साधर्म्य], @deva[सजातीय], &c.[^3]

---

[^1]: @deva[ज्योतिर्जनपदरात्रिनाभिनामगोत्ररूपस्थानवर्णवयोवचनबन्धुषु] । @deva[चरणे ब्रह्मचारिणि] । @deva[तीर्थे ये] । @deva[विभाषोदरे] । @deva[दृग्दृशवतुषु] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 85-89. @deva[दृक्षे चेति वक्तव्यम्] Vārt.

[^2]: @deva[चरणः शाखा], @deva[ब्रह्म वेदः] । @deva[तदध्ययनार्थं व्रतमपि ब्रह्म तच्चरतीति ब्रह्मचारी] Sk:

[^3]: @deva[समानस्य छन्दस्यमूर्धप्रभृत्युदर्केषु] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 84. The proper meaning of this sûtra is that the word @deva[समान] is changed to @deva[स] in the Veda when followed by any other word than @deva[मूर्धन्], @deva[प्रभृति].

rules.title: स् → ष् Transformations in Compounds
rules.body:
@deva[स्] is changed to @deva[ष्] when the following words are compounded:[^1]

**(a)** @deva[अगुलि] and @deva[धर्]; @deva[अगुलिध्रः] ।

**(b)** @deva[भीरु] and @deva[स्थान] n.; @deva[भीरुष्ठानम्].

**(c)** @deva[ज्योतिस्] or @deva[आयुस्] and @deva[स्तोम]; @deva[ज्योतिष्टोमः]; @deva[आयुष्टोमः] a sacrifice performed for obtaining long life.

**(d)** and in the case of the words @deva[दुषामा] and others; @deva[शोभनं साम यस्य दुषामा]; so @deva[निःषामा], @deva[दुषेषः]; @deva[दुषन्धिः]; @deva[दुश्च], @deva[दुष्] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[समावे।ऽगुलिः सरः] । @deva[भीरोः स्थानम्] । @deva[ज्योतिरायुष्स्तोम: दुषामादिषु च] । Pāṇ. VIII. 3. 80-81, 83. 98.

rules.title: अन्य → अन्यद् Transformations
पृषोदरादि - Irregular Formations
rules.body:
A certain number of compounds and other words of irregular formation are classed under the head of @deva[पृषोदरादि].[^1] Any word whose formation cannot be properly explained is included into this group. These are to be taken as found in the language. The principal of these are:—@deva[पवते उदरं पृषोदरम्] 'wind, air', @deva[हन्ति गच्छतीति हस्तीति वा हस्तः] (either from @deva[हन्] or @deva[हस्]); @deva[हिनस्तीति सिंहः] (fr. @deva[हिंस्] conj. ? to kill). @deva[परेभ्यातो आत्मा परात्मा] the soul that is concealed from the external senses; @deva[वारिणां वाहकाः बलाहकाः] 'clouds' @deva[जीवनस्य धरः] (a bag) @deva[जीमूतः] 'a cloud'; @deva[श्मशानः] (dead bodies) @deva[शेरते अत्र श्मशानं] or @deva[श्मशानं शापनं] (Kāś.); @deva[उल्व्यै च ततं र्वं च कुर्वं तत् वातीति उलूखलम्], 'a wooden mortar'; @deva[पिशितमाचामयतीति पिशाचः]; @deva[मुक्तोऽस्य शीर्धीति मुणि] 'the seat of ascetics or holy sages discussing philosophical subjects'; @deva[मयते असौ, मयां करोतीति वा, मयूरः] 'a peacock.'

**(a)** @deva[तीर] becomes @deva[तार] optionally when compounded with the names of directions;[^2] as @deva[दक्षिणतीरम्] or @deva[दक्षिणतारम्]; @deva[उत्तरतीरम्-तारम्] &c.

**(b)** **Obs.**— @deva[दुर्] becomes @deva[दु] in the following cases—[^3]@deva[दुःखेन द्रष्टुमते दुद्राक्षः] 'difficult to be given or hurt'; @deva[दुःखेन नाश्यते दुनाशः] 'not easy to be destroyed;' @deva[दुःखेन द्रभ्यते दुद्रभः] 'difficult to be injured or impelled;' @deva[दुःखेन ध्यायतीति दुध्याः] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[पृषोदरादीनि यथोपदिष्टम्] । Pāṇ. VI. 3. 109.

[^2]: @deva[दिक्शब्देभ्यस्तारस्य तारभावो वा] । Vārtika.

[^3]: @deva[दुरो द्राघनाशद्रभ्यध्येषु दुर्वे च] । Vārtika.

rules.title: Lengthening of First Member Vowel
rules.body:
The vowel of the first member is lengthened in the following cases:—[^1]

**(a)** When the nouns derived from the roots @deva[नह्], @deva[सद्], @deva[इष्], @deva[व्यध्], @deva[रुच्], @deva[सह्], and @deva[तन्] with the aff. @deva[क्विन्] ( o ) follow prepositions termed Gati or nouns which they govern; @deva[उपनाह्], @deva[नीवृद्] an inhabited country, a realm, @deva[वीवृद्] the-rainy season, @deva[मर्माविद्] piercing the vitals; so @deva[मृगविद्] a hunter (cf. Bhaṭṭi II. 7). @deva[नीरुह्], @deva[अभीरुह्], @deva[शत्रूरुद्] overpowering an assailant @deva[परीसह्]. But @deva[परिधावनम्] as @deva[नह्] is not followed by Kvip.

**(b)** When followed by the aff. @deva[वल], and the whole is a name; @deva[कषीवलः] a husbandman.

**(c)** Words containing more than two vowels when followed by @deva[वत्] (@deva[मत्]) except in the case of @deva[अजिर], @deva[रविर], @deva[क्षिणिन], @deva[इरिच], @deva[कारणवत्] and @deva[चरणवाक] and the whole is a name; @deva[अमरावती] and @deva[इरावती] which are names; but @deva[अजिरवती], @deva[कृदिमती], @deva[बहुमती] which is not a name. Also in the case of @deva[हर], @deva[वंश], @deva[भूम], @deva[अति], @deva[कपि], @deva[तनि], @deva[शुचि], and @deva[इण]; @deva[इरावती] &c.

**(d)** When a verbal derivative with the aff. @deva[अ] (@deva[घञ्]) follows a preposition, in most cases, when the comp. does not signify a human being; @deva[परिधानम्]:-@deva[परीपाकः]; but @deva[निषादः] one of a mountain-tribe. Similarly @deva[प्रति-सी-वंशः]; @deva[प्रति-सी-कारः] &c.

**(e)** When @deva[काश] follows a preposition ending in @deva[इ]; @deva[नीकाशः], @deva[नीकाशः]; but @deva[प्रकाशः]

**(f)** When @deva[अट्टन्] is the first, and @deva[नर्] the second member of a compound, and the whole is a name; @deva[अटानर]: gold, @deva[अष्टानरः] a spider; but @deva[अष्टउत्तरः], @deva[विद्यातरः] an epithet of Savitṛi.

**(g)** When @deva[मित्र] is the latter member and the whole is the name of a ṛishi; @deva[विश्वामित्रः]; but @deva[विश्वामित्रो माणवकः] ।

---

[^1]: @deva[नद्युद्वितृतीयपिद्विषतिनिहके] । @deva[वेले] । @deva[भूतो बहुव्रीहिजगृत्प्रियेषाम्] । @deva[शरादीनां च] । @deva[उपसर्गस्य पञ्चमसुष्ठे बहुलम्] । @deva[इकः फले] । @deva[अह्नः संज्ञायाम्] । @deva[नरे संज्ञायाम्] । @deva[पर्वे चपा] । Pāṇ. VI. 3. 116; 118-129. 122. 123. 125, 129, 130.

rules.title: Insertion of नुम् in Compounds
rules.body:
@deva[नुम्] is inserted in the case of the following compounds:—[^1]

**(a)** @deva[अपर] followed by @deva[पर] when continuity of an action is implied; @deva[अपरंपराः साङ्करा गच्छन्ति] । @deva[सततमाविच्छेदेन गच्छन्तीत्यर्थः]; but @deva[अपरपरा गच्छन्ति] । @deva[अपरे च परे च साङ्केष गच्छन्तीत्यर्थः] । and in the case of @deva[आ + श्चर्य] when wonder is meant; @deva[आश्चर्यं यदि उ दुर्जीते] । But @deva[आश्चर्ये कर्म दोषमयम्] ।

**(b)** @deva[अवकीर्णते इति अवस्करः] when it means @deva[वर्जितं] ( @deva[व्रन्तितं वर्ज्यं वर्जनीयसमतलम्] । Sid. Kau.) otherwise @deva[अवस्करः]; @deva[अपस्करः] when it means @deva[रथाङ्ग] 'part of a carriage'; @deva[विषिन्क] ( or @deva[विशिन्कः] ) 'a bird'. @deva[प्रतिष्कन्दः] ( @deva[संजातः पुरोगामी वा] Sid. Kau. ), but @deva[प्रतिकशः कशां प्रतिकशः] 'one who boldly faces the whip, a disobedient servant' &c. @deva[मस्करः] 'a bamboo', but @deva[मकरः] 'a shark', @deva[मस्करिन्] 'an ascetic' but @deva[मकरिन्] 'the sea'; @deva[कारस्करः] when it means 'a particular kind of tree,' otherwise @deva[कारस्करः] ।

**(c)** in the case of the words of the @deva[पारस्करादि] group, such as @deva[पारस्करः], @deva[किंस्कुः], @deva[किंस्कुना], &c. when they are names.

**(d)** and when the words @deva[तस्] and @deva[इन्द्र] are follow d by @deva[कर] and @deva[पति] and the meaning is 'a thief', and 'a deity' respectively, and @deva[र] and @deva[न] being dropped before @deva[ष]; @deva[तस्करः], @deva[इन्द्रपतिः]. Also @deva[प्रायश्चित्तम्], @deva[प्रायश्चित्तिः], @deva[वनस्पतिः] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[अपरस्पर: क्रियाजातत्वे] । @deva[आश्चर्येर्थसन्निधौ] । @deva[स्वैरंडुत्सकः] । @deva[अपस्करो रक्षार्थम्] । @deva[विशेदः शङ्कनिर्विशङ्को वा] । @deva[मांस्करोस्य कस्ते:] । @deva[मत्करम्मकारिणो वेदपरिव्राजकयोः] । @deva[कारस्करो ब्रह्मः] । @deva[पारस्करप्रवीवणि च संज्ञायाम्] । Pāṇ. VI. 1. 144, 147, 148-152, 154, 156, 157. @deva[तस्नुनुष्टोस्करांमाकारतये वतयोः वटसुहोपक्रः] । Vārt. @deva[भावस्य स्वनिरविसयोः] । Vārt.

rules.title: Vowel Lengthening and न → ण Before वन
rules.body:
When the words @deva[पुराज], @deva[मित्रक], @deva[सिंहक], @deva[सारिक] and @deva[कौटर] are followed by @deva[वन] in a compound they lengthen their ending vowel, and the @deva[न] of @deva[वन] is changed to @deva[ण] ( also after @deva[अग्र] );[^1] @deva[पुराजावणम्], @deva[मित्रकावणम्], @deva[सिंहकावणम्], @deva[सारिकावणम्], @deva[कौटरावणम्]; but @deva[अवित्रवनम्]; @deva[वनस्पतौ अद्रेवनम्].

---

[^1]: @deva[वनं पुराजमित्रकसिंहकसारिककौटरेभ्यः] । Pāṇ. VIII 4. 4.

rules.title: न → ण in वन with Prepositions and Plants
rules.body:
**Obs.**— The @deva[न] of @deva[वन] is changed to @deva[ण] necessarily when preceded by @deva[प्र], and optionally when compounded with names of herbs or plants containing two or three vowels[^1] @deva[प्रवणम्], @deva[काद्रम्बीवणम्], &c. @deva[पूतीवणम्-वनम्], @deva[तिंबीवणम्-वनम्]; but @deva[देववाचनम्]: (if the word contains more than three vowels); exceptions:—@deva[हरिवाचनम्], @deva[गिरिवाचनम्], and @deva[तिमिराचनम्].

---

[^1]: @deva[प्रतिश्रनः कोंगैङ्कुप्रसासुकार्येसंविदविकुसामीऽसंज्ञायामपि] । @deva[विभाषार्कतिवनस्पतिभ्यः] । Pāṇ. VIII. 4. 5-6.

rules.title: न → ण in वाहन
rules.body: The @deva[न] of @deva[वाहन] is changed to @deva[ण] when preceded by a word denoting an object that can be borne; @deva[पुष्पवाहणम्]; but @deva[इन्द्रवाहनम्] (@deva[इन्द्रस्वामिके वाहनमित्यर्थः]: Sid. Kau.).

rules.title: न → ण in पान and Other Compounds
rules.body:
The @deva[न] of @deva[पान] is changed to @deva[ण] necessarily when the compound implies a country and optionally when it signifies merely the act of drinking; as @deva[सुरापाणः]: (@deva[पाण्डयः]); @deva[क्षीरपाणः]: (@deva[द्वायणर्देशः]); but @deva[क्षीरपानम्] or @deva[पाणम्].

**(a)** @deva[न] is also optionally changed to @deva[ण] in the case of the following compounds:—@deva[गिरि-पर्णी-णर्णी], @deva[गिरि-पर्ण-णख], @deva[गिरि-पर्चूषि-णचूषि], @deva[गिरिषिवुन्ते-णितन्ते], @deva[चर्कि-पर्दी-णर्दी], @deva[चर्कि-णितन्ते-नितन्ते], &c

rules.title: Introduction to Feminine Formation
rules.body:
# Chapter VIII. Formation of Feminine Bases

Feminine bases are derived from the masculine by the addition of the affixes @deva[आ] (@deva[टाप्], @deva[डाप्], @deva[चाप्]), @deva[ई] (@deva[ङीप्], @deva[ङीष्], @deva[ङीन्]), @deva[क] (@deva[कङ्]) and @deva[ति].

rules.title: Changes Before Feminine Affix ई
rules.body:
Before the affix @deva[ई]—[^1]

**(a)** nouns ending in consonants assume that form which they take before the termination of Inst. sing.; @deva[प्रत्यच्-श्-प्रतीची], @deva[राजन्—राज्ञी], @deva[भवत्—भवती], @deva[श्वन्—शुनी], @deva[अर्यमन्—आर्येणी], @deva[विद्वस्—विदुषी], &c. There are some exceptions, @deva[अर्हन्—अर्हती] &c.

**(b)** the preceding @deva[अ] or @deva[ई] is dropped; as @deva[गोर—गोरी आटी श—दूत्ती], @deva[पाम्वती]. &c.

**(c)** if a Prâtipadika end in @deva[य], part of a Taddhita affix, that @deva[य] is dropped @deva[गार्ग्य + ई = गार्ग्याः] 'the daughter of Garga.' &c.

**(d)** the final @deva[य] of the words @deva[सूर्य], @deva[तिष्य] the constellation of stars called @deva[पुष्य], @deva[अगस्त्य] and @deva[मत्स्य] is dropped;[^2] as @deva[सौरी], @deva[मत्सी], &c.

**(e)** in the case of the participles of the present and the future @deva[न] is inserted, as in the Nom. dual of the neu. (vide @ref[311]. a. b.); for instances, see @ref[236].

---

[^1]: @deva[हलन्तच्छपिदस्य] । Pān VI. 4. 150. For the meaning of the term Prâtipadika vide @ref[52].

[^2]: @deva[सूर्यतिष्यागस्त्यमत्स्यानां य उपधायाः] । Pan VI. 4. 149.

rules.title: Feminine Formation in आ
rules.body:
A Prâtipadika ending in @deva[अ] and the words included in the Ajâdi group[^1] form their feminine in @deva[आ];[^2] as @deva[भुञ्जान-भुञ्जाना] ; @deva[अज-अजा], @deva[एडका], @deva[अभा], @deva[चटका], @deva[मूषिका]; @deva[बाला], @deva[बत्सा], @deva[होडा], @deva[मन्दा], @deva[विडाला], all meaning 'a young girl'; (of these the first five form an exception to @ref[313], and the second to @ref[308], a°); @deva[आ] is also added to @deva[फल] when compounded with @deva[सत्], @deva[भद्र], @deva[अर्जुन], @deva[पद्म] and @deva[पिण्ड]; to @deva[पुष्प] when compounded with @deva[सत्], words ending in @deva[अच्], to @deva[काण्ड], @deva[प्रान्त], @deva[शत] and @deva[एक]; to @deva[शूद्र] not preceded by @deva[महत्], when class is implied, and to @deva[मल] preceded by @deva[अ]; @deva[संस्फला]; @deva[भद्रफला], @deva[पुणयफला], &c all 'kinds of creeper'; @deva[सत्-पाक्-काण्ड-प्रान्त-शत-एक-पुष्पा], 'kinds of creeper' @deva[शूद्रा] 'a woman of the @deva[शूद्र] class;' @deva[अमला].

**(a)** But if the Prâtipadika end in @deva[क] (the member of the termination ) the preceding @deva[अ] is changed to @deva[इ];[^3] @deva[सर्विका], @deva[कारिका], &c.; the words @deva[मामक], @deva[नरक], and those ending in the Tad. affix @deva[त्य] with @deva[क] suffixed to it, changed their @deva[अ] to @deva[इ] similarly; @deva[मामिका], @deva[नराद् क्रोशति] calls out to @deva[इति नरिका], @deva[दाक्षिणात्यिका], @deva[इहत्यिका] a woman of this place.

Exceptions:—The @deva[अ] is not changed to @deva[इ] when the @deva[क] is added to the pronouns @deva[यद्] and @deva[तद्], or when it is a part of the Tad. affix @deva[त्यक], or when there is a compound, or when there is a word included in the Kshipaka group (@deva[क्षिपकगण]);[^4] as @deva[यका], @deva[सका], @deva[अधित्यका] 'a tableland', @deva[उपत्यका] 'the land at the foot of a mountain.' @deva[बहुपरिव्राजका नगरी], @deva[क्षिपका], @deva[धुवका], @deva[कन्यका], &c.

**(b)** @deva[अ] is optionally changed to @deva[इ] in the following cases.—[^5]

**(1)** @deva[तारका] 'a star', @deva[तारिका] 'able to protect'; @deva[वर्णका] 'a cloak, a garment;' @deva[वर्णिका] (in other cases), @deva[वर्तका-वर्तिका शकुनौ प्राचाम्] @deva[उदीचां तु वर्तिका]; @deva[अष्टका] 'kind of Shrāddha,' @deva[अष्टिका] (in other cases).

**(2)** @deva[सूतिका-सूतका], a woman recently delivered; @deva[पुत्रिका] or @deva[पुत्रका], @deva[वृन्दारका] or @deva[वृन्दारिका], a goddess.

**(3)** when the @deva[क] follows upon the fem. termination @deva[आ] shortened to @deva[अ] and is preceded by @deva[य] or @deva[क]; as @deva[आर्या+क=आर्यक+आ=आर्यिका] or @deva[आर्यका]; @deva[चटका+क=चटकक+आ=चटकिका] or @deva[चटकका] &c. but @deva[संकाश्ये भवा सांकाश्यिका], @deva[अश्विका], @deva[शुभंयातीति शुभंयाः]; @deva[अज्ञाता शुभंयाः शुभंयिका].

**(c)** This change of @deva[अ] to @deva[इ] is necessary when the @deva[क] follows the @deva[य] or @deva[क] of a root @deva[इनयिका], @deva[इपाक्रिका], &c.

---

[^1]: The words included in the Ajâdi group are.—@deva[अज], @deva[एडक] 'a ram', @deva[अभ], @deva[चटक] 'a sparrow', @deva[मूषक], @deva[बाल], @deva[बत्स], @deva[होड], @deva[पाक] 'a young child,' @deva[मन्द]; @deva[विडाल], @deva[कुञ्ज] 'a heron,' @deva[उष्ट्रविह्], @deva[देववह्] 'a deity,' @deva[स्योद], @deva[मध्यम], @deva[कनिष्ठ] and @deva[कनिष्ठ].

[^2]: @deva[अजाद्यतष्टाप्] । Pān IV. 1. 4. 4. @deva[संयकाजिनपक्षपिण्डेभ्यः फलात् सत्पुष्पकाण्डप्रान्तशतैकेभ्यः पुष्पात्] । @deva[शूद्रा चामहत्पूर्वा जातौ] । @deva[मलटवरः] । Vârtikas.

[^3]: @deva[प्रत्ययस्थात्कात्पूर्वस्यात इद्राप्येधुः] । Pān. VII. 3. 44. @deva[मामकनरकयोर्पूर्वत्वाभावः] । @deva[व्यत्ययोऽपि] । Vârtikas.

[^4]: @deva[न यासयोः] । Pān. VII. 3. 45. @deva[त्यकनञ्च निषेधः] । @deva[क्षिपकादीनां च] । Vārtika. The following words are included in the @deva[क्षिपकगण]:—@deva[क्षिपक] 'an archer,' @deva[धुवक], @deva[चरक] 'a spy,' @deva[सेवक], @deva[करक] 'a kind of bird, hail,' @deva[चटक]; @deva[अवक] 'a kind of plant,' @deva[हलक], @deva[अलका], @deva[कन्यका], and @deva[एडक].

[^5]: @deva[तारका ज्योतिषि] । @deva[वर्णका तान्तवे] । @deva[वर्तिका शकुनौ प्राचाम्] । @deva[सूतिकापुत्रिकावृन्दारकाणां वेति वक्तव्यम्]. Vārtika. @deva[उदीचामातः स्थाने यकपूर्वायाः] । Pān. VII. 3. 46. @deva[यात्वन्तयकोस्तु नित्यम्] । Vārtika.

rules.title: Feminine Formation in ई
rules.body:
**(a)** A prātipadika ending in @deva[कर], except @deva[धक्कर], @deva[तक्कर], @deva[स्किकर] and @deva[बहुकर]; @deva[भ]. @deva[सर], preceded by @deva[यत्]; @deva[अमर]: @deva[अमे] and @deva[तुद्]; and @deva[खर] preceded by @deva[सेवा]. @deva[द्वाप] and words expressive of place; the words @deva[नद], @deva[चोर], @deva[देव], @deva[भाइ], @deva[भर]. @deva[व्छय], and @deva[नह्], nominal bases ending in @deva[ण्य], nominal and verbal derivatives formed by the affix @deva[अ] causing Vṛddhi or Guṇa, such as @deva[ओढनः], @deva[ओसन:], @deva[कुम्भकारः], @deva[भावहारः], @deva[पाठ्यः], @deva[ताइम:], &c. and words ending in the Tad. affixes @deva[इयस्], @deva[दुह], @deva[माच] and @deva[इक] (with some exceptions) and in the kṛit affix @deva[स्वर] form their feminine in @deva[ई] when they are not used adjectively;[^1] e. g. @deva[भोगकरी] conducing to pleasures; @deva[एककरी] &c.; @deva[पतिसी], @deva[सिनसी], &c.; @deva[अविसरी], &c.; @deva[सेनाखरी], @deva[कुरुखरी], a woman of the Kuru country; @deva[मत्स्यखरी], &c.; @deva[नदी], @deva[देवी], @deva[सटी], &c.; @deva[सौपर्णी], @deva[वैनतेयी], &c.; @deva[ऐन्द्री], @deva[औरसी], &c.; @deva[कुम्भकारी], @deva[नगरकारी], &c.; @deva[उरुद्यसी-दुही-माचां] measuring or reaching as far as the knee; &c. @deva[आशिथकी], @deva[छागणकी], &c.; @deva[पाटसी], @deva[ताइसी], @deva[स्वरी], evanescent, an unchaste woman &c., @deva[गल्वरी] &c., but @deva[स्किकरा]. @deva[बहुकुरारा नगरी].

**(b)** Also words ending in the Tad. affixes @deva[न], @deva[स्न], @deva[इक्]. @deva[य] (causing Vṛiddhi) and the words @deva[नदुन] and @deva[नठुन];[^2] @deva[धोणी]. @deva[गोत्नी] fit for a man; @deva[शाकोकी], @deva[तरुणी], @deva[नठुनी], &c. also words ending in the kṛit. affix @deva[अन] causing a nasal to be inserted before it; @deva[आह्वेमकरणी].[^3]

**(c)** Words indicative of the stages of life except the last take the fem. @deva[ई];[^4] @deva[कुमारी], @deva[किशोरी], @deva[बक्री], @deva[बष्टी], @deva[बिरण्टी] (both meaning a 'a young woman'); but @deva[वृद्धा]. @deva[स्थविरा] &c. as these imply old age; @deva[कन्या] is an exception.

**(d)** **Obs**—The words @deva[केवल], @deva[मामक], @deva[भागधेय] @deva[धाण], @deva[अमर], @deva[समान], @deva[आर्येष्ठ], @deva[छन्दोगाल] and @deva[भेषज] form their fem. in @deva[ई] when they are used as names ( or in the Veda ), @deva[केवली], @deva[मामकी], @deva[समानी], @deva[आर्येष्ठी] &c., but @deva[केवला उमाना], &c. when they are not names.[^5]

**(e)** The words @deva[नर्तक], @deva[खनक], @deva[रञ्जक] and @deva[रनक], those derived by adding the Krit affixes @deva[आक], and @deva[अ] ( added to certain roots ) and the words included in the @deva[गोरादिगण] form their fem. in @deva[ई];[^6] @deva[नर्तकी], @deva[रञ्जकी] &c. @deva[छुट्टकी] one who divides or cuts; @deva[लुण्टाकी] robbing or stealing, @deva[भाङ्गी], &c.; @deva[गोरी], @deva[मञ्जरी], @deva[चुङ्गी], @deva[हरिणी], @deva[मातामही], @deva[पितामही] &c.; @deva[सुन्दर] has @deva[सुन्दरा] and @deva[सुन्दरी].

---

[^1]: @deva[विङुणचतुरभ्यससाच्वरश्मान्चूतचट्यकुटप्रकारनः] । Pāṇ. IV. 1: 15.

[^2]: @deva[नक्षत्रजीवकन्योन्तारनिनठुनानामुपसंख्यानम्] । Vārt. @deva[यचश्च] Pāṇ. IV. 1. 16.

[^3]: Vide the Kāshikā on Pāṇ. III. 2. 21.

[^4]: @deva[वयसि प्रथमे] । Pāṇ. IV. 1 20. @deva[वयस्त्यवरम इति वाच्यम्] । Vārt.

[^5]: Vide Pāṇ. V. 1. 30.

[^6]: @deva[गोरादिभ्यश्च] । Pāṇ. IV. 1. 41. The following are the more important of the words included in the @deva[गोरादि] group:—@deva[गोर], @deva[मनुष्य], @deva[कव्य], @deva[पुट], @deva[प्रोण], @deva[हरिण], @deva[कण], @deva[आमलक], @deva[बदर], @deva[बिम्ब], @deva[तुम्बर], @deva[शिखण्ड], @deva[सपभ], @deva[आलिन्द्य], @deva[आहक], @deva[अश्वत्थ], @deva[उभय], @deva[भृङ्ग], @deva[मह], @deva[मह], @deva[भव], @deva[तरुण], @deva[अनुत्तर], @deva[अनष्टवाह], @deva[देव], @deva[देवली], @deva[रजन], @deva[आरट], @deva[नट], @deva[आस्तरण], @deva[आश्रायण], @deva[महनल], @deva[मत्सर], @deva[मण्डल], @deva[पिण्ड], @deva[इन्द्र], @deva[वहम्], @deva[प्रबृद्ध], @deva[सोम], @deva[सौभग] &c.

rules.title: Insertion of आयन् Before ई
rules.body:
Some prātipadikas ending in the Tad. affix @deva[य] insert @deva[आयन्] before @deva[ई];[^1] @deva[भार्गायणी] ( the grand-daughter of @deva[भृगु] ), @deva[लोहितायनी], @deva[काश्यायनी], &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[सर्वेभ्यो लौहितादिकान्तेभ्यः] । Pāṇ. IV. I. 18.

rules.title: Eleven Prātipadikas with Conditional ई
rules.body:
The following eleven prātipadikas form their feminine in @deva[ई] under the circumstances mentioned—[^1]@deva[जानपद] when it qualifies @deva[वृत्ति] or 'maintenance', @deva[कुण्ड] when it means 'a vessel' or 'a man of a mixed class', @deva[गोण] 'a full sack', @deva[स्थल] 'natural site', @deva[भाज] 'boiled,' @deva[नाग] 'a huge elephant', and @deva[काल] 'a particular colour, @deva[नील] when it does not refer to a garment ( or rather refers to an animal ) or means 'indigo', @deva[कुश] when it means 'something made of iron. @deva[काषुक] 'desirous of enjoyment,' and @deva[कबर] 'a knot of hair; as @deva[जानपदी] [@deva[वृत्तिः]], '@deva[जानपदा नगरी]'; @deva[कुण्डी अमत्रं] [a vessel] @deva[कुण्डान्या] (one that burns). @deva[गोणी आवपनं चेत्], @deva[गोणा अन्या] i.e. 'an empty sack;' @deva[स्थली अकृत्रिमा चेत्], @deva[स्थला अन्या] i.e. ground artificially prepared; @deva[भाजी श्राणा] (rice-gruel) @deva[चेत्], @deva[भाजा अन्या]; @deva[नागी स्थूला चेत्], @deva[नागा अन्या], @deva[काली वर्णश्चेत्], @deva[काला अन्या]; i.e. 'if it be a proper name;' @deva[नीली अवाच्छादनं] [@deva[ओषधिविशेषो गौर्वा]] @deva[चेत्], @deva[नीला अन्या नील्या रक्ता छाटी इत्यर्थे नीली] or @deva[नीला] (when a name), @deva[कुशी अयोविकारश्चेत्] but @deva[कुशा] 'a wooden peg'; @deva[काषुकी] 'a woman desirous of enjoyment,' @deva[काषुका] 'one anxious to meet her lover,' @deva[कबरी] 'a braid of hair,' but @deva[कबरा] variegated; @deva[शोण] has @deva[शोणी]-@deva[णा].[^2]

---

[^1]: @deva[जानपदकुण्डगोणस्थलभाजनागकालनीलकुशकाषुककबरादृत्त्यमत्राच्छपनाकृत्रिमाश्राणास्थौलवर्णानाच्छादनायोविकारमैथुनेच्छाकेशवेशेषु] । Pāṇ. IV. 1. 42. @deva[अनाच्छादनेऽपि न सर्वत्र किन्तु] । @deva[नीलादोषधौ] । @deva[प्राणिनि च] । @deva[संज्ञायां वा] । Vārt.

[^2]: @deva[शोणात्प्राचाम्] । Pāṇ. VI. 1. 43.

rules.title: Feminine ई for Wife of Male
rules.body:
The feminine of nouns denoting 'a male' is formed by adding @deva[ई] when the wife of that male is meant;[^1] @deva[गोपस्य स्त्री गोपी]; @deva[शूद्री] (sometimes @deva[शूद्राणी] also) 'wife of a Sudra'.

**(a)** but not of nouns ending in @deva[पालक]; as @deva[गोपालिका] 'the wife of a cowherd' (but @deva[गोपाल] has @deva[गोपाली]); @deva[अश्वपालिका] 'the wife of a horse-groom'.

**(b)** @deva[सूर्य] has @deva[सूर्या] 'the divine wife of Surya;' but @deva[सौरी] i.e. @deva[कुन्ती] who was a mortal.

---

[^1]: @deva[स्त्रियोगादाख्यायाम्] । Pāṇ. IV. 1. 48. @deva[पालकान्ताच्] । Vārtika. @deva[सूर्योदेवतायां चाप् वाच्य:] । Vārtika.

rules.title: Insertion of आन् Before ई
rules.body:
The words @deva[इन्द्र], @deva[वरुण], @deva[भव], @deva[शर्व], @deva[रुद्र], @deva[मृड], and @deva[आचार्य]. @deva[हिम] and @deva[अरण्य] both implying 'vastness'; @deva[यव] meaning 'bad or spoiled barley', @deva[यवन] when the feminine denotes the alphabet of the Yavanas, @deva[मातुल] and @deva[आचार्य] form their fem in @deva[ई] but insert @deva[आन्] before this @deva[ई][^1] e.g. @deva[इन्द्राणी] 'the wife of Indra;' @deva[वरुणाणी] 'the wife of Varuṇa', &c.; @deva[हिमानी] 'a vast sheet of ice,' @deva[अरण्यानी] 'an immense expanse of forests,' @deva[दुषो यवो यवानी], @deva[यवनानी लिपिविशयानी], but @deva[यवनी] 'the wife of a Yavana or Yavana woman;' @deva[आचार्याणी] (and not @deva[णी])[^2] 'the wife of an Achārya or a holy teacher', but @deva[आचार्या] 'a woman who teaches; a spiritual preceptress'.

**(a)** The words @deva[मातुल]-and @deva[उपाध्याय] insert this @deva[आन्] optionally;[^3] @deva[मातुलानी मातुली]; @deva[उपाध्यायानी], @deva[उपाध्यायी]; 'the wife of a preceptor,' but @deva[उपाध्यायी] or @deva[उपाध्याया] 'a female preceptor', 'a woman who herself performs the work of an @deva[उपाध्याय]'; in the case of @deva[अर्य] and @deva[क्षत्रिय], @deva[आन्] is optionally inserted before the @deva[ई], when no wife is meant: @deva[अर्यी—अर्यानी], 'a mistress or a woman of the Vaisya or trader class', @deva[क्षत्रिया], @deva[क्षत्रियाणी] 'a woman of the Kshatriya or warrior class', @deva[अर्यी] 'the wife of a Vaishya'; @deva[क्षत्रियी] 'the wife of a Kshatriya.'

---

[^1]: @deva[इन्द्रवरुणभवशर्वरुद्रमृडाचार्याणाम्] । Pāṇ. IV. 1. 49, @deva[हिमारण्ययोर्महत्वे] । @deva[यवनानें] । @deva[यवनानी लिप्याम्] । Vārtikas.

[^2]: @deva[आचार्याणीपुत्रस्य च] । Vārtika.

[^3]: @deva[मातुलोपाध्याययोस्तदर्थे वा] । @deva[या तु स्वयमेवाध्यापिका तत्र वा स्त्रीत्व वाच्य:] । @deva[अर्यक्षत्रियाभ्यां वा स्त्रार्थे] । Vārtikas.

rules.title: Feminine ई for Class and Kind
rules.body:
Nouns ending in @deva[अ] and not having @deva[य] for their penultimate, except @deva[हय], @deva[गवय] a wild ox, @deva[शुक्रय], @deva[मनुष्य] and @deva[मत्स्य] take @deva[ई] when 'class' is implied[^1] e. g. @deva[शूद्री] 'A Sudra female' (also the wife of a @deva[शूद्र], see @ref[311]. above); similarly @deva[माद्रवी], @deva[महाराष्ट्री], &c., @deva[हरिणी], @deva[दृष्टी], @deva[औरणी] 'a woman of the @deva[औपव] class of Brāhmaṇas,' @deva[कटी] 'a woman of the @deva[कट] class of Brāhmaṇas', &c., @deva[हयी]; @deva[गवयी], @deva[शुक्रयी], @deva[मनुषी], and @deva[मत्सी] (vide @ref[306]. d.); but @deva[देवदत्ता] 'a woman of that name'; @deva[अश्वा] as it is one of the words included in the Ajādi group; (see @ref[307]. and foot-note); @deva[शूद्रा] 'a woman of the Śūdra class (see @ref[307] above).'

**(a)** Words ending in @deva[पाक], @deva[कूर्च], @deva[पर्ण], @deva[पुष्प], @deva[फल], @deva[मूल] and @deva[वाल] form their fem. in @deva[ई] when kind is implied; @deva[कोदनपाकी], @deva[शङ्कुकूर्ची], @deva[कालपर्णी], @deva[शिंशुपर्णी], @deva[दाशीफली], @deva[दर्भमूली] and @deva[गोवाली] all names of particular herbs.

**(b)** Also words ending in @deva[त] and denoting mankind;[^2] @deva[दाक्षी] 'a woman of the @deva[दाक्षि] family,' @deva[औदमेयी] (@deva[उदमेयगणपठितम्]), but @deva[तिमिनिः].

---

[^1]: @deva[जातेरस्त्रीविषयादयोपधात्] । Pāṇ IV. 1. 63. @deva[गोपयप्रभृतिभ्यो हयगवयशुक्रयमनुष्यमत्स्यानाम्] । Vārtika. @deva[पाककूर्चपर्णपुष्पफलमूलवालोत्तरपदाच्च] ।

[^2]: @deva[तितो मनुष्यजातेः] । Pāṇ. IV. 1. 64. 65.

rules.title: Feminine of Color Words
rules.body:
Prātipadikas expressive of colour, having @deva[न] for their penultimate and ending in an Anudātta vowel, except @deva[आसित] black and @deva[पलित] grey, and the word @deva[पिङ्ग] form their feminine in @deva[ई] or @deva[आ]; @deva[एता] or @deva[एती] 'variegated' from @deva[एत]; @deva[रोहिता], @deva[रोहिती]; @deva[पिङ्गी-पिङ्गा]; but @deva[आसिता], @deva[पलिता], @deva[श्वेता] ( as the @deva[त] here is Udātta ).

**(a)** But if the Prātipadika has no @deva[न] for its penultimate, it simply takes @deva[ई]; @deva[कल्माषी] variegated, @deva[सारङ्गी]; but @deva[कृष्णा कपिला] ( as the last vowels are not Anudātta ).

rules.title: नारी and Shārṅgaravādi Group
rules.body: The Feminine of @deva[नृ] and @deva[नर] is @deva[नारी] and that of words included in the Shārṅgaravādi ( @deva[शार्ङ्गरवादिगण] ) group is formed by adding @deva[ई]; as @deva[शार्ङ्गरवी], @deva[गौतमी], @deva[आतिथेयी], @deva[आश्रौकेयी], @deva[वैद्यी], @deva[पुत्री], &c.

rules.title: Irregular Feminine of Relationship Words
