## THIRD OR @deva[जुहोत्यादि] CLASS.

rules.title: Third Class Formation - Reduplication and न Dropping
rules.body:
(a) The base is formed by reduplication of the root.

(b) The third personal plural termination loses its @deva[न].

(c) The Imperfect third person plural termination is @deva[उस्] (P.), before which the final @deva[आ] of roots is dropped and the final @deva[इ], @deva[उ] and @deva[ऋ], short or long, are guṇated.

**Rules of Reduplication:—**

rules.title: Reduplication - First Vowel with Initial Consonant
rules.body:
The first vowel of a root together with the initial consonant, if any, is reduplicated i. e. doubled; as @deva[पत्]=@deva[पपत्], @deva[उत्]=@deva[उउत्], &c. after reduplication.

**Note**—The first syllable of a reduplicated root is called 'the reduplicative syllable; e. g. the first @deva[प] in @deva[पपत्], or first @deva[उ] in @deva[उउत्].

rules.title: Reduplication of Conjunct Consonants
rules.body:
If a conjunct consonant begins a root, the first consonant only with the following vowel is reduplicated; e. g. @deva[प्रच्छ्]=@deva[पप्रच्छ्].

**(:)** If the first member of a conjunct consonant, however, be a sibilant (@deva[श], @deva[ष] or @deva[स]) and the second a hard consonant, the hard consonant is reduplicated. @deva[स्तुभ्]=@deva[तुष्टुभ्]; @deva[स्कन्द्]=@deva[चस्कन्द्]; but @deva[स्वन्]=@deva[सुस्वन्] &c.

rules.title: Aspirates Become Unaspirates in Reduplicative Syllable
rules.body: A radical aspirate (2nd or 4th letter of a class) is changed to its corresponding unaspirate in the reduplicative syllable; as @deva[चित्]=@deva[चिचित्], @deva[धूह्]=@deva[दुधूह्], @deva[भुज्]=@deva[बुभुज्], &c.

rules.title: Gutturals to Palatals and ह to ज in Reduplicative Syllable
rules.body: The guttural of the reduplicative syllable is changed to the corresponding palatal (subject to the above rule) and @deva[ह] to @deva[ज]; e. g. @deva[कृ]=@deva[चकृ]; @deva[गम्]=@deva[जगम्]; @deva[पवि]=@deva[तिपवि]; @deva[सक्त्]=@deva[तसक्त्]=@deva[चसक्त्], @deva[हृणु] &c.

rules.title: Long Vowels Shortened and ऋ to अ in Reduplicative Syllable
rules.body: A radical long vowel becomes short and @deva[ऋ] is changed to @deva[अ] in the reduplicative syllable; as @deva[पा]=@deva[पपा], @deva[वी]=@deva[विवी], @deva[धू]=@deva[दुधू] &c.

rules.title: Penultimate Vowel Changes and Third Class Paradigms
rules.body:
The penultimate @deva[ए] or @deva[ऐ] and @deva[ओ] or @deva[औ] become @deva[इ] and @deva[उ] respectively in the reduplicative syllable; @deva[सेव्]-@deva[सिषेव्], @deva[ढौक्]-@deva[डुढौक्], &c.

rules.title: Specific Roots with इ in Reduplicative Syllable
rules.body: The vowel of the roots @deva[मा], @deva[हा] 'to go' @deva[धू], @deva[घु] or @deva[धु] 'to fill' and @deva[दो] is changed to @deva[इ] in the reduplicative syllable.

rules.title: निज्, विच्, विश् with Guṇa in Reduplicative Syllable
rules.body: The @deva[इ] of the reduplicative syllable of @deva[निज्], @deva[विच्] and @deva[विश्], takes its Guṇa substitute before all terminations and the radical @deva[इ] is not guṇated before vowel strong terminations.

rules.title: दा and धा Dropping आ After Reduplication
rules.body: @deva[दा] and @deva[धा] drop their @deva[आ] after reduplication before weak terminations; @deva[दध्] becomes @deva[घद्] before @deva[स्], @deva[ध्व], @deva[त] and @deva[थ]. The Par. Imperative 2 per. singulars are @deva[देहि] and @deva[धेहि] respectively.

rules.title: भी, मा, हा with Special Base Forms
rules.body:
@deva[भी] optionally shortens its vowel before consonantal weak terminations.

(a) @deva[मा] and @deva[हा] 'to go' assume the forms @deva[मिम्] and @deva[जिह्] before vowel terminations and @deva[मिमो] and @deva[जिहो] before consonantal terminations.

rules.title: Complete Third Class Paradigms and हा 'to abandon'
rules.body:
@deva[हा] 'to abandon' assumes the forms @deva[जहि] or @deva[जहो] before consonantal weak terminations except in the Pot. and @deva[जह्] before vowel terminations and those of the Pot. The Imp. 2 sing. forms are @deva[जहाहि], @deva[जहिहि] and @deva[जहोहि].

## SEVENTH OR @deva[रुधादि] CLASS.

rules.title: Seventh Class Formation - Insertion of न and ण
rules.body: In this class the base is formed by inserting @deva[न] between the radical vowel and the final consonant before the strong and @deva[ण] before the weak terminations.

rules.title: Complete Seventh Class Paradigms
rules.body:
(a) The original nasal of a root is dropped.

(b) In the case of the root @deva[भुज्], @deva[व] is changed to @deva[उ] before consonantal strong terminations.

## II. GENERAL OR NON-CONJUGATIONAL TENSES AND MOODS.

rules.title: Introduction to General Tenses - Seṭ, Veṭ, Aniṭ Roots
rules.body: In the General Tenses and Moods and in the formation of verbal derivatives generally, the augment @deva[इ] is prefixed (necessarily or optionally) to terminations beginning with any consonant except @deva[य] in the case of certain roots. Such roots as take the augment @deva[इ] necessarily are called Seṭ (@deva[स]+@deva[इट्] i. e. with @deva[इ]); such as take it optionally are called Veṭ (@deva[वा]+@deva[इट्]), and those that do not, are called Aniṭ (@deva[अन्]+@deva[इट्] i. e. without @deva[इ]).

rules.title: Classification of Seṭ, Veṭ, and Aniṭ Roots
Roots Ending in इ, ऋ, ओ Treated as अय
rules.body: Roots ending in @deva[इ], @deva[ऋ], and @deva[ओ] are to be treated as roots ending in @deva[अय]. Also roots of @deva[त्री] 3 Â. 'to kill,' @deva[सि] 4 Â. 'to perish,' before a termination causing Guṇa or Vṛddhi; @deva[सि] 9 P. 4 Â. 'to adhere or cling to' changes its vowel to @deva[अय] optionally under the same circumstances.

rules.title: Tenth Class Roots Preserving अय in General Tenses
rules.body: Roots of the tenth class preserve their @deva[अय] (i. e. @deva[अय] with the final @deva[अ] dropped) with all the changes that the root undergoes before @deva[अय] in the general tenses.

rules.title: Roots Preserving Conjugational Bases Optionally
rules.body: The roots @deva[मय], @deva[पय], @deva[विच्छु], @deva[पचू], @deva[पज़], @deva[कम], and @deva[कत्] preserve their conjugational bases optionally.

rules.title: अच् and णि Substitutions
rules.body: @deva[अच्] and @deva[णि] substitute for themselves @deva[ऐ] and @deva[ऐच्] respectively.

rules.title: Sixth Class Roots Without Guṇa/Vṛddhi
rules.body:
Neither Guṇa nor Vṛddhi is substituted for the vowel of a few roots of the 6th class even before a strong termination except the @deva[स्य] of the 1st and 3rd person sing. of the Perfect, the @deva[सीय] of the causal and the @deva[स्य] of the 3rd pers. sing. of the Passive Aorist. These are @deva[इच्], @deva[युच्], @deva[इच्छ], @deva[वच्], @deva[व्यच्], @deva[स्वर्], @deva[स्पृश्], @deva[मृश्], @deva[स्पृश्], @deva[यश्], @deva[वि], @deva[वु], @deva[कु]; and a few more not often to be met with.[^1]

[^1]: These couplets as well as those bearing on the 2nd variety of the Aorist are composed by Mr. Chintāmaṇa Ātmārām Kelkar, one of the learned Śāstris of the Poona Training College.

rules.title: प्रच्छ् Assuming Forms पृच्छ् and पच्छ्
rules.body: The root @deva[प्रच्छ्] assumes the forms @deva[पृच्छ्] and @deva[पच्छ्] in the Non-conjugational Tenses.

rules.title: मुच् and लुप् Changing अ to य
rules.body: The penultimate @deva[अ] of @deva[मुच्] and @deva[लुप्] is changed to @deva[य] before a consonantal strong termination in the General Tenses.

rules.title: Weak Intermediate इ in सिञ्च् and ऋच्
rules.body: The intermediate @deva[इ] is weak in the case of the root @deva[सिञ्च्] 6. Â. 7 P.; and optionally so in the case of @deva[ऋच्].

rules.title: सिच् and चेङ् Without Guṇa/Vṛddhi and Introduction to Two Futures
rules.body:
The roots @deva[सिच्] 2 Â. 'to shine' and @deva[चेङ्] 2 Â. 'to go' do not take Guṇa or Vṛddhi before any termination. They also drop their final vowel before the intermediate @deva[इ] and @deva[य]. @deva[दरिद्रा] also drops its @deva[आ] before a non-conjugational termination except in the Desiderative and the Aorist where it retains it optionally.

---

## The Two Futures and Conditional.

## (1) First Future (@deva[लृट्])

Also called Periphrastic Future.

rules.title: First Future Terminations
rules.body:
**Terminations:—**[^1]

| | Parasm. | | | Ātm. | | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | S. | D. | P. | S. | D. | P. |
| 1. | @deva[तास्मि] | @deva[तास्वः] | @deva[तास्मः] | @deva[ताहे] | @deva[तास्वहे] | @deva[तास्महे] |
| 2. | @deva[तासि] | @deva[तास्यः] | @deva[तास्थ] | @deva[तासे] | @deva[तासाथे] | @deva[तास्ध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[ता] | @deva[तारौ] | @deva[तारः] | @deva[ता] | @deva[तारौ] | @deva[तारः] |

[^1]: The forms of the First Future may be derived by adding to the Nom. sing. of the noun of agency derived with the affix @deva[तृ] the forms of the Present Tense of the root @deva[अस्] 'to be' in the 1st and 2nd persons. The forms of the Nom. are the forms of the 3rd pers.

rules.title: Augment इ Before First Future Terminations
rules.body: To these terminations the augment @deva[इ] is prefixed in the case of Seṭ roots, optionally in the case of Veṭ roots, and not affixed at all in that of Aniṭ roots.

rules.title: First Future Terminations Are Strong
rules.body: All these terminations are strong. The final vowel and the penultimate vowel of a root therefore take their Guṇa substitute before them.

rules.title: First Future Forms and Examples
rules.body:
Aniṭ roots with a penultimate @deva[अ] change it to @deva[आ] optionally before a strong termination beginning with any consonant except a nasal or a semi-vowel; @deva[सू]—@deva[सोतासि], @deva[सोतासि] &c.

## @deva[दा] P. Â. 'to give &c.,'

| | Par. | | | Ātm. | | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | S. | D. | P. | S. | D. | P. |
| 1. | @deva[दातास्मि] | @deva[दातास्वः] | @deva[दातास्मः] | @deva[दाताहे] | @deva[दातास्वहे] | @deva[दातास्महे] |
| 2. | @deva[दातासि] | @deva[दातास्यः] | @deva[दातास्थ] | @deva[दातासे] | @deva[दाताथे] | @deva[दातास्ध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[दाता] | @deva[दातारौ] | @deva[दातारः] | @deva[दाता] | @deva[दातारौ] | @deva[दातारः] |

@deva[नी] P. Â. 'carry'—@deva[नेतास्मि], @deva[नेतास्यः], @deva[नेतास्मः] &c., @deva[नेताहे], @deva[नेतास्वहे], @deva[नेतास्महे], &c.

@deva[पत्] P.—@deva[पतितास्मि], @deva[पतितास्यः], @deva[पतितास्मः] &c.

@deva[ईश्] Â.—@deva[ईशिताहे], @deva[ईशितास्वहे], @deva[ईशितास्महे] &c.

**Irregular Bases.**

rules.title: Roots Admitting इ Optionally in First Future
rules.body: The roots @deva[भू], @deva[कृष्] 1 Â., @deva[श्रु], @deva[धिय] and @deva[वद्] admit @deva[इ] optionally in the First Future; e. g. 1 sing. @deva[भवितासि], @deva[भविष्यासि], @deva[श्रुतासि], @deva[शेष्यासि], @deva[सृजिताहे], @deva[शोचाहे]; @deva[लोभितासि], @deva[लोप्स्यासि]; @deva[रवितासि], @deva[रेष्यासि]; @deva[वदिष्यति], @deva[वक्तासि].

rules.title: कुप् Optionally Parasmaipada and Rejecting इ
rules.body: @deva[कुप्] is optionally Parasm. in the First Future and when so it rejects @deva[इ]: @deva[कोपितासि], @deva[कोप्तासि]; @deva[कोपिताहे] 1 sing. &c.

rules.title: सह् with Long Augment इ
rules.body: The augment @deva[इ] as added to @deva[सह्] is long in all Non-conjugational Tenses, except in the Perfect; @deva[सहीतासि] 1 sing.

rules.title: Optional Lengthening of Intermediate इ
rules.body: The intermediate @deva[इ] is optionally lengthened in the case of @deva[घु] and roots ending in @deva[अ], except in the Perfect, the Benedictive Âtm. and the Aorist Par.; @deva[वर]—@deva[वरितासि], @deva[वरीतासि], 1 sing. @deva[धा]—@deva[धरितासि], @deva[धारीतासि] 1 sing.

rules.title: Insertion of त for मस्, नश्, पुरु, दिवु
rules.body: @deva[त] is inserted before the ending consonant of the root @deva[मस्] before which @deva[स] is dropped, and after the vowel of @deva[नश्], @deva[पुरु] and @deva[दिवु] followed by any consonant except a nasal or a semi-vowel: @deva[मग्धासि] &c.; @deva[नत्तासि], @deva[मंस्तासि]. The @deva[स] of @deva[मस्] is changed to @deva[य] when not dropped.

rules.title: गै Substitution for अञ्च् and Introduction to Second Future
Second Future Terminations
rules.body:
**Terminations of the Second Future:—**[^1]

| | Parasm. | | | Ātmane | | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | S. | D. | P. | S. | D. | P. |
| 1. | @deva[स्यामि] | @deva[स्यावः] | @deva[स्यामः] | @deva[स्ये] | @deva[स्यावहे] | @deva[स्यामहे] |
| 2. | @deva[स्यसि] | @deva[स्यथः] | @deva[स्यथ] | @deva[स्यसे] | @deva[स्येथे] | @deva[स्यध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[स्यति] | @deva[स्यतः] | @deva[स्यन्ति] | @deva[स्यते] | @deva[स्येते] | @deva[स्यन्ते] |

[^1]: These terminations, it will be seen, are obtained by adding to the Present tense @deva[स्य] or @deva[स्य] the suffixes mentioned before which @deva[ष्] and @deva[य] are dropped before a vowel.

rules.title: Conditional Terminations
rules.body:
**Terminations of the Conditional:—**[^1]

| | Parasm. | | | Ātmane | | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | S. | D. | P. | S. | D. | P. |
| 1. | @deva[स्यम्] | @deva[स्याव] | @deva[स्याम] | @deva[स्ये] | @deva[स्यावहि] | @deva[स्यामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[स्यः] | @deva[स्यतम्] | @deva[स्यत] | @deva[स्यथाः] | @deva[स्येथाम्] | @deva[स्यध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[स्यत्] | @deva[स्यताम्] | @deva[स्यन्] | @deva[स्यत] | @deva[स्येताम्] | @deva[स्यन्त] |

[^1]: These are obtained similarly by adding the terminations of the Imperfect to @deva[स्य] the usual rules of Sandhi being observed.

rules.title: Substitution of इ for Ending स of Root
rules.body: @deva[इ] is substituted for the ending @deva[स] of a root when followed by any non-conjugational termination beginning with a consonant.

rules.title: Augment इ in Second Future and Conditional
rules.body:
## Augment @deva[इ] in Second Future and Conditional

@deva[इ] is to be prefixed, or not, or optionally to the terminations given above, according as the root is @deva[सेट्] (@[Seṭ]) or @deva[अनिट्] (@[Aniṭ]) or @deva[वेट्] (@[Veṭ]). Before the terminations the final vowel and the penultimate vowel take their @deva[गुण] (@[Guṇa]) substitute.

rules.title: Augment अ in Conditional and Paradigms
rules.body:
## Augment @deva[अ] in Conditional and Paradigms

In the Conditional the augment @deva[अ] is prefixed to the root as in the Imperfect.

Paradigms.

**Second Future**

| | @deva[शक्] 5 P. | | | @deva[लभ्] P. 1 Â. | | |

| 1. | @deva[शक्ष्यामि] | @deva[शक्ष्यावः] | @deva[शक्ष्यामः] | @deva[लप्स्ये] | @deva[लप्स्यावहे] | @deva[लप्स्यामहे] |
| 2. | @deva[शक्ष्यसि] | @deva[शक्ष्यथः] | @deva[शक्ष्यथ] | @deva[लप्स्यसे] | @deva[लप्स्येथे] | @deva[लप्स्यध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[शक्ष्यति] | @deva[शक्ष्यतः] | @deva[शक्ष्यन्ति] | @deva[लप्स्यते] | @deva[लप्स्येते] | @deva[लप्स्यन्ते] |

| 1. | @deva[अशक्ष्यम्] | @deva[अशक्ष्याव] | @deva[अशक्ष्याम] | @deva[अलप्स्ये] | @deva[अलप्स्यावहि] | @deva[अलप्स्यामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अशक्ष्यः] | @deva[अशक्ष्यतम्] | @deva[अशक्ष्यत] | @deva[अलप्स्यथाः] | @deva[अलप्स्येथाम्] | @deva[अलप्स्यध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[अशक्ष्यत्] | @deva[अशक्ष्यताम्] | @deva[अशक्ष्यन्] | @deva[अलप्स्यत] | @deva[अलप्स्येताम्] | @deva[अलप्स्यन्त] |

@deva[मुद्]—@deva[मुदिष्याम]—@deva[स्ये]; @deva[अमुदिष्यम्]—@deva[ये] &c.

Irregular Bases

rules.title: Admission of इ by गम्, हन् and Aniṭ Roots
rules.body:
## Admission of @deva[इ] by @deva[गम्], @deva[हन्] and Aniṭ Roots

@deva[गम्] P. @deva[हन्] and @deva[अनिट्] (@[Aniṭ]) roots ending in @deva[अ] admit @deva[इ] in the Second Future and the Conditional; @deva[गम्] P. (also @deva[गा] substituted for @deva[इ] 'to go' and @deva[अध्यै] with @deva[अधि] 'to remember') also admits it in the Desiderative. @deva[गमिष्याम], @deva[हनिष्याम], @deva[करिष्याम], &c. Sec. Fut. 1 sing. @deva[अगमिष्यम्], @deva[अकरिष्यम्], @deva[अहनिष्यम्], &c. Cond. 1 sing.

rules.title: Optional Parasmaipada for कल्प्, वृत्, वृध्, शुभ्, स्पन्द्
rules.body:
## Optional Parasmaipada for @deva[कल्प्], @deva[वृत्], @deva[वृध्], @deva[शुभ्], @deva[स्पन्द्]

The roots @deva[कल्प्], @deva[वृत्], @deva[वृध्], @deva[शुभ्] and @deva[स्पन्द्] optionally take Parasmaipada terminations in the Second Future, Conditional and the Desiderative. They reject the augment @deva[इ] when Parasmaipadi; @deva[कल्पिष्ये], @deva[कल्प्स्याम]; @deva[कल्प्स्याम]; @deva[वर्तिष्ये], @deva[वर्त्स्याम]; @deva[वर्धिष्ये], @deva[वर्त्स्याम]; @deva[वर्धिष्ये], @deva[वर्त्स्याम]; @deva[स्पन्दिष्ये], @deva[स्पन्द्स्याम] 1 sing. 2nd Fut.; @deva[अकल्पिष्ये], @deva[अकल्प्स्याम]; @deva[अवर्धिष्यम्], @deva[अवर्त्स्याम]; @deva[अवर्तिष्ये], @deva[अवर्त्स्याम]; @deva[अवर्त्स्ये]; @deva[अस्पन्दिष्ये], @deva[अस्पन्द्स्याम], @deva[अस्पन्द्स्याम] 1. sing. Cond.

rules.title: Optional इ before Ārdhadhātuka with स
rules.body:
## Optional @deva[इ] before Ārdhadhātuka with @deva[स]

The roots @deva[कृत्], @deva[वृत्], @deva[गृध्], @deva[वृध्] and @deva[वृश्] take @deva[इ] optionally when followed by an Ārdhadhātuka (Non-conjugational termination) beginning with @deva[स] except in the Aorist; @deva[कृत्]—@deva[कर्तिष्याम], @deva[कर्त्स्याम]; @deva[अकर्तिष्यम्], @deva[अकर्त्स्याम] Cond. &c.

rules.title: Substitution of गा and इ in Specific Roots
rules.body:
## Substitution of @deva[गा] and @deva[इ] in Specific Roots

In the case of @deva[इ] with @deva[अधि], @deva[गा] is optionally substituted for @deva[इ] in the Conditional and the Aorist. @deva[इ] is substituted for the final vowel of the verbs @deva[च्या] 3 P. Â. 1 P., @deva[प्रा], @deva[दो], @deva[ते], @deva[धे], @deva[मा], @deva[स्था], @deva[भा] (substituted for @deva[इ] 2 P. and @deva[स्था] with @deva[अधि],) @deva[म्ला], @deva[मा], and @deva[को] before a consonantal weak termination. All terminations added to @deva[मा] substituted for @deva[इ] are weak.

rules.title: Two Kinds of Perfect
rules.body:
## Two Kinds of Perfect

There are two kinds of Perfect, Reduplicative and Periphrastic.

rules.title: Reduplicative Perfect Formation
rules.body:
## Reduplicative Perfect Formation

The Reduplicative Perfect is formed of all monosyllabic roots beginning with consonants, as well as of those beginning with the vowels @deva[अ] or @deva[आ], and @deva[ऋ], @deva[ऌ]; and @deva[ए] short.

Exceptions—@deva[ऊह्], @deva[अस्], @deva[कास्], @deva[आस्]. These take the Periphrastic Perfect necessarily.

rules.title: Periphrastic Perfect Formation
rules.body:
## Periphrastic Perfect Formation

The Periphrastic Perfect is formed of all roots beginning with any vowel except @deva[अ] or @deva[आ] which is naturally or prosodially long, and of roots of more than one syllable (roots of the 10th class and other derivative roots included). Exceptions:—@deva[ऊड्] and @deva[चक्ष्] which take the Reduplicative Perfects.

rules.title: Roots Taking Both Perfects
rules.body:
## Roots Taking Both Perfects

The roots @deva[ऊह्], @deva[विदू], @deva[जाग्], @deva[पै], @deva[ई], @deva[धू], @deva[व], and @deva[दरिद्रा] take both the perfects.

The Reduplicative Perfect.

rules.title: Reduplication in Perfect Tense
rules.body:
## Reduplication in Perfect Tense

The root is reduplicated according to the rules laid down in @ref[444]—@ref[449].

rules.title: Perfect Tense Terminations
rules.body:
## Perfect Tense Terminations

**Terminations.**

**Parasmaipada:**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अ] | @deva[व] | @deva[म] |
| 2. | @deva[थ] | @deva[अथुः] | @deva[अ] |
| 3. | @deva[अ] | @deva[अतुः] | @deva[उः] |

**Ātmanepada:**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[ए] | @deva[वहे] | @deva[महे] |
| 2. | @deva[से] | @deva[आथे] | @deva[ध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[ए] | @deva[आते] | @deva[इरे] |

rules.title: Strong and Weak Terminations in Perfect
rules.body:
## Strong and Weak Terminations in Perfect

The Parasmaipada singular terminations are strong; the rest weak. Before the strong terminations the penultimate short vowel takes its @deva[गुण] (@[Guṇa]) substitute. The final vowel and penultimate @deva[अ] take @deva[वृद्धि] (@[Vṛddhi]) necessarily in the third and optionally in the first person singular. In the 2nd person singular the final vowel takes @deva[गुण] (@[Guṇa]) and the penultimate @deva[अ] remains unchanged.

rules.title: Admission of Intermediate इ before Terminations
rules.body:
## Admission of Intermediate @deva[इ] before Terminations

Special rules about the admission of the intermediate @deva[इ] before the terminations @deva[व], @deva[म], @deva[वहे], @deva[से], @deva[वहे], @deva[महे]; see (@ref[457]).

(a) All @deva[सेट्] (@[Seṭ]) roots admit it, whether @deva[सेट्] (@[seṭ]) or @deva[अनिट्] (@[aniṭ]), except @deva[ई], @deva[ऊ], @deva[ऋ], @deva[लृ], @deva[हु], @deva[वृ]; @deva[वृ], @deva[ग्रु], @deva[क्षु], permit @deva[इ] or @deva[अ]; But @deva[इ] with @deva[सम्], and @deva[वृ] admit it only as @deva[सचक्रिव], @deva[ववरिव].

(b) @deva[अनिट्] (@[Aniṭ]) roots ending in short @deva[अ], except @deva[अव्], reject it before @deva[व]; as @deva[तस्थिव] from @deva[स्था]; but @deva[आरिव] from @deva[ऋ].

(c) @deva[अनिट्] (@[Aniṭ]) roots with a final vowel or with a penultimate @deva[अ] admit it optionally before @deva[व].

rules.title: Reduplicative इ and उ Changes
rules.body:
## Reduplicative @deva[इ] and @deva[उ] Changes

When initial @deva[इ] or @deva[उ] of a root takes @deva[गुण] (@[Guṇa]) or @deva[वृद्धि] (@[Vṛddhi]) substitute, the reduplicative @deva[इ] or @deva[उ] is changed to @deva[इय] or @deva[उव]; otherwise the two vowels combine to form long @deva[ई] or @deva[ऊ]; as @deva[इ]→@deva[इयेश]=@deva[इयेश], @deva[ऊ]→@deva[उवोच]=@deva[ऊचोच]; @deva[ईविध], &c.

rules.title: Final ऋ and ई Changes before Weak Terminations
rules.body:
## Final @deva[ऋ] and @deva[ई] Changes before Weak Terminations

The final @deva[ऋ], short or long, is changed to @deva[अर] before a vowel weak termination and @deva[ई] to @deva[इय] or @deva[य] as it is preceded by a conjunct consonant or not; as @deva[ऋ]→@deva[अर]→@deva[इरुव] ! dual; @deva[तितिर्]+@deva[इरे]=@deva[तितिरिरे], @deva[लिभिर्]+@deva[इरे]=@deva[लिभिरिरे], &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[इण्वाडुशदुसृक्रूढ्वाम् लिटि।] Pāṇ. VII. 2. 13. @deva[अन्तादून्तोऽनुपदस्यादादिते पूर्वः वेध्यति। सेदात् इदेदीनवार्चिकेनादैव कामात्मो लिटि परैव परे॥] (Sid. Kau.)

rules.title: Roots Ending in आ in Perfect
rules.body:
## Roots Ending in @deva[आ] in Perfect

Roots ending in @deva[आ] take @deva[औ] instead of @deva[आ] in the 1st and 3rd per. sing. and drop their final @deva[आ] before vowel weak terminations, and before such as take the augment @deva[इ]; as @deva[ददौ], @deva[दद्विव], @deva[दद्विम] 1st Per. @deva[ददौ], @deva[दद्व] 2. Per. sing. of @deva[दा].

rules.title: Guṇa Substitution for Final Vowels in Perfect
rules.body:
## Guṇa Substitution for Final Vowels in Perfect

@deva[गुण] (@[Guṇa]) is substituted for the final vowel of roots ending in @deva[ऋ] preceded by a conjunct consonant, and in long @deva[ऋ] and of the roots @deva[ऋ], @deva[चक्ष्] and @deva[जाग्]; as @deva[तस्तरिव] 1 dual of @deva[स्तृ], &c. @deva[ऐकृव] 1 dual of @deva[कृ]; @deva[ववक्षिव] 2 sing. of @deva[वक्ष्]; @deva[रुरुव] 1st dual of @deva[रु]; @deva[सुषुप्व], @deva[शुश्रुविव] 1 dual of @deva[स्वप्] &c. weak terminations, and shorten their vowel when they do not; as @deva[शशरिव], @deva[शुश्रुविव] 1 dual of @deva[शृ], &c.

rules.title: Monosyllabic Roots with Penultimate अ
rules.body:
## Monosyllabic Roots with Penultimate @deva[अ]

Monosyllabic roots, having a short @deva[अ] for their penultimate, change it to @deva[इ] and drop the reduplicative syllable before the weak terminations and before @deva[व] when it takes @deva[इ], provided their initial letter undergoes no change in the reduplication, e. g. @deva[पत्] 1st dual @deva[पेतुव्]+@deva[इव]=@deva[पेत्]+@deva[इव]=@deva[पेतिव], @deva[पेतिव] 2 sing. @deva[शक्ष्व], @deva[शसक्ष्व] 2. sing. of @deva[शक्], but @deva[निनेश्व] 2nd dual of @deva[नन्द्] as the @deva[अ] here is prosodially long.

Exceptions:—Roots beginning with @deva[व] and the roots @deva[शास्] and @deva[ग्रस्].

rules.title: Insertion of त after Reduplicative Syllable
rules.body:
## Insertion of @deva[त] after Reduplicative Syllable

@deva[त] is inserted after the reduplicative syllable in the case of roots beginning with @deva[अ] and ending in a conjunct consonant, in that of @deva[अह्] 'to pervade' and @deva[चक्ष्] 'to go'; consequently @deva[अ] after @deva[त] is changed to @deva[आ]; @deva[अञ्ज्] @deva[अनज्]+@deva[अ]=@deva[आनज्]+@deva[अ]+@deva[अ]=@deva[आनञ्ज], similarly @deva[आनन्द] 1 sing. of @deva[अन्द्], @deva[आनर्द] of @deva[अर्द्], &c.

rules.title: Samprasāraṇa in Perfect Tense
rules.body:
## Samprasāraṇa in Perfect Tense

The change of a semi-vowel to its corresponding vowel is called @deva[सम्प्रसारण] (@[Samprasāraṇa]). Samprasāraṇa generally takes place before weak terminations in the case of the following roots:—@deva[वद्], @deva[वस्], @deva[शप्], @deva[वच्], @deva[स्वप्], @deva[वह्], @deva[यज्], @deva[वञ्च्], @deva[वै], @deva[वष्], @deva[व्यध्], @deva[दो], @deva[स्मृ], @deva[वप्], @deva[भज्], @deva[स्वञ्ज्], @deva[भञ्ज्], @deva[ग्रह्], @deva[सह्] and @deva[स्वप्]. In the Perfect the roots @deva[मध्यू], @deva[द्रक्षु] and @deva[मध्य] form an exception.

rules.title: Samprasāraṇa in Reduplicative Syllable
rules.body:
## Samprasāraṇa in Reduplicative Syllable

Before the strong terminations of the Perfect Samprasāraṇa takes place in the reduplicative syllable only. In this case the initial conjunct consonant of a root is reduplicated as it is; i. e. without Samprasāraṇa; as

(a) The vowel following the Samprasāraṇa is dropped.

rules.title: Roots Rejecting इ in Perfect
rules.body:
## Roots Rejecting @deva[इ] in Perfect

The roots that reject @deva[इ] altogether in the Perfect—

**@deva[कृ] P. Â. 'to do'**

**Parasmaipada:**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[चकार], @deva[चकर] | @deva[चक्रव] | @deva[चक्रम] |
| 2. | @deva[चकर्थ] | @deva[चक्रथुः] | @deva[चक्र] |
| 3. | @deva[चकार] | @deva[चक्रतुः] | @deva[चक्रुः] |

**Ātmanepada:**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[चक्रे] | @deva[चक्रवहे] | @deva[चक्रमहे] |
| 2. | @deva[चक्रिषे] | @deva[चक्राथे] | @deva[चक्रध्वे][^3] |
| 3. | @deva[चक्रे] | @deva[चक्राते] | @deva[चक्रिरे] |

Conjugate similarly @deva[धु], @deva[वु], and @deva[ई] except in the 2nd per. sing. which is @deva[वर्धिथ].

**But @deva[इ] with @deva[सम्][^1]**

**Parasmaipada:**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[सचकार] | @deva[सचक्रविव][^2] | @deva[सचक्रविम] |
| | @deva[समक्रम्] | | @deva[समक्रन्] |
| 2. | @deva[सचक्रिथ] | @deva[सचक्रथुः] | @deva[सचक्र] |
| 3. | @deva[सचकार] | @deva[सचक्रतुः] | @deva[सचक्रुः] |

**Ātmanepada:**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[सचक्रे] | @deva[सचक्रविहे] | @deva[सचक्रमिहे] |
| 2. | @deva[सचक्रिषे] | @deva[सचक्राथे] | @deva[सचक्रध्वे][^3] |
| 3. | @deva[सचक्रे] | @deva[सचक्रते] | @deva[सचक्रिरे] |

**@deva[स्तु] P. Â.**

**Parasmaipada:**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[तुष्टाव]-@deva[तुष्टुव] | @deva[तुष्टुविव] | @deva[तुष्टुविम] |
| 2. | @deva[तुष्टोथ] | @deva[तुष्टुवथुः] | @deva[तुष्टुव] |
| 3. | @deva[तुष्टाव] | @deva[तुष्टुवतुः] | @deva[तुष्टुवुः] |

**Ātmanepada:**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[तुष्टुवे] | @deva[तुष्टुवहे] | @deva[तुष्टुवमहे] |
| 2. | @deva[तुष्टुषे] | @deva[तुष्टुवाथे] | @deva[तुष्टुवध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[तुष्टुवे] | @deva[तुष्टुवाते] | @deva[तुष्टुविरे] |

Conjugate similarly @deva[तु], @deva[धु], @deva[धू].

---

[^1]: @deva[समर्थयम्परिणां समशोरिते। समर्थादे च। उपायतिर्वुल्यत्रिनुस्वमच्यायादृरुश् च] Pāṇ. VI. 1. 137—139. @deva[स] is prefixed to the root @deva[इ] after the prepositions @deva[सम्] and @deva[परि] when it means to ornament or collect together; and after the preposition @deva[उप] in the above sense, as well as in the sense of procuring agreeably to a supplicant a thing without destroying the thing itself (@deva[सनी प्रदानापानं मनिद्वहः] S. 33. on Pāṇ. II. 3. 58.) or preparing as food, or supplying what is in hand without obtaining anything new from elsewhere.

[^2]: The @deva[इ] is changed to @deva[गुण] (@[Guṇa]) as it is preceded by a conjunct consonant now (Vide @ref[499] Sid. Kau. on Pāṇ. VII. 1. 10-11.)

[^3]: The @deva[व] of the terminations @deva[ध्वस्व], @deva[स्वम्], and @deva[महे] of 2nd per. pl. of the Benedictive, the Aorist and the Perfect, is changed to @deva[ढ्] when preceded by any vowel except @deva[अ] or @deva[आ] or by @deva[य], @deva[र], @deva[व], @deva[ल] or @deva[ह्]. When the aforesaid terminations are preceded by the vowel @deva[ई], it is changed to @deva[इ], if @deva[ई] be preceded by one of the consonants given above.

[^4]: @deva[श्वि] is to be optionally considered as @deva[उ] in the Perfect.

[^5]: @deva[वे] optionally assumes the form @deva[उव] before the strong, and @deva[ऊय] or @deva[ऊव] before the weak terminations of the Perfect.

[^7]: @deva[हे] is to be considered as @deva[हु] in the Perf.

rules.title: Vowel-Dropping Roots in Perfect
rules.body:
## Vowel-Dropping Roots in Perfect

The @deva[अ] of the roots @deva[गम्], @deva[हन्], @deva[जन्], @deva[सद्] and @deva[घस्], is dropped before vowel weak terminations except those of the 2nd variety of the Aorist; the @deva[ह्] of @deva[हन्] is then changed to @deva[घ्]; and @deva[जन्] and @deva[घस्] become @deva[ज्ञ] and @deva[क्ष्] respectively.

**@deva[गम्]**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |

| 1. | @deva[दिदीये] | @deva[दिदीयिवहे] | @deva[दिदीयिमहे] |
| 2. | @deva[दिदीयिषे] | @deva[दिदीयाथे] | @deva[दिदीयिध्वे]-@deva[ढ्] |
| 3. | @deva[दिदीये] | @deva[दिदीयाते] | @deva[दिदीयिरे] |

rules.title: Perfect Base of दे (to protect): दिगि
rules.body:
## Perfect Base of @deva[दे] (to protect): @deva[दिगि]

@deva[दे] 1. Â. 'to protect' assumes as its base the form @deva[दिगि] in the Perfect. @deva[दिग्ये], @deva[दिगिषवहे], 1 sing. and dual @deva[दिगिष्ध]-@deva[ढ्] 2 pl.

rules.title: Perfect Form of युत्: दियुव्
rules.body:
## Perfect Form of @deva[युत्]: @deva[दियुव्]

@deva[युत्] after reduplication assumes the form @deva[दियुव्]; @deva[दियुते] 1 sing., @deva[दियुतिषे] 2 sing.

rules.title: Substitution of पी for मे in Perfect and Frequentative
rules.body:
## Substitution of @deva[पी] for @deva[मे] in Perfect and Frequentative

@deva[पी] is substituted for @deva[मे] 'to grow fat' in the Perfect and in the Frequentative; @deva[पिप्ये] 1 sing., @deva[पिपिष्ध]-@deva[ढ्] 2 pl.

rules.title: Samprasāraṇa in Reduplicative Syllable of व्यथ्
rules.body:
## Samprasāraṇa in Reduplicative Syllable of @deva[व्यथ्]

The root @deva[व्यथ्] takes Samprasāraṇa in the reduplicative syllable in the Perfect; @deva[विव्यथे] 1 & 3 sing., @deva[विव्यथिषे] 2 sing.

rules.title: Forms of विज् in Perfect
rules.body:
## Forms of @deva[विज्] in Perfect

For the forms of @deva[विज्], see @ref[466], @deva[विवेज] 1 sing., @deva[विविजिथ्] @deva[विविजथुः] @deva[विविज] 2 per &c.

**PERIPHRASTIC PERFECT**

rules.title: Formation of Periphrastic Perfect
rules.body:
## Formation of Periphrastic Perfect

The Periphrastic Perfect is formed by adding @deva[आम्] to the root and then adding the forms of the reduplicated Perfect of @deva[कृ], @deva[भू], or @deva[अस्] as terminations; when the forms of @deva[कृ], are added, a Parasmaipadi root takes the Parasmaipadi forms and an Ātmanepadi one takes the Ātmanepadi forms.

rules.title: Guṇa Substitution before आम् in Periphrastic Perfect
rules.body:
## Guṇa Substitution before @deva[आम्] in Periphrastic Perfect

Before @deva[आम्] the final vowel and the penultimate short vowel, except that of @deva[विद्], take their @deva[गुण] (@[Guṇa]) substitute.

Paradigms.

**@deva[ईड्] 2. Â. 'to praise.'**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[ईडाचक्रे] | @deva[ईडाचक्रिवहे] | @deva[ईडाचक्रिमहे] |
| | @deva[ईडामास] | @deva[ईडामासिव] | @deva[ईडामासिम] |
| | @deva[ईडाबभूव] | | |
| 2. | @deva[ईडाचक्रिषे] | @deva[ईडाचक्राथे] | @deva[ईडाचक्रिध्वे] |
| | @deva[ईडामासिथ्] | @deva[ईडामासथुः] | @deva[ईडामास] |
| | @deva[ईडाबभूविथ्] | @deva[ईडाबभूवथुः] | @deva[ईडाबभूव] |
| 3. | @deva[ईडाचक्रे] | @deva[ईडाचक्राते] | @deva[ईडाचक्रिरे] |
| | @deva[ईडामास] | @deva[ईडामासतुः] | @deva[ईडामासुः] |
| | @deva[ईडाबभूव] | @deva[ईडाबभूवतुः] | @deva[ईडाबभूवुः] |

@deva[ईर्], @deva[ईक्ष्], @deva[ऊह्], &c. are similarly conjugated.

**@deva[दा] 'to give.'**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[दयाचक्रे] | | |
| | @deva[दयामास] | | @deva[दयाबभूव] |
| 2. | @deva[दयाचक्रिषे] | @deva[दयामासिथ्] | @deva[दयाबभूविथ्] |
| 3. | @deva[दयाचक्रे] | @deva[दयामास] | @deva[दयाबभूव] |

@deva[अद्]—is similarly conjugated.

**@deva[आस्]**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[आसाचक्रे] | @deva[आसाचक्रिवहे] | @deva[आसाचक्रिमहे] |
| 2. | @deva[आसाचक्रिषे] | @deva[आसाचक्राथे] | @deva[आसाचक्रिध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[आसाचक्रे] | @deva[आसाचक्राते] | @deva[आसाचक्रिरे] |

also @deva[आसामास्], @deva[आसाबभूव] &c.

@deva[कास्]—is similarly conjugated.

**@deva[उष्] 1. P. 'to burn.'**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[उवोष] | @deva[ऊषिव] | @deva[ऊषिम] |
| | @deva[औषाचकार्], &c. | @deva[औषाचक्रिव्], &c. | @deva[औषाचकम्], &c. |
| 2. | @deva[उवोषिथ्] | @deva[ऊषथुः] | @deva[ऊष] |
| | @deva[औषाचकर्थ्], &c. | @deva[औषाचक्रथुः], &c. | @deva[औषाचकृ], &c. |
| 3. | @deva[उवोष] | @deva[ऊषतुः] | @deva[ऊषुः] |
| | @deva[औषाचकार्], &c. | @deva[औषाचकृतुः], &c. | @deva[औषाचक्रुः], &c. |

**@deva[विद्] 2. P. 'to know.'**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[विवेद] | @deva[विविदिव] | @deva[विविदिम] |
| | @deva[विदामास्], &c. | @deva[विदामासिव्], &c. | @deva[विदामासिम्], &c. |
| 2. | @deva[विवेदिथ्] | @deva[विविदथुः] | @deva[विविद्] |
| | @deva[विदामासिथ्], &c. | @deva[विदामासथुः], &c. | @deva[विदामास], &c. |
| 3. | @deva[विवेद्] | @deva[विविदतुः] | @deva[विविदुः] |
| | @deva[विदामास], &c. | @deva[विदामासतुः], &c. | @deva[विदामासुः], &c. |

**@deva[जागृ] 2. P. 'to awake.'**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[जजागार्], @deva[जजागर्] | @deva[जजागरिव] | @deva[जजागरिम्] |
| | @deva[जागरामास्], &c. | @deva[जागरामासिव्], &c. | @deva[जागरामासिम्], &c. |
| 2. | @deva[जजागरिथ्] | @deva[जजागरथुः] | @deva[जजागर] |
| | @deva[जागरामासिथ्], &c. | @deva[जागरामासथुः], &c. | @deva[जागरामास], &c. |
| 3. | @deva[जजागार्] | @deva[जजागरतुः] | @deva[जजागरुः] |
| | @deva[जागरामास], &c. | @deva[जागरामासतुः], &c. | @deva[जागरामासुः], &c. |

**Additional forms:**

@deva[युज्]—@deva[जुयोज], @deva[युजामाचकार्], &c. 1 sing. @deva[जुयुजिव्], @deva[युज्यामाचक्रव्] 1 dual; @deva[जुयोजिथ्], @deva[जुजेज्थ], @deva[युजामाचकर्थ्], &c. 2 sing.

@deva[भूष्]—@deva[बुभूष], or @deva[भूषामाचकार्], &c. 1 sing.

@deva[चिच्छ्]—@deva[चिविच्छ], or @deva[चिच्छामाचकार्], &c. 1 sing.

@deva[पन्]—@deva[पेणे] or @deva[पणामाचक्रे] (@deva[पणामाचक्रे] according to Bopādeva) &c. 1 sing.

@deva[पन्]—@deva[पेने] or @deva[पनामाचक्रे], &c. 1 sing.

@deva[कल्]—@deva[आनर्ते] or @deva[कलामाचक्रे] &c. 1 sing.

rules.title: Reduplication before आम् in भी, ह्री, घू, and हु
rules.body:
## Reduplication before @deva[आम्] in @deva[भी], @deva[ह्री], @deva[घू], and @deva[हु]

When @deva[आम्] is added to the roots @deva[भी], @deva[ह्री], @deva[घू] and @deva[हु] they are first reduplicated as in the third conjugation; e. g.—

**@deva[भी] 2. P. 'to fear.'**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[चिभाय्], @deva[चिभय्] | @deva[चिभियिव] | @deva[चिभियिम्] |
| | @deva[चिभयामाचकार्]-@deva[चकर्], &c. | @deva[चिभयामाचक्रव्], &c. | @deva[चिभयामाचकम्], &c. |
| 2. | @deva[चिभयिथ्], @deva[चिभेथ्] | @deva[चिभ्यथुः] | @deva[चिभ्य] |
| | @deva[चिभयामाचकर्थ्], &c. | @deva[चिभयामाचकृथुः], &c. | @deva[चिभयामाचकृ], &c. |
| 3. | @deva[चिभाय्] | @deva[चिभ्यतुः] | @deva[चिभ्युः] |
| | @deva[चिभयामाचकार्], &c. | @deva[चिभयामाचकृतुः], &c. | @deva[चिभयामाचकुः], &c. |

**@deva[ह्री] 3 P. 'to be ashamed.'**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[जिह्राय], @deva[जिह्रय्] | @deva[जिह्रियिव] | @deva[जिह्रियिम्] |
| | @deva[जिह्रयामाचकार्]-@deva[चकर्], &c. | @deva[जिह्रयामाचक्रव्], | @deva[जिह्रयामाचकम्], &c. |
| 2. | @deva[जिह्रयिथ्]-@deva[जिह्रेथ्] | @deva[जिह्रियथुः] | @deva[जिह्रिय] |
| | @deva[जिह्रयामाचकर्थ्] &c. | @deva[जिह्रयामाचकृथुः], &c. | @deva[जिह्रयामाचकृ], &c. |
| 3. | @deva[जिह्राय] | @deva[जिह्रियतुः] | @deva[जिह्रियुः] |
| | @deva[जिह्रयामाचकार्], &c. | @deva[जिह्रयामाचकृतुः], &c. | @deva[जिह्रयामाचकुः], &c. |

**Additional forms:**

@deva[घू]—@deva[बुभार्], @deva[बुभर्], @deva[बुभरामाचकार्]-@deva[बुभूवामास्] 1 sing.

@deva[हु]—@deva[जुहाव्], @deva[जुहवामाचकार्]-@deva[बुभूवामास] 1 sing. &c.

**(5) THE AORIST @deva[लुङ्].**

rules.title: Seven Varieties of the Aorist
rules.body:
## Seven Varieties of the Aorist

There are seven Varieties or Forms of the Aorist. The augment @deva[अ] is prefixed to the root as in the Imperfect.

**First Variety or Form.**

rules.title: Terminations of First Aorist Variety
rules.body:
## Terminations of First Aorist Variety

The terminations of the First Variety are the same as those of the Imperf., except that of third person plural, which is @deva[उस्]—

| Person | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|--------|----------|------|--------|
| 1. | @deva[अम्] | @deva[व] | @deva[म] |
| 2. | @deva[स्] | @deva[तम्] | @deva[त] |
| 3. | @deva[त्] | @deva[ताम्] | @deva[उस्] |

rules.title: Dropping of Radical आ before उस्
rules.body:
## Dropping of Radical @deva[आ] before @deva[उस्]

The radical @deva[आ] is dropped before @deva[उस्].

rules.title: Roots Taking First Aorist Variety
rules.body:
## Roots Taking First Aorist Variety

@deva[इ], @deva[स्था], @deva[रा], @deva[धा], and roots assuming the forms of @deva[धा] (Vide @ref[459]), @deva[पा] 'to drink' and @deva[भू] take this Variety.

rules.title: Optional First Aorist for प्रा, घे, शो, सो, and छो
rules.body:
## Optional First Aorist for @deva[प्रा], @deva[घे], @deva[शो], @deva[सो], and @deva[छो]

The roots @deva[प्रा], @deva[घे], @deva[शो], @deva[सो], and @deva[छो] belong to this Variety optionally. They optionally take the Sixth Form. @deva[घे] takes the Third Form also.

Paradigms.

**@deva[स्था] P.**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अस्थाम्] | @deva[अस्थाव] | @deva[अस्थाम] |
| 2. | @deva[अस्थाः] | @deva[अस्थातम्] | @deva[अस्थात] |
| 3. | @deva[अस्थात्] | @deva[अस्थाताम्] | @deva[अस्थुः] |

**@deva[शो] P.**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अशाम्] | @deva[अशाव] | @deva[अशाम] |
| 2. | @deva[अशाः] | @deva[अशातम्] | @deva[अशात] |
| 3. | @deva[अशात्] | @deva[अशाताम्] | @deva[अशुः] |

rules.title: Special Forms of भू in First Aorist
rules.body:
## Special Forms of @deva[भू] in First Aorist

@deva[भू] takes @deva[अन्] instead of @deva[उस्] in the 3rd per. pl. and changes its vowel to @deva[ऊव्] before the vowel terminations; e. g. @deva[अभूवम्], @deva[अभूव], @deva[अभूम] 1st pers.; @deva[अभूत्], @deva[अभूताम्], @deva[अभूवन्] 3rd per.

rules.title: Substitution of गा for इ in Aorist
rules.body:
## Substitution of @deva[गा] for @deva[इ] in Aorist

@deva[गा] is substituted for @deva[इ] in the Aorist, @deva[अगाम्], @deva[अगाव], @deva[अगाम] 1st per.; @deva[इ] with @deva[अधि] 'to remember' @deva[अध्यगाम्], @deva[अध्यगाव], @deva[अध्यगाम], &c.

rules.title: First Aorist Exclusively Parasmaipada; Ātmanepada Alternatives
rules.body:
## First Aorist Exclusively Parasmaipada; Ātmanepada Alternatives

This Variety is exclusively Parasmaipadi. @deva[दा], @deva[धा], and @deva[स्था] take the fourth Variety in the Ātm. @deva[भू] when Ātm. takes the fifth; and @deva[इ] with @deva[आङ्] Ātm. the fourth.

**Second Variety or Form.**

rules.title: Formation of Second Aorist Variety
rules.body:
## Formation of Second Aorist Variety

In this Variety @deva[अ] is added on to the root and then the terminations of the Imperf. of the first group of conjugational classes are added; viz.

**Parasmaipada:**

| Person | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|--------|----------|------|--------|
| 1. | @deva[अम्] | @deva[व] | @deva[म] |
| 2. | @deva[स्] | @deva[तम्] | @deva[त] |
| 3. | @deva[त्] | @deva[ताम्] | @deva[अन्] |

**Ātmanepada:**

| Person | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|--------|----------|------|--------|
| 1. | @deva[इ] | @deva[वहि] | @deva[महि] |
| 2. | @deva[थाः] | @deva[इथाम्] | @deva[ध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[त] | @deva[इताम्] | @deva[अन्त] |

rules.title: Vowel Changes in Second Aorist Variety
rules.body:
## Vowel Changes in Second Aorist Variety

The preceding @deva[अ] is dropped before @deva[अम्], @deva[अव्], and @deva[अन्त] and lengthened before @deva[इ] and @deva[म]. The radical vowel except a final @deva[ऋ], short or long, and the @deva[ऋ] of @deva[गृत्], does not undergo @deva[गुण] (@[Guṇa]) or @deva[वृद्धि] (@[Vṛddhi]) substitute.

rules.title: Second Aorist Variety: Parasmaipada and Exceptions
rules.body:
## Second Aorist Variety: Parasmaipada and Exceptions

This Variety is Parasmaipadā with a few exceptions such as @deva[ऋ] with @deva[सम्], @deva[स्था], @deva[वच्], and @deva[अस्] 'to throw' with a preposition. The roots @deva[लिण्], @deva[सिच्], and @deva[हे] take this form in the Par. and optionally in the Ātm, in which they also take the Fourth Form.

rules.title: Dropping of Penultimate Nasal in Second Aorist
rules.body:
## Dropping of Penultimate Nasal in Second Aorist

The penultimate nasal of a root is dropped; as @deva[भञ्ज्]—@deva[अभञ्जत्], @deva[स्कन्द्]—@deva[अस्कदत्], &c.

rules.title: Root Changes in Second Aorist
rules.body:
## Root Changes in Second Aorist

The roots @deva[अस्], @deva[स्था], @deva[पद्], @deva[वच्], @deva[भास्], @deva[स्वि] and @deva[दृश्] are changed to @deva[अर्], @deva[स्त], @deva[पत्], @deva[वच्], @deva[शिष्], @deva[श्व्], and @deva[दर्श्], respectively; as @deva[अवचत्], @deva[अशिषत्], &c. 3rd sing.

rules.title: Roots Taking Second Aorist Variety (Complete List)
rules.body:
## Roots Taking Second Aorist Variety (Complete List)

The roots giving the following couplets belong to this Variety necessarily:—

@deva[ध्यातीयतां ससर्तिहे कान्तां शक्नोतिदाक्रयती ।
उच्च भुवो वर्त्तिः शिष्टिक्षान्ता लुव्यतिः पततिस्ततथा ॥ १ ॥
द्रान्ताः क्षिद्रं द्विदृद् यदि भिदो विदन्त्तः शुदसौदक्सिदः ।
कृधिकुधौ क्षुधिक्षुधौ राधिः ज्ञुय्यतिसिध्यतौ ॥ २ ॥
आङ्क्तौ गुण्यतिऽऽडपौ युर् ऱद् लिम्पतिलुञ्चयतौ ।
लुम्पतिः सर्पतिः पान्ताः क्षुण्यतिस्तुम्भयतौनिभिः ॥ ३ ॥
लुम्प्यतिच्च भकारादता मान्ताः ङाध्यतिक्षाऽभ्यती ।
गर्मिस्त्तौमिदौमेन्नौ शाम्यतिः श्राम्यतिः सर्पिः ॥ ४ ॥
झान्ताः पञ्च ङूशेनशौ भूसित्रेभोतर्त्तृद्धुग्धत्तौ ।
तुच्यतितुच्यतिदुग्धः पिनष्टिः पुष्यतिः प्छुषिभिः ॥ ५ ॥
रिष्यतद्ग चैवाऽऽष्टोवशेरो व्यधिः सह शिनेष्टिन ।
शुष्यथिहेष्यतिः पान्ताः सान्ता अस्यतिड्स्यत्यतौ ॥ ६ ॥
घर्षिजन्मौ तसिदरशौ बस्त्यातिबैस्त्योतिच्च्योतिः ।
मस्सुधौ यस्वांसौविदौ युस्यतिः शास्तरस्त्यापि ॥ ७ ॥
द्रुह्यत्वर्मूरोहस्तूहौ लुड्ड्यहूचिक्करणा भवेत् ।
नवाक्षौतिच्च धातूनां परस्मैपदिनाऽमियम् ॥ ८ ॥
ज्ञमिभर्त्तेः स्त्यातिविक्तौ अस्यतिश्रीयोऽप्सु्पोमग्रकम् ।
आत्मनेपदिनोऽप्यीमे हूयर्त्तिःलिङ्ञिषिच्छयती ॥ ९ ॥
एते विभाषयाड्घुन्ते आत्मनेपदिनो ग्रदा ।]

rules.title: Roots Optionally Taking Second Aorist Variety
rules.body:
## Roots Optionally Taking Second Aorist Variety

The following roots belong to the 2nd Variety optionally; they optionally take the Fourth or Fifth Variety according as they are Anit or Seṭ.

@deva[यथातीयतं ससर्तिहे कान्तं शक्नोतिदाक्रयती ।
रिणात्मिच रिनात्मिच चान्तास्तमौ व घुष्यातिः ॥ १ ॥
मेन्तिच्छ युनक्तिच वेमिनिच्छोदती वृङिः ।
च्युतितवुवौ बोतीतिघ्य स्यूतितेर्त्वितश्च रुद्रतयम् ॥ २ ॥
भ्रदिच्छन्दौ युतिवेन्दौ वुन्दतिच्छ भिनत्तीना ।
रुदिरक्षन्दौ बोध्यतिच्छ स्पर्दृशेदिच्छ नृपिधैपाः ॥ ३ ॥
स्तन्नातिः स्तोभनत्तिदशौ घोघात्तिश्छठ्यती उदिः ।
तोद्रतोबोह्रविदूहौ चत्वारिप्रदिय लुदि ॥ ४ ॥
विभाषया लुङ्कारणां परस्मैपदिनौ ग्रदा ।][^1]

rules.title: 25 Ātmanepada Roots Taking Parasmaipada in Second Aorist
rules.body:
## 25 Ātmanepada Roots Taking Parasmaipada in Second Aorist

The following 25 roots, which are all Ātmanepadi, are conjugated in the Parasmaipadā when they belong to this Variety. In the Ātmanepada they take the Fourth or Fifth Variety according as they are Anit or Seṭ.

@deva[रुचैश्वुष्टोसेट्टुट्टो लोट्टै युतिवृतुभिरेतः ।
देवदे मेदते स्पर्द्धः स्वेदते च यृधिः च्यथिः ॥ १ ॥
कूस्ते तुभतामभिनभः शोभते सम्भते श्राविः ।
अंशोवर्त्तौ अंसित्वौ रवादिः पर्झिकातिः ॥ २ ॥
आत्मनेपदिनौ नित्यं तुदि त्वेषा विभाषया ।
अर्द् परसमेपदिनौ भजन्त्यन्यत्र सिज्वतौ ॥ ३ ॥]

**THIRD VARIETY OR FORM**

rules.title: Terminations of Third Aorist Variety
Roots Taking Third Aorist Variety
rules.body:
## Roots Taking Third Aorist Variety

Roots of the tenth class, causals, some derivatives, the root @deva[कम्] and the roots @deva[भी], @deva[हु], and @deva[घू] when expressing fear or gent, take this Variety necessarily, and the roots @deva[घे] and @deva[चि] take it optionally.

rules.title: Formation of Third Aorist: Reduplication and Vowel Changes
rules.body:
## Formation of Third Aorist: Reduplication and Vowel Changes

(a) The root is first reduplicated and then the augment @deva[अ] and the terminations are added as in the 2nd Variety.

(b) Final @deva[इ] and @deva[उ] are changed to @deva[इय्] and @deva[उव्] before @deva[अ] and final @deva[आ] is dropped.

Paradigms.

**@deva[भी] P. Â. 'to go,' &c.**

**Parasmaipada:**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अभीभियम्] | @deva[अभीभियाव] | @deva[अभीभियाम] |
| 2. | @deva[अभीभियः] | @deva[अभीभियतम्] | @deva[अभीभियत] |
| 3. | @deva[अभीभियत्] | @deva[अभीभियताम्] | @deva[अभीभियन्] |

**Ātmanepada:**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अभीभियि] | @deva[अभीभियावहि] | @deva[अभीभियामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अभीभियथाः] | @deva[अभीभियथाम्] | @deva[अभीभियध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[अभीभियत] | @deva[अभीभियताम्] | @deva[अभीभियन्त] |

**Additional Forms:**

@deva[हु]—@deva[अजुहुवत्] 3 Sing.

@deva[घू]—@deva[अजुघुवत्] 3 Sing.

@deva[कम्]—@deva[अचकमत]-@deva[अचीकमत] also, when it takes @deva[आराध्]; see @ref[461] and @ref[548]. 3 sing.

@deva[चि]-@deva[अचिचियत्] (see p. 338. foot-note)

@deva[घे]—@deva[अजेजयत्] (@deva[घे] also takes 1st and 6th Varieties besides this).

rules.title: Third Aorist of Tenth Class Roots and Causals
rules.body:
## Third Aorist of Tenth Class Roots and Causals

Roots of the tenth Class and Causals:—

(a) The @deva[अय्] of the base is dropped (the vowel changes taking place before it being reta'ned) and a short vowel substituted for the long one (@deva[ऋ] and @deva[ॠ] being shortened to @deva[इ], and @deva[औ] and @deva[ऐ] to @deva[उ]).

The base so modified is then reduplicated according to the general rules; @deva[शोच्] (Cau. B. of @deva[छु]) =@deva[शोच]-@deva[शुच]-@deva[शुशोच्] after reduplication; @deva[चकम्] (from @deva[कम्])=@deva[कम]-@deva[चकम्]-@deva[चचकम्].

(b) @deva[इ] is substituted for the @deva[अ] of the reduplicative syllable if the vowel following it is short, or of the base if the vowel long; the @deva[इ] of the reduplicative syllable is lengthened if not followed by a long syll. or a conjunct consonant; thus @deva[चकम्]-@deva[चिकम्]-@deva[चीकम्]; @deva[चिचित्]-@deva[चिचित्]; @deva[त्रकद्]-@deva[चत्रकद्]-@deva[चित्रकद्], the @deva[इ] is not lengthened as it is followed by a conjunct consonant; @deva[स्पुर्]-@deva[स्पुस्पुर्] only, as @deva[प] is followed by a syllable prosodially long.

(c) Roots having a penultimate @deva[ऋ], short or long, optionally preserve it, the long @deva[ऋ] te ng changed to the short one; @deva[वृत्] causal base @deva[वर्तय]-@deva[वर्तय] after cropping @deva[अय] and @deva[वृत्] by this: @deva[वर्त्]-@deva[चवृत्]-@deva[चवृत्]-@deva[चिवर्त्]-@deva[चीवृत्]; @deva[कृत्]-@deva[कोत्तय]-@deva[कोत्तद्] and @deva[कृत्] by this: @deva[कात्]-@deva[चिकोत्]; @deva[कूत्]-@deva[चाकद्].

(d) To the base so prepared the augment @deva[अ] is to be prefixed and the terminations added; @deva[अचीकमत्] from @deva[कम्]; @deva[अचीकमत्] from @deva[कम्]; @deva[अचीचित्] from @deva[चित्]; @deva[अचिवर्त्] or @deva[अचीवृत्त्] from @deva[वृत्]; @deva[अचिकोत्त्] from @deva[कृत्]; @deva[अस्पुस्पुरत्] from @deva[स्पुर्]; @deva[अचिवर्त्त्], @deva[अचीवृत्त्] from @deva[वृत्], @deva[अचिकोत्त्],@deva[अचीकृत्त्],@deva[वृत्];@deva[अस्पुस्पुद्],@deva[अचुछुदत्] from @deva[छुद्], &c.

@note[type=note]{N. B. The Ātm. form in @deva[इ] when not given should be supposed to bs understood.}

rules.title: Third Aorist of Bases with Initial Vowels
rules.body:
## Third Aorist of Bases with Initial Vowels

Bases with initial vowels:—

(a) If a root begins with a vowel and ends in a single consonant, the consonant is reduplicated and @deva[इ] added to it in the reduplicative syllable: @deva[अद्]-@deva[आद्]-@deva[आदिद्द्]; @deva[आप्]-@deva[आप्]-@deva[आपिप्]; &c.

(b) If it ends in a conjunct consonant with @deva[ध्], @deva[र्] or @deva[द्] for its first member, the second member of the conjunct is reduplicated. @deva[उन्द्]-@deva[उचन्द्]-@deva[उचिन्द्द्] and finally @deva[औचिन्द्त्] 3 Sing, similarly @deva[आविन्द्त्] from @deva[अञ्ज्] (considered as @deva[अजद्], otherwise @deva[आविद्त्]), @deva[आविञ्छत्] from @deva[अञ्च्]; @deva[आविज्जत्] from @deva[अञ्ज्], &c.

(c) The roots @deva[उच्], @deva[आञ्च्], @deva[अञ्च्], @deva[अञ्], @deva[आद्], @deva[अर्ध्] Ātm. and some others, substitute @deva[अ] for @deva[इ] in the reduplicative syllable; 3 sing. @deva[अौजत्], @deva[आवच्त्], @deva[आजघत्], @deva[आञ्चवत्], @deva[आअर्त्], @deva[आर्द्त्], &c.

rules.title: Reduplication Rules for Roots Ending in उ
rules.body:
## Reduplication Rules for Roots Ending in @deva[उ]

Roots ending in @deva[उ], short or long, substitute @deva[उ] (changeable to @deva[ऊ] like @deva[इ]) for @deva[इ] in the reduplicative syllable, provided it be not (immediately) followed by a labial consonant or a semivowel or @deva[व्], followed by @deva[अ] or @deva[आ]: @deva[नु]—@deva[अनूनवत्]-@deva[त], @deva[चु]—@deva[अचूकवत्]-@deva[त], @deva[दु]—@deva[अदूदवत्], @deva[यु]—@deva[अयूयवत्]-@deva[त], &c.

But @deva[पू]—@deva[अपीपवत्]-@deva[त], @deva[भू]—@deva[अबीभवत्]-@deva[त], @deva[जु] 'to hasten' @deva[अजीजवत्], @deva[म्रु] 'to bind'—@deva[अमीमवत्], @deva[यु] 'to bind' @deva[अयीयवत्], @deva[रु]—@deva[अरीरवत्]-@deva[त]; @deva[लू]—@deva[अलीलवत्], &c.

(a) The roots @deva[स्रु], @deva[श्रु], @deva[द्रु], @deva[प्लु] 'to go,' @deva[प्लु] 'to swim' and @deva[च्यु] optionally retain the @deva[इ]: @deva[असिस्रवत्] or @deva[अस्रुस्रवत्], @deva[अशिश्रवत्] or @deva[अशुश्रवत्], @deva[अदिद्रवत्] or @deva[अदुद्रवत्], @deva[अपिप्लवत्] or @deva[अपुप्लवत्], @deva[अपिप्लुवत्] or @deva[अपुप्लुवत्], @deva[अचिच्यवत्] or @deva[अचुच्यवत्]-@deva[त].

rules.title: Roots Shortening Vowels in Third Aorist
rules.body:
## Roots Shortening Vowels in Third Aorist

The roots @deva[घ्राघ्], @deva[मार्], @deva[मार्], @deva[दीध्], @deva[जीव्], @deva[मीन्], @deva[पीन्], @deva[कण्], 'to moan' @deva[छुप्] 'to sound,' 'to go,' @deva[रप्] 'to sound,' @deva[भण्], @deva[चण्] @deva[उ] 'to sound,' @deva[अर्ण्] 'to give' @deva[दुर्] 6. P. Â 'to cut,' @deva[हृद्] 'to harass,' @deva[हो], @deva[छड्], @deva[छुड्] and @deva[त्रुड्] on 9. do shorten their vowels; 3 sing. @deva[आदिद्धरत्], @deva[आदिछत्], @deva[अपुषत्] or @deva[अवाछान्], @deva[अचिससम्] or @deva[अचमार्त्], @deva[अचिञ्जान्] or @deva[अचमाघ्त्], @deva[चुम्पतिः] or @deva[अवतिरत्], @deva[क्षिनायन्] or @deva[क्षिनतिरत्], @deva[आशिगोध्] or @deva[आविर्मौच्म्], @deva[अघशिरध्म्] or @deva[आष्टरहम्], @deva[अचाकृषत्] or @deva[अचकाघम्], @deva[अचाछाघन्] or @deva[अचान्त्राघ्त्], @deva[अचाबोतिच्], @deva[अचाघात्], @deva[अचाकोत्] or @deva[अचकोघ्म्] (see @ref[553] below), @deva[आछुट्टम्] or @deva[अछुत्ताछ्म्], @deva[आछुट्टोद्] or @deva[आछुत्रतिछ्त्], &c.

rules.title: Reduplicative Syllable अ Not Changed to इ
rules.body:
## Reduplicative Syllable @deva[अ] Not Changed to @deva[इ]

The @deva[अ] of the reduplicative syllable of @deva[स्मृ], @deva[दृ], @deva[त्वर्], @deva[प्रथ्], @deva[म्रद्] 'to pound, to wish,' @deva[स्तृ] and @deva[स्पश्], is not changed to @deva[इ]; @deva[वेष्ट्] 1 Ā. 'to surround' and @deva[चेष्ट्] optionally change their @deva[इ] to @deva[अ]; 1 sing. @deva[असस्मरम्], @deva[अददरम्], @deva[अतत्वरम्], @deva[अपप्रथम्], @deva[अमम्रदम्], @deva[अतस्तरम्], @deva[अपस्पशम्]; @deva[वेष्ट्]—@deva[अविवेष्टम्], @deva[अववेष्टम्]; @deva[चेष्ट्]—@deva[अचिचेष्टम्], @deva[अचचेष्टम्].

rules.title: Samprasāraṇa in Third Aorist
rules.body:
## Samprasāraṇa in Third Aorist

The roots @deva[हे] and @deva[स्पुघ्] can take Samprasāraṇa, @deva[चि] does it optionally; @deva[हे] @deva[उ]-@deva[हाक्]-@deva[हाइ] or @deva[हृघ्], then @deva[चुहुद्], @deva[चुहात्] by @ref[550]; then @deva[अचुहात्], @deva[अचुहूत्]; @deva[स्पुघ्]—@deva[स्पृभ्द्]—@deva[स्पाइ]-@deva[चुस्पुघ्]—@deva[चुस्पुघ्]; @deva[अचुस्पुघ्त्], @deva[अचुस्पुघम्] 1st sing.

rules.title: Roots Preserving Vowel in Reduplicative Syllable
rules.body:
## Roots Preserving Vowel in Reduplicative Syllable

The roots given under @ref[400] preserve their vowel unchanged; i. e. do not substitute @deva[इ] in the reduplicative syllable, &c. @deva[कृट्]—@deva[अचक्रयत्], @deva[वृ]—@deva[अवर्त्रत्], @deva[शद्]—@deva[आशाशत्त्], @deva[रद्]—@deva[अरर्त्रत्], @deva[पद्]—@deva[अपस्पत्], @deva[प्छुट्]—@deva[अपप्छुटत्]. @deva[क्षुद्]—@deva[अचक्षुत्त्].

rules.title: Roots Not Shortening Penultimate Vowel
rules.body:
## Roots Not Shortening Penultimate Vowel

The roots @deva[घ्राघ्], @deva[एघ्], @deva[काम्], @deva[कीड्], @deva[क्षीद्], @deva[स्वाद्], @deva[सेद्], @deva[राय्], @deva[राव्], @deva[स्पुव्], @deva[रुद्], @deva[ग्लेव्], @deva[स्वेद्], @deva[रोघ्], @deva[धाव्], @deva[रुज्], and @deva[रुष्] restore the @deva[छे], @deva[द्], @deva[लेव्], @deva[लौव्], @deva[शेष्], @deva[वेष्], @deva[ढ्लौष्], @deva[ब्लोष्], @deva[व्लौष्], @deva[रेष्], @deva[हेष्], and others less important, do not shorten their penultimate; 3 sing. @deva[अञ्जशाशत्त्], @deva[राजत्त्], @deva[अचकाशत्], @deva[अचिकीइत्], @deva[अचिक्षीत्त्], @deva[अचिक्षावत्], @deva[अचिसेत्त्], &c.

rules.title: Irregular Causal Aorist Forms
rules.body:
## Irregular Causal Aorist Forms

Roots which form their Causal Aorist irregularly:—

@deva[इ] with @deva[अधि] 'to study,—@deva[आध्यजीघत्], @deva[अप्रजीघत्], (@deva[इ] with @deva[अधि] to remember' @deva[आध्यजीघत्]).

@deva[द्रुह्] 'to envy'—@deva[आद्रिप्ररत्त्त्], @deva[आद्रिप्रयत्त्त्]

@deva[ऊर्ण्]—@deva[अजन्तर्णत्], @deva[अजनौर्णत्]

@deva[गम्]—@deva[अञ्जघ्रत्], @deva[अजनिघत्]

@deva[शा]—@deva[अजिन्यत्], @deva[अविङ्घत्]

@deva[चकार्]—@deva[अचीचकासत्], @deva[अचचकासत्]

@deva[घुष्]—@deva[अदुघुषत्त्].

@deva[पा] 'to drink' @deva[अपीपयत्] (@deva[पा] 'to protect' forms its Causal Aorist regularly as @deva[अपीपयत्]).

@deva[स्था]—@deva[अतिष्ठिपत्त्].

@deva[स्फुर्]—@deva[अस्पुष्फुरत्त्].

### Paradigms

**@deva[कृ] 'to do.'**

**Parasmaipada:**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अचीकरम्] | @deva[अचीकराव] | @deva[अचीकराम] |
| 2. | @deva[अचीकरः] | @deva[अचीकरतम्] | @deva[अचीकरत] |
| 3. | @deva[अचीकरत्] | @deva[अचीकरताम्] | @deva[अचीकरन्] |

**Ātmanepada:**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अचीकरे] | @deva[अचीकरावहि] | @deva[अचीकरामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अचीकरथाः] | @deva[अचीकरेथाम्] | @deva[अचीकरध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[अचीकरत] | @deva[अचीकरेताम्] | @deva[अचीकरन्त] |

**@deva[त्रप्].**

**Parasmaipada:**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अतित्रपम्] | @deva[अतित्रपाव] | @deva[अतित्रपाम] |
| 2. | @deva[अतित्रपः] | @deva[अतित्रपतम्] | @deva[अतित्रपत] |
| 3. | @deva[अतित्रपत्] | @deva[अतित्रपताम्] | @deva[अतित्रपन्] |

**Ātmanepada:**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अतित्रपे] | @deva[अतित्रपावहि] | @deva[अतित्रपामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अतित्रपथाः] | @deva[अतित्रपेथाम्] | @deva[अतित्रपध्वम्] |

rules.title: Roots Taking the Fourth Form
rules.body:
## Roots Taking the Fourth Form

(a) Anit roots not belonging to any of the preceding Varieties take this Form. Anit roots that optionally take any of the preceding Varieties and Veṭ roots[^1] optionally belong to this Variety.

### Exceptions:

(1) @deva[ऋ] and @deva[इ], when Parasmaipadi, belong to the Fifth Variety.

(2) Roots ending in @deva[ऋ] preceded by a conjunct consonant may take Fourth or Fifth Form in the Ātmanepada.

(3) @deva[भञ्ज्] and @deva[घ्] Par. take the Fifth Form only. @deva[घ्] Â. may take the Fourth or the Fifth Form.

(4) Of Seṭ roots @deva[इ] and those ending in @deva[ऋ] (long) when Ātm. belong to either (4th or 5th Variety). @deva[प्रच्छ्] and @deva[कृष्] when Â. belong to the Fourth.

---

[^1]: Veṭ roots which belong to this Variety, as Anit, optionally take the 5th as Seṭ.

rules.title: Vowel Changes in Fourth Aorist
rules.body:
## Vowel Changes in Fourth Aorist

(a) In the Parasmaipada the radical vowel takes its Vṛddhi substitute; @deva[कृ]-@deva[अकार्षीत्]; @deva[इ]-@deva[ऐषीत्]; @deva[मञ्ज]-@deva[अमाञ्जीत्], &c.

(b) In the Ātmanepada, Guṇa is substituted for final @deva[इ] or @deva[उ], short or long; final @deva[ऋ] and the penultimate vowel remain unchanged; final @deva[ऋ] is changed to @deva[ऋर्] or @deva[ऊर्] in accordance with @ref[594]; @deva[चि]-@deva[अचेष्ट], @deva[नी]-@deva[अनेष्ट], @deva[च्यु]-@deva[अच्योष्ट], @deva[क्]-@deva[अकोष्ट], @deva[छ्] see below, @deva[गिर्]-@deva[अगरिष्ट], @deva[धूर्]-@deva[अधोरीष्ट], @deva[हूर्]-@deva[अहोरीष्ट].

(c) The Penultimate @deva[ऋ] of Anit roots is optionally changed to @deva[ऋर्] or @deva[ऊर्] @deva[सञ्जाघर्सुर्] or @deva[सञ्जाघोरुत्].

rules.title: Dropping of स् in Fourth Aorist Terminations
rules.body:
## Dropping of @deva[स्] in Fourth Aorist Terminations

After a short vowel, and after a consonant except a nasal or semi-vowel, the @deva[स्] of terminations beginning with @deva[स्त] and @deva[स्थ] is dropped; @deva[हृ]—@deva[अहृत] 3 sing.; @deva[कृ]—@deva[अकृथाः] 2 sing.; @deva[क्षिप्]—@deva[अक्षिप्थाः], @deva[अक्षिप्त]; @deva[कृष्]—@deva[अकृष्ट] 3rd sing. &c.

P. & Â.; @deva[सृज्]—@deva[अस्राक्षम्][^1] 1 sing., @deva[अस्राष्टम्] 2nd dual; @deva[दृश्]—@deva[अद्राक्षम्]; with @deva[सम्] Â. @deva[समदृक्षि] 1 sing.; @deva[प्रच्छ्]—@deva[अप्राक्षम्] 1 sing.; @deva[अप्राक्षीः], @deva[अप्राष्टम्], @deva[अप्राष्ट] 2 per. &c.; @deva[रुध्]—@deva[अरौत्सम्] 1 sing.; @deva[अरौत्सीः] 2 sing.; @deva[अरौद्धम्] 2 per. dual., &c.; Â. @deva[अरुत्सि] 1st sing.; @deva[अरुद्ध], @deva[अरुत्साताम्] 3rd sing. and dual; @deva[दह्]—@deva[अधाक्षम्] 1 sing.; @deva[अदाग्धम्] 2nd dual.

| 3. | @deva[व्यजेष्ट] | @deva[व्यजेषाताम्] | @deva[व्यजेषत] |

Conjugate similarly @deva[चि], @deva[नी], @deva[ली],[^2] &c.; @deva[श्रु], @deva[यु] 9. P. Â. &c.; @deva[चि]—@deva[अचैषम्], @deva[अचेषि] 1 sing.; @deva[ली] 9. P. 4. Â. @deva[अलैषम्] 1 sing.; @deva[अलेषि], @deva[अलासि] 1 sing.; @deva[श्रु]—@deva[अश्रौषम्], &c.

rules.title: Vowel Substitution in दा, धा, स्था Roots
rules.body:
## Vowel Substitution in @deva[दा], @deva[धा], @deva[स्था] Roots

@deva[दा], @deva[धा], and roots assuming the forms of @deva[दा] and @deva[धा] (Vide @ref[459]) and @deva[स्था] substitute @deva[इ] for their final vowel in the Ātm. This @deva[इ] does not take its Guṇa substitute. In the Parasm. these roots take the first Variety (vide @ref[532]).

rules.title: Root हन् Dropping Nasal
Optional Nasal Dropping in गम् and यम्
rules.body:
## Optional Nasal Dropping in @deva[गम्] and @deva[यम्]

@deva[गम्], and @deva[यम्] with @deva[उप्] 'to marry,' optionally drop their nasal, when they take the Ātm. terminations. @deva[यम्] when it means 'to give out' (as the faults of others) necessarily drops its nasal

rules.title: Roots Taking the Fifth Variety
rules.body:
## Roots Taking the Fifth Variety

All roots not restricted to any of the preceding Varieties take this Variety. Consequently it is peculiar to Seṭ roots (Vide @ref[565]).

rules.title: Vowel Changes in Fifth Aorist
rules.body:
## Vowel Changes in Fifth Aorist

(a) In the Parasmaipada, the final radical vowel and the penultimate @deva[अ] of roots ending in @deva[र्] or @deva[ल्] and that of @deva[वद्] and @deva[त्रज्] take their Vṛddhi substitute necessarily; @deva[लू]-@deva[अलाविषम्]; @deva[चर्]—@deva[अचारिषम्]; @deva[फल्]-@deva[अफालिषम्], &c.

(b) The penultimate short vowel of a root takes its Guṇa substitute; @deva[क्रुश्]-@deva[अक्रोषिषम्], &c.

(c) Vṛddhi is optionally substituted for the penultimate @deva[अ], not prosodially long, of roots having an initial consonant and not ending in @deva[र्] or @deva[ल्]; @deva[पद्]—@deva[अपादिषम्], @deva[अपदिषम्]; @deva[गह्]—@deva[अगाहिषम्]—@deva[अगहिषम्].

(d) But the vowel of roots ending in @deva[स्], @deva[व्], @deva[य], and of the roots @deva[क्षप्], @deva[क्षर्], @deva[नाघ्], @deva[चि], @deva[कट्] 'to cover, to surround,' @deva[वद्], 'to break, to pierce,' @deva[चत्], @deva[चर्], 'to ask, to beg,' @deva[वश्] 'to go or move,' @deva[मथ्] 'to churn,' @deva[लम्] 'to stick or cling to,' @deva[हुस्] and @deva[स्वस्] 'to sound or to be diminished,' does not take its Vṛddhi substitute.

(e) In the Ātmanepada the radical vowel takes its Guṇa substitute; @deva[लू]—@deva[अलेष्ट].

rules.title: Optional इ for इष्ट Substitution
rules.body:
## Optional @deva[इ] for @deva[इष्ट] Substitution

The roots @deva[दीप्], @deva[जन्], @deva[पूर्], @deva[ताय्] and @deva[प्याय्] optionally substitute @deva[इ] for @deva[इष्ट] (third person sing. Ātm.).

---

[^4]: Vide p. 249 foot-note; @deva[गुह्] also takes 7th Variety.

rules.title: 8th Class Roots Ending in Nasals
rules.body:
## 8th Class Roots Ending in Nasals

Roots of the 8th class ending in @deva[न्] or @deva[ण्] drop their nasal and substitute optionally @deva[यास्] and @deva[न्] for the terminations @deva[ष्ठाः] and @deva[ष्] of the 2nd and 3rd person sing. Âtm. @deva[तृण्] lengthens its vowel after dropping @deva[ण्], Ātm.

rules.title: Vowel Changes in ऊर्ण्
rules.body:
## Vowel Changes in @deva[ऊर्ण्]

The vowel of @deva[ऊर्ण्] takes Vṛddhi optionally in the Parasm, i. e. optionally takes Guṇa substitute; also it optionally remains unchanged before @deva[इ] (Vide @ref[466], @ref[518]).

rules.title: Optional Dropping of आ in दरिद्रा
rules.body:
## Optional Dropping of @deva[आ] in @deva[दरिद्रा]

The @deva[आ] of @deva[दरिद्रा] is optionally dropped in the Aorist; consequently it takes the Sixth and the Fifth Varieties.

rules.title: Benedictive Mood Terminations
rules.body:
## Benedictive Mood Terminations

The Parasmaipada terminations of this mood may be obtained by prefixing @deva[यास्] to those of the Imperative after dropping its final @deva[स्] before @deva[स्त्] and @deva[त्] of the 2nd and 3rd per. sings.; and the Ātmanepada ones by prefixing @deva[स्] to the terminations of the Ātm. Potential and also to the @deva[त्] and @deva[थ्] occurring in them. These, therefore, are:—

**Parasmaipada:**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[यासम्] | @deva[यास्व] | @deva[यास्म] |
| 2. | @deva[याः] | @deva[यास्तम्] | @deva[यास्त] |
| 3. | @deva[यात्] | @deva[यास्ताम्] | @deva[यासुः] |

**Ātmanepada:**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[सीय] | @deva[सीवहि] | @deva[सीमहि] |
| 2. | @deva[सीष्ठाः] | @deva[सीयाथाम्] | @deva[सीध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[सीष्ट] | @deva[सीयाताम्] | @deva[सीरन्] |

(a) Parasmaipadā.

rules.title: Benedictive Parasmaipada: No Guṇa or Vṛddhi
rules.body:
## Benedictive Parasmaipada: No Guṇa or Vṛddhi

The Par. terminations are weak and therefore occasion no Guṇa or Vṛddhi change in the root. All roots reject the augment @deva[इ].

rules.title: Vowel Changes in Benedictive Before Parasmaipada Terminations
rules.body:
## Vowel Changes in Benedictive Before Parasmaipada Terminations

The final @deva[इ] or @deva[उ] is lengthened; final @deva[ऋ] short is changed to @deva[रि], and final @deva[ऋ] changed to @deva[ऋर्] or to @deva[ऊर्] when preceded by a labial or @deva[व्] before the Par. terminations of the Benedictive, and the @deva[य] of the Passive.

**Examples:**
- @deva[चि]—@deva[चीयात्]
- @deva[स्तु]—@deva[स्तुयात्]
- @deva[कृ]—@deva[कुरियात्]
- @deva[लृ]—@deva[लीरियात्]
- @deva[वृ]—@deva[वूरियात्], &c.

rules.title: Guṇa Substitution for Final ऋ in Benedictive
rules.body:
## Guṇa Substitution for Final @deva[ऋ] in Benedictive

Final @deva[ऋ] preceded by a conjunct consonant and the root @deva[ऋ] are changed to Guṇa under the same circumstances.

**Examples:**
- @deva[स्मृ]—@deva[स्मर्यात्]
- @deva[ऋ]—@deva[अर्यात्]

rules.title: Samprasāraṇa in Benedictive
rules.body:
## Samprasāraṇa in Benedictive

Roots capable of taking Samprasāraṇa take it. @deva[शास्] substitutes @deva[इ] for its vowel.

rules.title: Dropping of Penultimate Nasal in Benedictive
Final Vowel Changes to ए in Benedictive
Prefixing इ to Benedictive Terminations
rules.body:
## Prefixing @deva[इ] to Benedictive Terminations

### (a) Seṭ and Veṭ Roots

@deva[इ] is prefixed to the terminations after Seṭ roots and optionally after Veṭ ones.

### (b) Roots Ending in @deva[ऋ]

Roots ending in @deva[ऋ] preceded by a conjunct consonant, the root @deva[ऋ] and roots ending in @deva[ॠ] admit of @deva[इ] optionally.

rules.title: Ātmanepada Benedictive Terminations and Paradigms
rules.body:
## Ātmanepada Benedictive Terminations and Paradigms

The Ātm. terminations, are strong. Before these radical vowel takes its Guṇa substitute, but when the intermediate @deva[इ] is not prefixed to the terminations, the final @deva[ऋ] remains unchanged and @deva[ऋ] is changed to @deva[ऋर्], or to @deva[उर्] if a labial or @deva[व्] precedes.

**Examples:**
- @deva[चि]—@deva[चेषीष्ट]
- @deva[धु]—@deva[धोषीष्ट]
- @deva[लृ]—@deva[लिरिषीष्ट]
- @deva[स्तृ]—@deva[स्तरिषीष्ट], or @deva[स्तीरिषीष्ट]
- @deva[वृ]—@deva[वुरिषीष्ट] or @deva[वूरिषीष्ट], &c.

Formation of Passive Voice
rules.body:
## Formation of Passive Voice

Every root in every one of the ten conjugational classes may take a Passive form conjugated like an Ātmanepadi root of the 4th Class.[^1]

---

[^1]: The only difference is in the accent; in the Passive it falls on @deva[य], whereas in the case of the primitive verbs of the 4th class, Ātm., it falls on the radical syllable.

rules.title: Three Types of Passive Verbs
rules.body:
## Three Types of Passive Verbs

There are three kinds of Passive Verbs:

1. **The Passive properly so called** (@deva[कर्मणि प्र॰]), as @deva[राघेण क्रयं दीयते]

2. **An Impersonal Passive** (@deva[भावे प्र॰]), as @deva[गच्यते] 'it is gone'

3. **A Reflexive** (@deva[आत्मनेपदी प्र॰]), as @deva[ओदनं पच्यते] 'rice is cooked'

---

**CONJUGATIONAL TENSES.**

rules.title: Formation of Passive Base with य
rules.body:
## Formation of Passive Base with @deva[य]

### (a) Addition of @deva[य]

@deva[य] is added to the root, which is weak i. e. no Guṇa or Vṛddhi substitute takes place before it.

**Examples:**
- @deva[नी]—@deva[नीय]
- @deva[भिद्]—@deva[भिद्य]

### (b) Changes Before @deva[य]

Before @deva[य] roots undergo the same changes as they do before the Par. terminations of the Benedictive.

**Examples:**
- @deva[जि]—@deva[जीय]
- @deva[कृ]—@deva[क्रिय]
- @deva[स्मृ]—@deva[स्मर्य]
- @deva[ऋ]—@deva[अर्य]
- @deva[कॄ]—@deva[कीर्य]
- @deva[पॄ]—@deva[पूर्य]
- @deva[बन्ध्]—@deva[बध्य] (but @deva[निन्द्]—@deva[निन्द्य])
- @deva[वच्]—@deva[उच्य]
- @deva[ग्रह्]—@deva[गृह्य], &c.

### (c) Final @deva[आ] Changed to @deva[ई]

The final @deva[आ] (original or substituted) of @deva[दा] 'to give,' @deva[दे], @deva[दो], @deva[धा], @deva[धे], @deva[मा], @deva[गै], @deva[पा] 'to drink,' @deva[सो] and @deva[हा] 'to abandon' is changed to @deva[ई]; in other cases it remains unchanged.

**Examples:**
- @deva[दा] and @deva[दो]—@deva[दीय]
- @deva[गै]—@deva[गीय]
- @deva[हा]—@deva[हीय]

@note[type=exception]{@deva[दा] 'to cut, to purify'—@deva[दाय]; @deva[ज्ञा]—@deva[ज्ञाय]; @deva[ध्यै]—@deva[ध्याय].}

rules.title: Conjugation of Passive Base as Fourth Class
rules.body:
## Conjugation of Passive Base as Fourth Class

The passive base is conjugated like a root of the 4th class in the Âtm., i. e.[^1]

### Paradigm: @deva[भू] 'to be'

#### Present

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[भूये] | @deva[भूयावहे] | @deva[भूयामहे] |
| 2. | @deva[भूयसे] | @deva[भूयेथे] | @deva[भूयध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[भूयते] | @deva[भूयेते] | @deva[भूयन्ते] |

#### Imperfect

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अभूये] | @deva[अभूयावहि] | @deva[अभूयामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अभूयथाः] | @deva[अभूयेथाम्] | @deva[अभूयध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[अभूयत] | @deva[अभूयेताम्] | @deva[अभूयन्त] |

#### Imperative

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[भूये] | @deva[भूयावहै] | @deva[भूयामहै] |
| 2. | @deva[भूयस्व] | @deva[भूयेथाम्] | @deva[भूयध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[भूयताम्] | @deva[भूयेताम्] | @deva[भूयन्ताम्] |

#### Potential

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[भूयेय] | @deva[भूयेवहि] | @deva[भूयेमहि] |
| 2. | @deva[भूयेथाः] | @deva[भूयेयाथाम्] | @deva[भूयेध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[भूयेत] | @deva[भूयेयाताम्] | @deva[भूयेरन्] |

### Paradigm: @deva[बुध्] 'to know'

#### Present

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[बुध्ये] | @deva[बुध्यावहे] | @deva[बुध्यामहे] |
| 2. | @deva[बुध्यसे] | @deva[बुध्येथे] | @deva[बुध्यध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[बुध्यते] | @deva[बुध्येते] | @deva[बुध्यन्ते] |

#### Imperfect

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अबुध्ये] | @deva[अबुध्यावहि] | @deva[अबुध्यामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अबुध्यथाः] | @deva[अबुध्येथाम्] | @deva[अबुध्यध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[अबुध्यत] | @deva[अबुध्येताम्] | @deva[अबुध्यन्त] |

#### Imperative

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[बुध्ये] | @deva[बुध्यावहै] | @deva[बुध्यामहै] |
| 2. | @deva[बुध्यस्व] | @deva[बुध्येथाम्] | @deva[बुध्यध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[बुध्यताम्] | @deva[बुध्येताम्] | @deva[बुध्यन्ताम्] |

#### Potential

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[बुध्येय] | @deva[बुध्येवहि] | @deva[बुध्येमहि] |
| 2. | @deva[बुध्येथाः] | @deva[बुध्येयाथाम्] | @deva[बुध्येध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[बुध्येत] | @deva[बुध्येयाताम्] | @deva[बुध्येरन्] |

---

[^1]: It might even be suspected, that the occasional assumption of an Intransitive signification and a Parasmaipada inflexion by a passive verb, was the cause which gave rise to a 4th class of Primitive verbs as distinct from the Passive. Instances of passively formed of passive verbs taking Parasmaipada terminations, and some passive verbs (e. g. @[jāyate] 'is born,' tr. @[jan]; @[pūryate], 'is filled,' tr. @[pṛ]; and @[upyate] 'is heated,' tr. @[tap]) are regarded by native grammarians as Âtmanepada verbs of cl. 4. Again, many roots appear in class 4 as Intransitive verbs, which also appear in some one of the other nine as Transitive. For example, @[yuj], 'to join' when used in a Transitive sense, is conjugated either in cl. 7, or in the Causal; when in an Intransitive, in cl. 4. So also @[puṣ], 'to nourish,' @[kṣubh], 'to agitate;' @[kliś] 'to vex'; @[ślāgh], 'to accomplish,' &c. — Monier Williams.

rules.title: Special Cases in Passive Base Formation
rules.body:
## Special Cases in Passive Base Formation

### (a) Nasal Dropping with Vowel Lengthening

The roots @deva[स्तञ्ज्], @deva[जन्], @deva[तन्], and @deva[सञ्ज्], 'to sprinkle' drop their @deva[न्] and at the same time lengthen their vowel.

**Examples:**
- @deva[स्तान्यते]
- @deva[जान्यते], &c.

### (b) Special Base Forms

@deva[शी] 'to lie down' and @deva[चि] form their bases as @deva[शय्] and @deva[चय्].

### (c) Vowel Shortening with Prepositions

@deva[ऊह्] shortens its @deva[ऊ] when a preposition is prefixed.

### (d) Final Vowel Elision

@deva[दरिद्रा], @deva[दौषी] and @deva[वेणी] drop their final vowel before @deva[य].

### (e) Special Substitutions

@deva[हू] and @deva[अस्] substitute @deva[हुय्] and @deva[अस्य्] for themselves; @deva[यज्] and @deva[भञ्ज्] also substitute @deva[इज्] and @deva[भज्] respectively.
